items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Kimi Antonelli goes wide TWICE on opening lap
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli went wide twice on the opening lap of the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛：安东内利夺冠与诺里斯的不幸遭遇引发反响
items.summaryZh: 2026赛季第十四轮西班牙大奖赛在马德里赛道（马德里赛道）结束，安东内利取得胜利，诺里斯则遭遇不幸，赛后再现各方反应。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP LIVE: Race updates, results, stream, highlights from 14th round of 2026 Formula 1 season at Madring
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli claimed victory at the Spanish Grand Prix, the 14th round of the 2026 Formula 1 season held at Madring, while Lando Norris suffered misfortune, prompting reactions after the race.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯一度以为拿下杆位，直到诺里斯出现
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫一度认为基米·安东内利已为西班牙大奖赛夺得杆位，但兰多·诺里斯在最后一刻以微弱优势抢走杆位。
items.titleEn: Mercedes thought it had pole position until Lando Norris came along
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff briefly believed Kimi Antonelli had secured pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix, but Lando Norris snatched it away by the slightest margin.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘：要赢西班牙大奖赛需先弄清在哪里超车
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘在F1西班牙大奖赛排位赛中位列第三，落后杆位得主诺里斯和梅赛德斯车手安东内利仅略超十分之一秒。他表示，鉴于马德里街道赛道超车极为困难，若要击败诺里斯夺冠，自己仍需弄清在哪里超车。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen: ‘I need to figure out where to overtake’ to win F1 Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen qualified third for the F1 Spanish Grand Prix, just over a tenth slower than polesitter Lando Norris and Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli. He said he still needs to figure out where to overtake if he is to beat Norris to victory, given how difficult passing is expected to be at the Madring street circuit.

items.titleZh: 决定马德里首场F1比赛的5大因素
items.summaryZh: F1今日在马德里马德里赛道赛道迎来首场比赛，练习赛、排位赛及F2/F3垫场赛提供了一些线索，但缺乏历史数据意味着比赛仍可能充满意外。
items.titleEn: 5 factors that will dictate Madrid's first F1 race
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads into the unknown today at the new Madring circuit in Madrid for its first Spanish Grand Prix, with practice, qualifying and support races offering some clues but no racing history meaning surprises are possible.

items.titleZh: 科尔顿·赫塔退出马德里F2两回合比赛
items.summaryZh: 科尔顿·赫塔在F2马德里站周五排位赛中于第19号弯失控撞墙，随后退出周六和周日两回合比赛。据报道其感觉“身体不适”。
items.titleEn: Colton Herta withdraws from both Madring F2 races
items.summaryEn: Colton Herta has withdrawn from both races at the Madring Formula 2 round after crashing in Friday qualifying. His car damaged the front, rear and right-hand side when he hit both walls at Turn 19.

items.titleZh: 马德里大奖赛前瞻：高抓地力与高轮胎损耗成焦点，梅赛德斯调侃六停策略
items.summaryZh: F1车手首次造访马德里赛道时体验到出乎意料的高抓地力，同时极高的轮胎损耗同样令围场内多支车队感到意外。梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫还就超长维修区带来的六停策略开玩笑，但实际上维修区过长反而更倾向于一停。
items.titleEn: What to expect from Madrid GP? From Mercedes' six-stop joke to a "six-kilometre-long" pitlane
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 drivers experienced a surprisingly high level of grip on their first visit to the Madrid circuit, while very high tyre degradation has equally surprised teams in the paddock. Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff joked about a six-stop strategy, though the extremely long pitlane in reality appears to favour a one-stopper.

items.titleZh: 前迈凯伦青训车手Ugochukwu加冕2026年F3年度冠军
items.summaryZh: 前迈凯伦F1青训车手Ugo Ugochukwu于周日加冕2026年F3年度冠军，击败奥迪青训车手Freddie Slater。两人此前还曾在冬季的FRECA赛事中争夺冠军，Ugochukwu同样胜出。
items.summaryEn: Former McLaren F1 junior Ugo Ugochukwu was crowned the 2026 Formula 3 champion on Sunday, defeating Audi protege Freddie Slater. The pair had previously fought for the Formula Regional European title over the winter, with Ugochukwu prevailing there as well.

items.titleZh: 年轻时的埃尔顿·塞纳如何让F1精英们抓狂
items.summaryZh: The 比赛的F1历史播客《F1 Rewind》第二集中，Edd Straw与Mark Hughes回顾了埃尔顿·塞纳从托勒曼到莲花车队时期的崛起，以及他如何令围场内的资深对手们大为恼火。
items.titleEn: When a young Ayrton Senna drove F1's elite crazy
items.summaryEn: The second episode of The Race's F1 Rewind podcast explores Ayrton Senna's early rise, focusing on how his strategic approach and speed unsettled established drivers and team management during his Lotus years.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索警告F1不能这样继续下去
items.summaryZh: 阿隆索对当前一代F1赛车在马德里新赛道受限感到失望，警告F1“不能这样继续下去”，并透露已与F1高层讨论加速规则改革。
items.titleEn: "F1 cannot continue this way" - Fernando Alonso sounds the alarm at Spanish GP home race
items.summaryEn: Alonso expressed disappointment with how the current generation of F1 cars is held back at the new Madring circuit, warning that F1 "cannot continue this way," and revealed he has held talks with F1 chiefs to fast-track rule changes.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦加速争取兰比亚斯，F1围场高调会面引关注
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦正加快行动，试图提前从红牛获得工程师詹皮耶罗·兰比亚斯，并在F1围场进行了一次刻意高调的会面以引起关注。
items.titleEn: What's behind McLaren's brazen public meeting with Lambiase
items.summaryEn: McLaren is accelerating efforts to secure Red Bull engineer Gianpiero Lambiase early, and a deliberately brazen paddock meeting has drawn attention to the matter.

items.titleZh: 马德里F1西班牙大奖赛：倾斜的第12弯或成关键
items.summaryZh: 新增的马德里站本周末开赛前已在围场引发大量讨论，焦点集中在赛道安全问题以及第12弯La Monumental。
items.titleEn: Why Madring’s banked Turn 12 could be crucial in the Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: The new Madrid round has already sparked extensive discussion in the paddock ahead of this weekend, focusing on safety concerns and Turn 12, known as La Monumental.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里称马德里排位赛表现“令人震惊”且“相当混乱”
items.summaryZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在西班牙大奖赛排位赛后形容自己的表现“令人震惊”且“相当混乱”，他最终排名第七，而迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯则夺得杆位。皮亚斯特里整个周末在新马德里赛道都缺乏速度，除第三次练习赛外，他在马德里的任何一节练习赛或排位赛阶段都未能进入前六。
items.titleEn: “Pretty shocking”, “quite messy” – Oscar Piastri bewildered by poor Madring F1 qualifying
items.summaryEn: Oscar Piastri described his Spanish Grand Prix qualifying as "shocking" and "messy" after finishing seventh while McLaren team-mate Lando Norris took pole position. Piastri struggled for pace all weekend at the new Madring track, failing to break into the top six in any practice session or qualifying segment except FP3.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔称旧版法拉利引擎导致其在马德里排位赛失利
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔认为，未能使用法拉利最新的ADUO 2动力单元规格，是他在西班牙大奖赛排位赛中名次下滑的关键因素。
items.titleEn: Leclerc says old Ferrari engine cost him in Madrid qualifying
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc believes that not having Ferrari's latest ADUO 2 power unit specification was a key factor in his slip down the order in qualifying for the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯0.011秒险胜夺西班牙大奖赛杆位，斯特拉盛赞
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛排位赛中以0.011秒的微弱优势击败安东内利夺得杆位，迈凯伦领队Andrea Stella对他的表现给予高度赞扬。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris lost “three tenths” on way to shock Madring F1 pole
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris took pole position at the Spanish Grand Prix by a mere 0.011s over Kimi Antonelli, drawing high praise from McLaren team principal Andrea Stella.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯夺西班牙大奖赛杆位，被赞“惊艳”
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛排位赛中夺得杆位，其表现被F1车迷广泛称赞为“惊艳”。这位迈凯伦车手在马德里赛道赛道为周日的正赛锁定头名发车位，以仅0.011秒的优势击败梅赛德斯车队积分榜领先者基米·安东内利。红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘获得第三。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris hailed for "sensational" Spanish GP pole after FP2 setback: "Found his beast mode"
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris secured a surprise pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix, earning widespread praise from Formula 1 fans who called his performance "sensational." The McLaren driver took the top spot for Sunday's race at the Madring circuit, beating Mercedes championship leader Kimi Antonelli by just 0.011 seconds, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen third.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘谈如何改进马德里F1赛道：“如果给我赛道图……”
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘表示全新的马德里赛道完全没有超车机会，并认同诺里斯关于超长维修区设计欠考虑的看法。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen on how to fix new Madrid F1 circuit: "If they give me the track map…"
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen says the new Madring circuit in Madrid offers no overtaking opportunities at all, and he agrees with Lando Norris that the extremely long pitlane has not been properly thought through. Criticism from drivers emerged after qualifying at the IFEMA complex in the Spanish capital.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛马德里赛道：周日赛程、天气预报与观赛指南
items.summaryZh: F1西班牙大奖赛在马德里新赛道马德里（马德里赛道）迎来周日正赛，诺里斯在激动人心的首场排位赛中凭借最后一圈夺得杆位。维斯塔潘将从第三位发车，汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔为法拉利位列第四和第五。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP at Madring: Sunday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads into Sunday at the new Madring circuit in Madrid with Lando Norris on pole after a thrilling first qualifying session. Max Verstappen starts third, with Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc fourth and fifth for Ferrari.

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德西班牙站FP2撞车后称“我允许自己犯错”
items.summaryZh: F1西班牙大奖赛FP2中，新秀Arvid Lindblad驾驶小红牛赛车在马德里赛道赛道13号左弯撞车，右侧VCARB 03受损，提前结束周五练习。尽管如此，他仍以第10名完成排位，赛后为自己犯错的权利辩护，并表示由于需要更换底盘，情况受到影响。
items.titleEn: After Madring F1 crash, Arvid Lindblad insists: “I'm allowed to make mistakes”
items.summaryEn: In FP2 at the Spanish Grand Prix, rookie Arvid Lindblad crashed his Racing Bulls car at Turn 13 of the Madring circuit, damaging the right-hand side of the VCARB 03 and ending his Friday running early. Despite this, he qualified 10th and defended his right to make mistakes, noting that a chassis change affected his weekend.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛F1排位赛：赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 在马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛排位赛中，诺里斯以0.011秒优势夺得杆位，皮亚斯特里表现挣扎，多位车手命运各异。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from Spanish GP F1 qualifying at the Madring
items.summaryEn: In the first-ever Formula 1 qualifying at the Madring, Lando Norris took pole position by just 0.011s, while Oscar Piastri struggled and several other drivers experienced mixed fortunes.

items.titleZh: F1 2026西班牙大奖赛发车格确定：两罚一维修区起步
items.summaryZh: The 比赛发布F1 2026西班牙大奖赛（马德里）临时发车格，该发车格是在两项发车格罚退和一次维修区起步之后确定的。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 Spanish GP starting grid after two penalties and a pitlane start
items.summaryEn: The Race has published the provisional starting grid for the 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, which was set after two grid penalties and one pit lane start.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔解释马德里F1排位赛仅列第六的原因
items.summaryZh: 在F1西班牙大奖赛排位赛中，乔治·拉塞尔仅列第六，而梅赛德斯队友、争冠对手基米·安东内利则取得第二名。拉塞尔在马德里新街道赛道的Q1中做出最快圈速，但在随后两个阶段未能像对手那样显著提升成绩，最终排名第六，落后领先者约0.3秒。
items.titleEn: George Russell explains how he ended up a lowly sixth in Madring F1 qualifying
items.summaryEn: George Russell has explained his poor qualifying performance in Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix, having ended up a lowly sixth while Mercedes team-mate and title rival Kimi Antonelli took second. Russell set the pace in Q1 at Madrid's new street circuit but failed to improve as significantly as his opponents in the next two segments, ending up sixth, some three tenths down on his team-mate.

items.titleZh: F1马德里赛道首秀成谜 拉塞尔与汉密尔顿各持看法
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔认为F1在马德里赛道的首场比赛可能走向两个极端，刘易斯·汉密尔顿则坦言不清楚周日西班牙大奖赛会发生什么，轮胎退化成为焦点。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: F1 drivers braced for race-day mystery on Madring debut with tyre and overtaking uncertainties
items.summaryEn: George Russell believes F1's first race at the Madring could swing one of two extreme ways, while Lewis Hamilton admits he does not know what to expect ahead of Sunday's Spanish Grand Prix, with tyre degradation a central concern.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯惊讶夺F1西班牙站杆位，力压安东内利
items.summaryZh: 卫冕F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，他对在新马德里赛道（马德里赛道）举行的首场比赛中夺得杆位感到震惊。他在高速的马德里赛道上跑出“职业生涯最佳圈之一”，击败了积分榜领先者基米·安东内利。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris "shocked" to snatch F1 Spanish GP pole from Kimi Antonelli
items.summaryEn: Reigning Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris said he was shocked to take pole for the first-ever race on the new Madring circuit, putting in "one of the best laps of my career" to take down championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛发车格公布
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛发车格已确定，诺里斯夺得杆位。阿斯顿马丁车手斯特罗尔因更换新引擎部件被罚至队尾发车。
items.titleEn: This is the starting grid for the 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: The starting grid for the 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix has been set, with Lando Norris securing pole position. Aston Martin driver Lance Stroll will start from the back of the grid due to penalties for taking on new engine components.

items.titleZh: 2026年西班牙大奖赛排位赛集锦
items.summaryZh: 天空体育F1发布了2026年西班牙大奖赛排位赛的精彩集锦视频。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix | Qualifying Highlights
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports F1 has released highlight footage from qualifying for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: F1 2026排位赛队友对决：西班牙大奖赛
items.summaryZh: Motorsport.com在F1西班牙大奖赛排位赛结束后，公布2026赛季各车队队友之间的排位赛交锋记录。该记录仅依据排位赛结果统计，以避免发车格罚退影响数据。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 qualifying head-to-head: Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: Following qualifying at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix, Motorsport.com has published the updated team-mate qualifying head-to-head records for the season. The record is based exclusively on qualifying results so that grid penalties do not alter the statistics.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯克服变速箱故障，夺马德里环西班牙大奖赛杆位
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛排位赛中击败F1积分榜领先者基米·安东内利，夺得马德里环赛道的首个杆位。
items.titleEn: Norris snatches first Madring Spanish GP pole from Antonelli
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris beat Formula 1 points leader Kimi Antonelli to take pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛马德林赛道排位赛成绩
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛在马德林赛道进行了史上首次排位赛，兰多·诺里斯夺得个人赛季第三杆，险胜积分榜领先者基米·安东内利。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix 2026 Madring F1 qualifying results
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris took his third pole position of the 2026 Formula 1 season by narrowly beating championship leader Kimi Antonelli in the first-ever qualifying session at the Madring for the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：诺里斯在马德里赛道赛道夺杆位
items.summaryZh: 在F1首次造访马德里赛道赛道的西班牙大奖赛中，卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯以最后一搏的圈速跑出0.011秒的优势，击败积分榜领先者基米·安东内利，夺得个人本赛季第三个杆位，同时让梅赛德斯连续第四次在排位赛中落败。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP: Lando Norris takes stunning pole at Madring
items.summaryEn: Reigning world champion Lando Norris claimed his third pole of the season at Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix, beating series leader Kimi Antonelli on F1's first-ever visit to the Madring circuit. With a last-ditch effort, Norris took a mere 0.011s out of Antonelli's benchmark to hand Mercedes its fourth consecutive qualifying defeat.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯力压安东内利夺得西班牙大奖赛杆位
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛排位赛中，诺里斯 跑出惊艳一圈，以0.011秒优势击败 安东内利，拿下全新 马德里赛道 赛道的首个 F1 杆位。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Lando Norris beats Kimi Antonelli to first pole position at Madring after thrilling qualifying finale
items.summaryEn: In Spanish Grand Prix qualifying, Lando Norris produced a stunning lap to beat Kimi Antonelli by 11 thousandths of a second and claim the first Formula 1 pole position at the all-new Madring circuit.

items.titleZh: 亲历F1事故现场：目睹贝尔曼西班牙大奖赛FP3撞车
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛第三次自由练习中，奥利·贝尔曼驾驶哈斯F1赛车在马德里赛道赛道10号弯撞车。《The 比赛》记者乔恩·诺布尔当时就在事故现场，记录下了亲眼目睹这起F1撞车事故发生的感受。
items.titleEn: What it's like watching an F1 crash unfolding in front of you
items.summaryEn: During the third free practice session of the Spanish Grand Prix, Ollie Bearman crashed his Haas F1 car at Turn 10 of the Madring circuit. The Race journalist Jon Noble was at the scene and recorded his feelings of witnessing the F1 crash firsthand.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫怒斥“沙发战士”质疑梅赛德斯对拉塞尔的待遇
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫驳斥了“沙发战士”的说法，即银箭车队在意大利大奖赛期间未能公平对待乔治·拉塞尔。
items.titleEn: Mercedes chief Toto Wolff fumes at 'couch warriors' questioning team's treatment of George Russell in title battle with Kimi Antonelli
items.summaryEn: Mercedes chief Toto Wolff has dismissed suggestions from "couch warriors" that the Silver Arrows failed to treat George Russell fairly during the Italian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛：安东内利因"驾驶过慢"受到警告
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛周末，安东内利因"不必要地慢速驾驶"而受到警告。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP LIVE: Final Practice and Qualifying updates, results, stream, highlights from Formula 1 race weekend at Madring
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli received a warning for driving unnecessarily slowly during the Spanish Grand Prix weekend.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫揭示梅赛德斯车队指令策略：“始终会保持平衡”
items.summaryZh: 据天空体育报道，托托·沃尔夫透露了梅赛德斯车队的车队指令策略，并表示这一策略“始终会保持平衡”。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Toto Wolff reveals Mercedes team orders strategy
items.summaryEn: According to Sky Sports, Toto Wolff has revealed Mercedes' team orders strategy, saying it will "always be balanced".

items.titleZh: 施泰纳：安东内利在蒙扎夺冠后“应该效力法拉利”
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯车队领队京特·施泰纳表示，梅赛德斯车手、积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛夺冠后“应该效力法拉利”。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli "should be in a Ferrari" after Monza win, says Guenther Steiner
items.summaryEn: Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner believes Mercedes driver and championship leader Kimi Antonelli "should be in a Ferrari" after his impressive win at the Italian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿、贝尔曼在马德里F1末次练习中撞车
items.summaryZh: 西班牙大奖赛最后一次练习赛在马德里马德里赛道赛道进行，汉密尔顿在最后一个弯道撞车引发红旗，贝尔曼随后也撞车再度触发红旗，安东内利以全场最快成绩排名榜首。
items.titleEn: Hamilton, Bearman crash in final Madrid F1 practice
items.summaryEn: Final practice for the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madrid Madring circuit featured two red flags after Lewis Hamilton crashed at the final corner and Ollie Bearman crashed late in the session, with Kimi Antonelli topping the timesheets.

items.titleZh: 戴维森批评汉密尔顿马德里FP3行为 警告年轻车手勿效仿
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手、天空体育评论员安东尼·戴维森批评刘易斯·汉密尔顿在马德里FP3撞车后仍驾驶受损赛车继续行驶，认为他为年轻车手树立了不良榜样。汉密尔顿最终在收到赛会指令后停车，国际汽联可能对其处以罚款或竞技处罚。
items.titleEn: Anthony Davidson warns young drivers not to follow Lewis Hamilton's Madrid FP3 example
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver and Sky Sports analyst Anthony Davidson criticised Lewis Hamilton for continuing to drive his damaged Ferrari after crashing in Madrid FP3, saying he set a bad example for young drivers. Hamilton eventually stopped after receiving race director instructions, and the FIA may impose a fine or sporting penalty.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利在红旗中断的FP3中居首，汉密尔顿与贝尔曼发生撞车
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛马德里赛道进行的第三节自由练习中，积分榜领先者基米·安东内利跑出最快圈速。练习赛因两次撞车而中断，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和奥利弗·贝尔曼先后发生事故。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli tops red-flagged FP3 following Lewis Hamilton, Oliver Bearman crashes
items.summaryEn: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli set the fastest time in a red-flagged third practice session for the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit. The session was interrupted twice by crashes involving Lewis Hamilton and Oliver Bearman.

items.titleZh: 安东内利西班牙大奖赛三练最快，汉密尔顿撞车损失时间
items.summaryZh: 西班牙大奖赛最后一节练习赛中，积分榜领先者基米·安东内利做出最快圈速。刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生撞车，在马德里排位赛前损失了宝贵的赛道时间。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Lewis Hamilton crashes as Kimi Antonelli tops final practice from Charles Leclerc in Madrid
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli topped the final practice session for the Spanish Grand Prix, while Lewis Hamilton crashed and lost valuable track time ahead of qualifying in Madrid.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛三练尾声贝尔曼发生严重撞车
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛第三次练习赛临近结束时，奥利·贝尔曼发生严重撞车，撞车力度巨大，评论员对此感到震惊并庆幸他平安无事。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Ollie Bearman takes big hit at the end of third practice
items.summaryEn: Ollie Bearman took a huge hit in a heavy crash right at the end of third practice at the Spanish Grand Prix, with commentators expressing shock and relief that he was unharmed.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿无视法拉利停车指令继续驾驶受损赛车引争议
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在马德里举行的西班牙大奖赛第三次自由练习赛中撞墙，导致右前轮爆胎并损坏前翼。法拉利要求他停车，但他无视指令继续驾驶受损赛车，随后遭到车迷批评。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton under fire after ignoring Ferrari calls to stop damaged car in Madrid FP3
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton hit the wall during third free practice for the Spanish GP in Madrid, suffering a front-right puncture and a broken front wing. He ignored Ferrari's calls to stop his damaged car and faced criticism from fans.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛马德里赛道练习赛：安东内利领先，汉密尔顿与贝尔曼撞车
items.summaryZh: 在新马德里赛道赛道进行的F1西班牙大奖赛练习赛中，安东内利领先勒克莱尔位列第一，而汉密尔顿和Ollie Bearman均在练习赛中发生撞车。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring: Practice results
items.summaryEn: In Formula 1 practice at the new Madring circuit, Kimi Antonelli led Charles Leclerc at the top, while both Lewis Hamilton and Ollie Bearman crashed during the session.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿三练撞墙后无视车队指令
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第三次练习赛中撞上护栏，随后在试图返回维修区的过程中无视车队要求其停车的指令。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton crashes and then ignores team orders!
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton found the barrier during third practice and then ignored team orders to stop as he tried to make his way back to the pits.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔：马德里排位赛将是2026赛季F1最具挑战性之一
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔认为本周末西班牙大奖赛在马德里新赛道马德里赛道的排位赛将是2026赛季F1最具挑战性的排位赛之一，车手们需要适应这条包含22个弯角、拥有倾斜13.5度La Monumental弯的街道赛道。
items.titleEn: Charles Leclerc: Madrid qualifying to be "one of the most challenging" in F1 2026
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc believes qualifying for this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madrid circuit, Madring, will be one of the most challenging of the 2026 F1 season as drivers adapt to the 22-corner street track featuring the 13.5-degree banked La Monumental curve.

items.titleZh: F1电视转播未能展现马德里赛道魅力
items.summaryZh: Edd Straw指出，F1最新赛道马德里赛道在现场观看时令人印象深刻，但在电视转播中却显得平淡，未能充分展现其魅力。
items.titleEn: F1's TV visuals are letting its Madrid track down
items.summaryEn: Edd Straw points out that F1's newest circuit, the Madring, is impressive in person but appears bland on television, failing to fully showcase its appeal.

items.titleZh: F1车队面临马德里赛道策略难题
items.summaryZh: 据The 比赛报道，马德里赛道存在轮胎退化严重和进站耗时约24秒的问题，使F1车队在西班牙大奖赛策略选择上陷入两难。
items.titleEn: F1 teams face big Madring strategy dilemma
items.summaryEn: According to The Race, the Madring circuit suffers from severe tyre degradation and a pit stop loss time of around 24 seconds, leaving F1 teams in a dilemma over strategy for the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: Permane：西班牙大奖赛周五表现出色，尽管Lindblad撞车
items.summaryZh: 小红牛车队负责人Alan Permane称赞车队在西班牙大奖赛周五的表现是“出色的一天”，尽管Arvid Lindblad在FP2中于13号弯发生撞车，提前结束了他的练习。
items.titleEn: Pain in Spain goes mainly down the drain, explains Permane
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls boss Alan Permane hailed his team's Friday efforts at the Spanish Grand Prix as an "excellent day", despite Arvid Lindblad's Turn 13 crash in FP2 bringing an early end to his running.

items.titleZh: FIA公布ADUO评估结果：红牛福特动力单元未获升级令牌
items.summaryZh: FIA在赞德沃特比赛周末后公开确认，在F1的额外开发与升级机会（ADUO）系统下，除红牛福特动力单元外每家制造商均获得一枚令牌，维斯塔潘在蒙扎站后对此裁定作出回应。
items.titleEn: How Monza revealed the true picture – Max Verstappen responds to FIA's surprising ADUO verdict
items.summaryEn: After the Zandvoort race weekend, the FIA publicly confirmed that under Formula 1's Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities system every manufacturer has been awarded a token except Red Bull Ford Powertrains, and Max Verstappen responded to this surprising verdict after Monza.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘坦言对银石百人卡丁车挑战毫无准备
items.summaryZh: 四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘承认，对于下周在银石赛道举行的30圈挑战赛，他没有做任何准备。届时他将从队尾发车，尝试在银石赛道的30圈内超越全部100名卡丁车手。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen reveals laid-back approach to 100-driver Silverstone challenge
items.summaryEn: Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has admitted he has done zero preparation for his upcoming challenge to overtake 100 go-karters in 30 laps at Silverstone next week. He will start from the back of the grid and attempt to pass all 100 go-karters within 30 laps of the Silverstone circuit.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔谈银石专属看台：童年情结与拒绝更大看台的原因
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔就自己在银石赛道设立专属看台一事作出回应。该看台将从2027年起设于Farm Curve，他解释了选择这一较小看台的原因，并回忆了童年时在银石观赛的经历。
items.titleEn: George Russell shares childhood Silverstone connection and why he rejected bigger grandstand
items.summaryEn: George Russell has responded to the launch of his own dedicated grandstand at Silverstone, which will be located at Farm Curve from 2027. He explained why he chose a slightly smaller grandstand and reflected on his childhood memories of visiting the circuit.

items.titleZh: 库特哈德：安东内利在蒙扎证明自己是F1“现象级”车手
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手大卫·库特哈德表示，基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛中从第19位发车夺冠，是一场定义职业生涯的表现，可与F1历史上最伟大车手的驾驶相提并论。这位梅赛德斯车手在蒙扎主场观众面前赢得个人第七个分站冠军，成为60年来首位赢得该赛事的意大利车手。
items.titleEn: David Coulthard says Kimi Antonelli proved he is an F1 "phenomenon" at Monza
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard says Kimi Antonelli's charge from 19th on the grid to win the Italian Grand Prix was a career-defining performance that sits alongside drives from the greatest drivers in the history of the series. The Mercedes driver secured his seventh career grand prix win in front of his home crowd at Monza, becoming the first Italian driver to win the event in 60 years.

items.titleZh: FIA主席推动规则让步以留住阿隆索
items.summaryZh: 据The 比赛报道，FIA主席Mohammed Ben Sulayem正推动一项新的规则让步方案，以帮助本田加快进展，并让费尔南多·阿隆索继续留在F1。
items.titleEn: The surprise plan to keep Alonso in F1
items.summaryEn: According to The Race, FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem is pushing a fresh rules concession plan to help accelerate Honda's progress and keep Fernando Alonso in Formula 1.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯长距离节奏明显领先：F1西班牙大奖赛练习赛长跑速度对比
items.summaryZh: 在F1西班牙大奖赛周五练习赛中，乔治·拉塞尔在搭载大量燃油的情况下成为长距离速度最快的车手，红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘经调整后每圈仅慢0.13秒。世界锦标赛领先者基米·安东内利位列长距离速度第三。
items.titleEn: Mercedes clearly ahead: How long-run pace compared in F1 Spanish GP practice
items.summaryEn: During Friday practice for the F1 Spanish Grand Prix, George Russell was the fastest driver over long runs with heavy fuel load, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen closest after adjustments, just 0.13 seconds per lap slower. World championship leader Kimi Antonelli was third-fastest over the long runs.

items.titleZh: F1马德里赛道练习首日：赢家与输家初现
items.summaryZh: F1在马德里赛道（马德里赛道）的首日正式赛道练习并未出现预期中的混乱，但已初步显现出一些赢家与输家。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from F1 Madring practice
items.summaryEn: The first official day of F1 track running at the Madring in Madrid did not produce the chaos that had been predicted, and first impressions up and down the field seem seriously positive.

items.titleZh: 车手评价F1新马德里赛道：高风险与潜在混乱
items.summaryZh: F1车手在模拟器和周五两节练习赛后首次评价西班牙大奖赛新马德里赛道（马德里赛道），多数人称赞其高难度布局，但也有人担忧超车困难。
items.titleEn: “High risk” and a chance of “chaos” - drivers open up on F1’s new Madring circuit
items.summaryEn: F1 drivers gave their first verdicts on the new Madring circuit for the Spanish Grand Prix after simulator runs and two Friday practice sessions, with most praising its high-commitment layout while some worried overtaking would be very tough.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘对F1新马德里赛道作出简短而意味深长的回应
items.summaryZh: F1首次使用马德里IFEMA会展中心周边的马德里赛道赛道，混乱少于围场内的担忧，维斯塔潘称主办方干得不错，但仍强调自己不是街道赛道的爱好者。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen’s short but telling reaction to F1’s new Madrid circuit
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's first visit to the new Madrid circuit around the IFEMA complex produced less chaos than feared, and Max Verstappen said the organizers have done a good job while stressing he is still not a fan of street circuits.

items.titleZh: David Croft盛赞安东内利成熟表现，F1争冠势头渐起
items.summaryZh: 天空体育F1首席评论员David Croft看好梅赛德斯车手安东内利，认为他有望成为比维斯塔潘更年轻的世界冠军。在上周末的意大利大奖赛中，Antonelli从第19位发车，在主场观众面前夺冠。
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports F1 lead commentator David Croft has backed Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli to become a younger world champion than Max Verstappen. At last weekend's Italian Grand Prix, Antonelli drove from 19th on the grid to victory in front of his home crowd.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔担忧马德里新赛道轮胎磨损：可能是一场六停的比赛
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在马德里新赛道首日练习后对周日西班牙大奖赛的轮胎磨损表示担忧，称高速弯角给轮胎带来巨大压力，并半开玩笑地说这可能是一场“六停的比赛”。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: George Russell reveals fears over tyre wear at new Madring track in Madrid for Sunday's race
items.summaryEn: George Russell has expressed concerns over tyre wear for Sunday's Spanish Grand Prix after the first day of practice at the new Madring circuit in Madrid, saying the high-speed corners put huge energy into the tyres and joking that it could be a "six-stop race".

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛马德里站：周六赛程、天气预报与观赛指南
items.summaryZh: F1西班牙大奖赛进入马德里赛道的周六赛程日，梅赛德斯车手安东内利在棘手的第二节练习赛中跑出全场最快圈速，力压法拉利的勒克莱尔，汉密尔顿位列第三。小红牛的林德布拉德表现抢眼排名第四，但随后在13号弯撞车触发红旗。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP at Madring: Saturday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
items.summaryEn: The Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix moves into Saturday at the Madring circuit in Madrid, where Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap in a tricky second practice session, ahead of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛 | 练习赛集锦
items.summaryZh: 天空体育发布了西班牙大奖赛周五练习赛的精彩集锦。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix | Practice highlights
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports has released highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 安东内利在马德里赛道第二次练习赛中领跑，红旗中断
items.summaryZh: 据Jack Benyon报道，锦标赛领跑者安东内利在马德里赛道的第二场F1练习赛中做出最快圈速，该节练习赛因红旗中断。
items.titleEn: All that happened in red-flagged second Madring F1 practice
items.summaryEn: According to Jack Benyon, championship leader Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap in the second F1 practice session at Madring, which was interrupted by a red flag.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利领跑艰难二练，林德布拉德撞车
items.summaryZh: 在F1西班牙大奖赛第二节自由练习中，梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利做出最快圈速，力压法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔。阿尔维德·林德布拉德在练习中发生撞车，引发红旗。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli leads tricky second practice as Arvid Lindblad crashes
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli topped the second practice session at the Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix, beating Ferrari's Charles Leclerc. Arvid Lindblad crashed during the session, bringing out a red flag.

items.titleZh: 安东内利马德里首日练习最快，林德布拉德遭遇F1首撞
items.summaryZh: F1西班牙大奖赛在马德里新赛道展开首日练习，世界锦标赛领先者基米·安东内利在二练做出最快圈速，法拉利的勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿紧随其后。英国新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德在13号弯发生严重撞车，这是他F1生涯的首次撞车。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli edges Ferrari in Madrid practice as Arvid Lindblad suffers first F1 crash at challenging Madring circuit
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli was fastest on the first day of Formula 1 running at the Spanish Grand Prix's new Madrid circuit, edging out Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton in Practice Two. British rookie Arvid Lindblad suffered his first F1 crash with a heavy impact at Turn 13.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚盛赞马德里赛道赛道：2026赛季首条让他想重返驾驶舱的赛道
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚对全新的马德里赛道赛道给予好评，表示这是2026赛季第一条让他想重新坐进驾驶舱的赛道。上周末在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛中，梅赛德斯由基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔包揽前二。此后车手们将面对这条全长5.4公里、共22个弯的全新赛道，踏入未知领域。
items.titleEn: Juan Pablo Montoya says Madring is first 2026 F1 track he wants to drive
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has praised the brand-new Madring circuit, saying it is the first track of the 2026 season that has made him want to get back behind the wheel. After the Italian Grand Prix at Monza last weekend, where Mercedes finished 1-2 with Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, drivers now face a step into the unknown at the new 5.4km, 22-turn semi-street circuit in the Spanish capital.

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德在马德里严重撞车 引发首次红旗
items.summaryZh: 在马德里马德里赛道赛道进行的第二次练习赛中，林德布拉德在第13号弯发生严重撞车，导致赛道出示本次周末的首次红旗。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Arvid Lindblad brings out first red flag in Madrid with big crash
items.summaryEn: Arvid Lindblad brought out the first red flag at the Madrid Madring track after a heavy crash at turn 13 during second practice.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛：勒克莱尔预测马德里排位赛将“激动人心”
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔在西班牙大奖赛前表示，马德里新赛道马德里赛道的排位赛将十分“激动人心”。天空体育对周五两次练习赛进行了直播报道。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP LIVE: Friday Practice updates, results, stream, highlights from Formula 1 race at new Madring circuit in Madrid
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc said ahead of the Spanish Grand Prix that qualifying at Madrid's new Madring circuit will be "exciting". Sky Sports provided live coverage of Friday's two practice sessions.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔西班牙大奖赛无缘法拉利最新引擎规格
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔因上周末意大利大奖赛在帕拉波利卡弯出口撞墙，无法在西班牙大奖赛使用法拉利最新的ADUO2引擎规格，只能使用ADUO1引擎，而汉密尔顿可正常使用ADUO2。
items.titleEn: Why Charles Leclerc isn't using latest ADUO2 engine in the Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc will not be able to use Ferrari's latest ADUO2 engine specification at the Spanish Grand Prix due to his crash at the exit of the Parabolica in last weekend's Italian Grand Prix, and will instead use an ADUO1 engine, while Lewis Hamilton can use the ADUO2 as normal.

items.titleZh: 佩雷兹FP1两次超速 凯迪拉克车队被罚两笔
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛马德里站第一次自由练习中，凯迪拉克F1车队的塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹两次超过维修区80公里/小时的限速，国际汽联裁判因此对车队开出两笔罚款。
items.titleEn: Cadillac hit with €1700 in fines after Sergio Perez Madrid FP1 infringements
items.summaryEn: Cadillac has been fined twice after Sergio Perez exceeded the 80km/h pitlane speed limit on two occasions during FP1 at the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid.

items.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁称兰斯·斯特罗尔在多条F1赛道"不可战胜"
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1大使佩德罗·德拉罗萨盛赞兰斯·斯特罗尔，称这位加拿大车手可以和队友费尔南多·阿隆索一样快。不过自2023年成为队友以来，斯特罗尔在排位赛和积分上均大幅落后于阿隆索。
items.titleEn: Aston Martin claims Lance Stroll is “unbeatable” at many F1 tracks
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin F1 ambassador Pedro de la Rosa has praised Lance Stroll, claiming the Canadian can be as quick as his team-mate Fernando Alonso. However, since becoming team-mates in 2023, Stroll has been heavily outqualified and outscored by Alonso.

items.titleZh: 乔里恩·帕尔默：法拉利为汉密尔顿调整争冠重心已"太晚"
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手、F1 TV评论员乔里恩·帕尔默认为，法拉利已错过将刘易斯·汉密尔顿的争冠作为优先事项的时机，马拉内罗车队已让自己的争冠希望溜走。
items.titleEn: Ferrari "too late" to prioritise Lewis Hamilton in F1 title fight, says Jolyon Palmer
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver and F1 TV pundit Jolyon Palmer believes Ferrari has missed its window to prioritise Lewis Hamilton's championship bid, arguing the Maranello team has already let its title hopes slip away.

items.titleZh: F1首次在马德林赛道进行练习赛：拉塞尔领先安东内利
items.summaryZh: 在2026年西班牙大奖赛首次练习赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔领先队友基米·安东内利，这是F1历史上首次在马德里近郊的新街道赛道马德林（马德里赛道）进行练习。
items.titleEn: What happened in F1's first-ever Madring practice session
items.summaryEn: Mercedes' George Russell led his team-mate Kimi Antonelli in the first ever F1 practice session at the new Madring street circuit near Madrid, during FP1 for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔在马德里新赛道首练最快，安东内利紧随其后
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛马德里新赛道马德里赛道的首节练习赛中，梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔做出最快圈速，队友基米·安东内利紧随其后包揽前二。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: George Russell tops first practice at new Madring as Lewis Hamilton frustrates other drivers
items.summaryEn: George Russell set the fastest time in first practice at the new Madring circuit for the Spanish Grand Prix, with Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli making it a one-two for the team.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：拉塞尔领跑一练，汉密尔顿阻挡多位车手
items.summaryZh: 在全新马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛首次F1练习赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔做出最快圈速。22辆赛车中有20辆在练习赛开始后100秒内驶上这条全新赛道，尼科·霍肯伯格和佛朗哥·科拉平托稍晚出场。
items.titleEn: F1 Spanish GP: George Russell tops FP1 as Lewis Hamilton impedes several drivers
items.summaryEn: George Russell was fastest in the first-ever Formula 1 practice session at the brand-new Madring track for the Spanish Grand Prix. Twenty of the 22 cars took to the new circuit within the first 100 seconds of the session, with Nico Hulkenberg and Franco Colapinto emerging some time later.

items.titleZh: 欣奇克利夫警告：瓦塞尔在法拉利车队指令问题上承受巨大压力
items.summaryZh: 前IndyCar车手、F1电视评论员欣奇克利夫表示，法拉利领队瓦塞尔正面临巨大压力，需要在汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔之间确立明确的交战规则。
items.summaryEn: Former IndyCar driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe says Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur is under tremendous pressure to establish clear rules of engagement between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc.

items.titleZh: FIA主席：中国制造商加入F1需提出“认真报价”
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆表示，对F1增加第12支车队持开放态度，但任何候选者都必须按照锦标赛的条件加入。
items.titleEn: Chinese manufacturer has to make 'serious offer' to join F1
items.summaryEn: FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem says he is open to Formula 1 adding a 12th team, but any candidate must join on the championship's terms.

items.titleZh: 多名车手不满汉密尔顿在西班牙大奖赛一练中阻挡
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛第一次自由练习中，刘易斯·汉密尔顿因阻挡其他车手而引发多名车手的不满。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Several drivers fume at Lewis Hamilton for getting in the way during first practice
items.summaryEn: Several drivers were left frustrated by Lewis Hamilton for getting in the way during first practice of the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚：拉塞尔过度分析一切，安东内利自然驾驶扩大领先优势
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚表示，乔治·拉塞尔在驾驶时“试图过度分析一切”，而队友、当前领跑车手积分榜的基米·安东内利则让驾驶自然展开。车手们抵达马德里参加在马德林赛道举办的首届西班牙大奖赛之际，蒙托亚谈到了梅赛德斯两位车手的表现。
items.titleEn: George Russell 'overanalysing everything' as Kimi Antonelli extends F1 lead, says former driver
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya says George Russell is 'trying to overanalyse everything' behind the wheel, while his team-mate and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli lets his driving unfold naturally. Montoya discussed the Mercedes duo's form as the drivers arrive in Madrid for the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit.

items.titleZh: 角田裕毅在马德里再度替补出场，坦言在蒙扎“犯了不少错”
items.summaryZh: 本周末角田裕毅将再次代表小红牛在马德里出战，顶替劳森，后者则因哈贾尔受伤而再度为红牛出赛。角田坦言自己在蒙扎“犯了不少错”，由此体会到2026年F1赛车的复杂性。
items.titleEn: “I f***ed up quite a lot”: How Yuki Tsunoda discovered the complexity of F1 2026 at Monza
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda will once again stand in for Liam Lawson at Racing Bulls in Madrid this weekend, with Lawson deputising for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull Racing. Tsunoda admitted that he "f***ed up quite a lot" at Monza, which showed him how complex the 2026 F1 cars are.

items.titleZh: 内部人士披露红牛与保时捷十亿美元合作破裂内幕
items.summaryZh: 据回顾报道，红牛与保时捷曾达成联手进军大奖赛的协议，但这桩被形容为F1史上最引人注目的合资之一在2022年夏末破裂，红牛在漫长谈判后于最后时刻退出。时任保时捷赛车运动负责人的Fritz Enzinger在采访中披露了谈判进展之深入。
items.titleEn: Insider reveals how Red Bull’s billion-dollar Porsche deal collapsed
items.summaryEn: Red Bull and Porsche had agreed to join forces in grand prix racing, but the deal, described as one of the most spectacular joint ventures F1 could have seen, collapsed in late summer 2022 when Red Bull pulled out at the last moment after marathon negotiations. Fritz Enzinger, then head of Porsche Motorsport, has revealed how advanced the talks had become.

items.titleZh: F2车手坦萨纳波尔·因特拉普瓦萨克赛车起火后自行脱困
items.summaryZh: F2车手坦萨纳波尔·因特拉普瓦萨克（Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak）的赛车在西班牙大奖赛相关事故中起火燃烧，他随后自行离开赛车，安然无恙。
items.summaryEn: F2 driver Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak walked away unharmed after his car went up in flames at the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索对F1未来含糊表态的背后
items.summaryZh: 阿隆索在西班牙大奖赛前表示，关于自己未来的消息短期内不会明朗，2027年规则是否让车手重新成为核心将是关键因素。
items.titleEn: What's behind Fernando Alonso's cryptic comments about his F1 future?
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso said ahead of the Spanish Grand Prix that there will be no clarity on his future anytime soon, with much depending on the 2027 rules and whether they put the driver back at the centre of things.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔确认将在梅赛德斯升级动力单元后接受引擎罚退
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔表示，他将在梅赛德斯引入升级版F1动力单元时接受引擎罚退。此前安东内利已在蒙扎站因超出动力单元配额受罚，从队尾发车最终夺冠。
items.titleEn: George Russell reveals when he’ll take his own F1 engine penalty
items.summaryEn: George Russell says he will take an engine penalty when Mercedes introduces its upgraded Formula 1 power unit. Kimi Antonelli already took a back-of-the-grid penalty at Monza and drove to a historic victory from 19th.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔推迟F1引擎罚退以配合梅赛德斯ADUO升级
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔将推迟其不可避免的F1引擎更换罚退，直到梅赛德斯新的ADUO升级规格准备就绪，可能要到美国大奖赛前后。
items.titleEn: What's behind Russell and Mercedes' F1 engine penalty delay
items.summaryEn: George Russell will delay his inevitable Formula 1 engine change penalty until Mercedes' new ADUO-upgraded specification is ready, which may not be until around the time of the United States Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 奥康：车手不是哈斯的问题，尽管车队可能在考察新人
items.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥康坚称，在困境中的哈斯F1车队里“车手不是问题”，而他在世界锦标赛中的未来正面临威胁。
items.titleEn: Esteban Ocon: ‘Haas may be testing new drivers, but drivers aren’t the problem’
items.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon insists that "drivers are not the problem" at the struggling Haas F1 team, even as his own future in the world championship is under threat. He also said the latest aerodynamic upgrades introduced at Monza were "positive" although they haven't fixed the car's inconsistency.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔：蒙扎撞车后视力问题“非常短暂”
items.summaryZh: 法拉利车手夏尔·勒克莱尔就意大利大奖赛撞车后的情况作出说明，表示视力问题“非常短暂”。他在蒙扎第二圈失控撞上帕拉波利卡弯出口护栏，这是其2026赛季第三次退赛。
items.titleEn: Charles Leclerc gives insight into eyesight problem after Monza F1 crash
items.summaryEn: Ferrari Formula 1 driver Charles Leclerc has explained that the vision problem he experienced after his Italian Grand Prix crash was "very short". He lost control on lap two at Monza and hit the barriers at the exit of Parabolica, his third retirement of the 2026 season.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿：法拉利在马德里赛道测试中几乎未获优势
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，法拉利在本周末西班牙大奖赛前对新马德里赛道（马德里赛道）的试跑中“几乎没有”获得任何优势。车队曾于7月在该街道赛道进行拍摄日，使用SF-26赛车完成规则允许的200公里演示轮胎行驶。
items.titleEn: Ferrari got “hardly any” advantage from its Madring F1 test
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton says Ferrari gained "hardly any" advantage from testing F1's new Madring track ahead of this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix. The team carried out a filming day at the Madrid street circuit in July, running its SF-26 for 200km on demonstration tyres provided by Pirelli.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里否认故意破坏诺里斯排位赛的说法
items.summaryZh: 意大利大奖赛排位赛末段，皮亚斯特里本应在直道上为队友诺里斯提供尾流优势，但因在一号弯锁死车轮并放弃该圈，引发故意破坏的猜测，皮亚斯特里予以否认。
items.titleEn: Oscar Piastri shoots down Lando Norris sabotage theory
items.summaryEn: During the tense final phase of qualifying at the Italian Grand Prix, Oscar Piastri was supposed to run ahead of teammate Lando Norris to give him a slipstream advantage, but he locked up at the first corner, ran across the asphalt runoff and abandoned the lap, sparking speculation of deliberate sabotage that Piastri has denied.

items.titleZh: F1车手为马德里首办西班牙大奖赛推出特别头盔设计
items.summaryZh: F1首次来到马德里举办西班牙大奖赛，塞恩斯、阿隆索和诺里斯等多位车手为这项首届赛事推出了特别头盔设计。
items.titleEn: F1 drivers unveil striking one-off helmet designs for first Madrid Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 drivers including Carlos Sainz, Fernando Alonso and Lando Norris have unveiled special helmet designs for the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid. The event marks F1's first visit to the Spanish capital.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯西班牙大奖赛推出致敬1981年FW07C冠军赛车的特别涂装
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队将在马德里举行的西班牙大奖赛上，为FW48赛车使用一款致敬1981年FW07C冠军赛车的特别涂装。
items.titleEn: Williams pays tribute to 1981 title-winning car with special Spanish Grand Prix livery
items.summaryEn: Williams will run a one-off livery on its FW48 at this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, paying tribute to the FW07C that won the 1981 constructors' championship. The white, green and navy blue design also marks the last time F1 visited the Spanish capital in 1981.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛首日：法拉利蒙扎余波与马德里赛道赛道受关注
items.summaryZh: 在马德里进行的F1西班牙大奖赛首日，车手们对全新的马德里赛道赛道兴趣浓厚，法拉利车手也努力平息蒙扎灾难性周末带来的风波。
items.titleEn: Everything we learned on day one at F1's Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: On the opening day of the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, drivers showed strong interest in the new Madring track, while Ferrari drivers tried to play down the fallout from their bruising Monza weekend.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔：我对安东内利的节奏有应对之策
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔坚称自己对安东内利的节奏“确实有答案”，但承认要在车手积分榜上追上这位梅赛德斯队友还需要一些运气。
items.titleEn: George Russell insists he 'has an answer' to Kimi Antonelli's pace amid his Mercedes team-mate's dominance in title battle
items.summaryEn: George Russell insists he "has an answer" to Kimi Antonelli's pace but admits he will need some luck to catch his Mercedes team-mate at the top of the Drivers' Championship.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘：新马德里赛道“可能是赛车杀手”
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘表示，新的马德里F1赛道“可能是赛车杀手”，多位车手预计西班牙大奖赛周末将受到干扰。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Max Verstappen says new Madring F1 circuit 'probably a car killer' as drivers anticipate disruptive weekend
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen says the new Madrid F1 circuit is 'probably a car killer', with several drivers anticipating a disruptive Spanish Grand Prix weekend.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘回应赛季可能一胜难求：我绝不会公开这么说
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎的荷兰媒体采访环节中，马克斯·维斯塔潘被问及本赛季是否可能一胜未得——这将是自2015年首秀赛季以来的首次，他回应称：“我显然绝不会公开这么说！”
items.titleEn: Why Max Verstappen isn’t buying the hype over a Red Bull surprise in Madrid
items.summaryEn: During the Dutch media session at Monza, Max Verstappen was asked whether he thinks he might not win a single race this Formula 1 season, which would be the first time since his debut year in 2015, and he replied: "I'm obviously never going to say that out loud!"

items.titleZh: F1车手展望首次驶上“疯狂”的马德里赛道赛道
items.summaryZh: F1车手准备周五首次驾驶“吓人”且“疯狂”的马德里赛道赛道，预计它将成为本赛季“最复杂”的赛道。
items.titleEn: F1's 'most complicated' track - What drivers expect from the Madring
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 drivers are bracing to drive the "scary" and "crazy" Madring circuit for the first time on Friday, with expectations that it will be the "most complicated" track of the year.

items.titleZh: 法拉利车手透露蒙扎赛后会谈内容
items.summaryZh: 法拉利F1车手汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔表示，他们在意大利大奖赛首圈争执后已澄清情况，目前将继续在没有交战规则的情况下比赛。
items.titleEn: What Ferrari drivers have revealed about post-Monza talks
items.summaryEn: Ferrari Formula 1 drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc say they have cleared the air after their opening-lap Italian Grand Prix squabble, and they will continue to race without rules of engagement for now.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔为蒙扎与汉密尔顿碰撞担责，两人在内部沟通后表态
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔承认在意大利大奖赛首圈与法拉利队友汉密尔顿的碰撞中“没有做出应有的表现”，并在两人与法拉利管理层沟通后为蒙扎事故承担责任。
items.titleEn: Charles Leclerc takes blame for Lewis Hamilton clash at Monza after pair hold talks ahead of Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc admitted he did not perform as he should have in his first-lap clash with Ferrari teammate Lewis Hamilton at the Italian Grand Prix and took responsibility for the Monza incident after the pair held talks with Ferrari's bosses.

items.titleZh: 抢先看！SkyPad解析F1全新马德里赛道
items.summaryZh: 天空体育的Anthony Davidson通过SkyPad对F1全新的马德里赛道马德里赛道进行了首个车载视角解析。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Ride onboard at the Madring circuit for the first time!
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports' Anthony Davidson breaks down the new Madrid F1 circuit, the Madring, using SkyPad with a first onboard lap.

items.titleZh: F1新马德里赛道马德里赛道的五个初步印象
items.summaryZh: F1三年来首条全新赛道马德里赛道亮相，作者Jon Noble分享了关于这条赛道的五点初步印象。
items.titleEn: Five first impressions of F1's new Madring circuit
items.summaryEn: The new Madring circuit hosting this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix is Formula 1's first new circuit since Las Vegas in 2023, and Jon Noble shares five first impressions of the track.

items.titleZh: 法拉利可借鉴迈凯伦与梅赛德斯车手管理经验
items.summaryZh: 法拉利正面临勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿之间的车手关系问题，Jon Noble撰文指出，法拉利可以从迈凯伦和梅赛德斯处理车手关系的政策中汲取经验。
items.titleEn: The driver handling lessons Ferrari can take from two big rivals
items.summaryEn: Ferrari is facing a driver relationship issue between Leclerc and Hamilton, and Jon Noble argues that Ferrari can learn from how McLaren and Mercedes have handled their driver relationships.

items.titleZh: 奥迪首位F1青训车手有望延续夺冠纪录
items.summaryZh: 随着F1首次亮相马德里，奥迪首位F1青训车手、F3年度冠军领跑者Freddie Slater将在F3冠军争夺战中力争保持其100%的夺冠纪录。
items.titleEn: Audi's first F1 protege is on the brink of extending his title streak
items.summaryEn: As F1 debuts in Madrid, Audi's first F1 protege, Formula 3 championship leader Freddie Slater, will aim to maintain his 100% title-winning streak in the F3 title decider.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛前瞻：马德里马德里赛道赛道迎来首秀
items.summaryZh: 本周末F1西班牙大奖赛将在位于西班牙首都郊区的新赛道马德里赛道首次举办，取代此前的巴塞罗那。
items.titleEn: Five things to look out for at the F1 Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: This weekend's F1 Spanish Grand Prix will be held for the first time at the new Madring circuit on the outskirts of the Spanish capital, replacing Barcelona as the host.

items.titleZh: 雅克·维伦纽夫谈从父亲吉尔身上真正学到的东西
items.summaryZh: 1997年世界冠军雅克·维伦纽夫表示，他从未把自己视为父亲吉尔·维伦纽夫赛车遗产的传承者，但如今承认自己从父亲身上吸收了更深层的东西——“我能做到，你做不到”。
items.titleEn: What Jacques Villeneuve really learned from Gilles: "I can do this, you can’t"
items.summaryEn: 1997 world champion Jacques Villeneuve says he never saw himself as carrying on his father Gilles' legacy in motor racing, but now recognises he absorbed something deeper from him: "I can do this, you can't".

items.titleZh: F1新马德里赛道为何被称为“赛车杀手”
items.summaryZh: 本周末马德里大奖赛将启用全新马德里赛道赛道，该赛道被比作摩纳哥、澳门和吉达的结合体，但F3测试中出现的19次红旗和多辆赛车损坏引发对其“赛车杀手”特性的担忧。
items.titleEn: Why F1's new Madrid track is a 'car killer'
items.summaryEn: This weekend's Madrid Grand Prix will debut the brand-new Madring circuit, which has been compared to a mix of Monaco, Macau and Jeddah, but fears about its "car killer" nature have arisen after 19 red flags and multiple damaged cars in an F3 test.

items.titleZh: 法拉利青训车手塔波宁：马德里新赛道“极具挑战”
items.summaryZh: 法拉利F1青训车手Tuukka Taponen将新落成的马德里赛道赛道形容为“相当耗费体力”且“非常苛刻”，并指出在这条赛道上达到完美非常困难。
items.titleEn: “Even a small mistake can cost you a lot” – How Madring will challenge F1 drivers
items.summaryEn: Ferrari F1 junior Tuukka Taponen described the new Madring circuit as "quite physical" and "very demanding", explaining how tough perfection is to reach there. The challenge emerged clearly as successive crashes caused five red flags in one afternoon during an F3 test at the track.

items.titleZh: 钱德霍克：安东内利效力梅赛德斯而非法拉利减轻了压力
items.summaryZh: 天空体育F1评论员卡伦·钱德霍克认为，基米·安东内利为梅赛德斯而非法拉利效力，在一定程度上减轻了这位意大利车手的压力。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli driving for Mercedes rather than Ferrari has taken pressure off Italian says Karun Chandhok
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports F1 pundit Karun Chandhok believes that Kimi Antonelli driving for Mercedes rather than Ferrari has taken some pressure off the Italian driver.

items.titleZh: 基米·莱科宁之子加入红牛车手发展计划
items.summaryZh: 2007年F1世界冠军基米·莱科宁的11岁儿子罗宾·莱科宁（Robin Raikkonen）将从2027年起加入红牛车手发展计划。
items.titleEn: Kimi Raikkonen's son joins Red Bull
items.summaryEn: Robin Raikkonen, the 11-year-old son of 2007 Formula 1 world champion Kimi Raikkonen, will join Red Bull's driver development programme from 2027.

items.titleZh: 红牛签下基米·莱科宁之子罗宾·莱科宁
items.summaryZh: 2007年F1世界冠军基米·莱科宁之子、11岁的罗宾·莱科宁已被红牛青训车队签下。他自2022年起活跃于卡丁车赛事，曾参加Rotax Max Challenge和WSK Super Master Series。
items.titleEn: Red Bull signs Kimi Raikkonen’s son as junior driver
items.summaryEn: Robin Raikkonen, the 11-year-old son of 2007 Formula 1 world champion Kimi Raikkonen, has been signed to the Red Bull Junior Team. He has been active in karting since 2022, competing in the Rotax Max Challenge and the WSK Super Master Series.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔蒙扎高速撞车未损引擎，西班牙大奖赛免于罚退
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛蒙扎站以超过230公里/小时的速度失控撞车退赛，但由于引擎未受严重损坏，他不会在本周末的西班牙大奖赛受到发车位罚退。
items.titleEn: Charles Leclerc to avoid F1 Spanish GP engine penalty despite Monza crash
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc crashed out of the Italian Grand Prix at Monza after losing control at more than 230km/h, but his engine avoided serious damage so he will not face a grid penalty at this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: F1马德里新赛事首秀：马德里赛道赛道前瞻
items.summaryZh: 本周末F1将在马德里的马德里赛道赛道迎来45年来首次马德里站的比赛，该赛事获得了为期10年的西班牙大奖赛举办权。这条57圈的赛道被称为“双头怪兽”般的布局，车手和车队需要时间从工程角度加以理解。
items.titleEn: What to expect from F1's newest race as Madring debuts
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 will race in Madrid for the first time in 45 years this weekend at the Madring circuit, which has secured a 10-year tenure of the Spanish Grand Prix. The 57-lap circuit is described as a two-headed monster that will take drivers and teams some time to understand from an engineering perspective.

items.titleZh: F1全新街道赛道马德里赛道首秀，西班牙大奖赛或现混乱
items.summaryZh: 本周末F1将首次亮相位于马德里的全新街道赛道马德里赛道，车手小卡洛斯·塞恩斯预计比赛中会出现安全车和红旗。这条赛道被认为将对车手构成巨大挑战。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: What to expect from new Madring track in Madrid with Carlos Sainz predicting safety cars and red flags
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads into the unknown this weekend with the debut of the new Madring street circuit in Madrid, where Carlos Sainz has predicted safety cars and red flags. The track is expected to be a huge challenge for the drivers.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯借助ADUO机制推进引擎升级，法拉利争冠前景受冲击
items.summaryZh: 据Jon Noble报道，梅赛德斯正借助F1的ADUO追赶机制推进一项引擎升级，可能对法拉利日渐黯淡的2026年争冠前景造成致命打击。
items.titleEn: Mercedes' new engine upgrade plan is terrible news for Ferrari
items.summaryEn: Jon Noble reports that Mercedes is working on an engine upgrade under F1's ADUO catch-up mechanism that could deal a killer blow to Ferrari's fading 2026 title chances.

items.titleZh: 维特尔驾驶舒马赫2002年冠军法拉利背后的更深层意义
items.summaryZh: 乔恩·诺布尔撰文指出，塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔在意大利大奖赛驾驶迈克尔·舒马赫2002年冠军赛车F2002，不仅带有情感色彩，还传递了另一层信息。
items.titleEn: The wider significance of Vettel's Schumacher run
items.summaryEn: Jon Noble writes that Sebastian Vettel's run in Michael Schumacher's 2002 championship-winning F2002 at the Italian Grand Prix carried more meaning than just an emotional demonstration of famous machinery.

items.titleZh: Toto Wolff：安东内利像不断进化的“AI智能体”
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队负责人Toto Wolff表示，安东内利在2026年F1赛季的快速成长令他自己都感到惊讶，并将其比作一个始终在进步的“AI智能体”。
items.summaryEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff admits that even he has been surprised by Kimi Antonelli's rapid growth during the 2026 F1 season, likening the young Italian to an "AI agent" that is always improving.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦将在意大利大奖赛后审查诺里斯与皮亚斯特里的赛道竞争规则
items.summaryZh: 在F1意大利大奖赛蒙扎站的比赛中，兰多·诺里斯被听到指责队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里将他逼出赛道，迈凯伦承认将在赛后审查两位车手的竞争条款。
items.titleEn: McLaren to "review" racing between Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri following Italian GP
items.summaryEn: During the F1 Italian Grand Prix at Monza, Lando Norris was heard accusing teammate Oscar Piastri of forcing him off track, and McLaren admitted it will review the terms of competition between the two drivers after the race.

items.titleZh: 法拉利誓言在蒙扎“失败”后于马德里强势反弹
items.summaryZh: 法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔表示，车队将带着“全部能量”前往马德里举行的西班牙大奖赛，力争从蒙扎的“失败”中反弹。法拉利上一站蒙扎仅获得8个积分。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur says team will come back stronger in Madrid after Italian GP 'failure' at Monza
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team boss Frederic Vasseur says the team will head to the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid with "full energy" as they aim to bounce back from their "failure" at Monza, where Ferrari scored just eight points.

items.titleZh: 为何加斯利式的F1杆位冷门正接近绝迹
items.summaryZh: 《The 比赛》撰文指出，皮埃尔·加斯利在意大利大奖赛夺杆是F1近期最大的冷门之一，而过去十年只有两名“四大车队”之外的车手拿到过杆位。
items.titleEn: Why F1 pole shocks like Gasly's are close to extinct
items.summaryEn: Jon Noble writes that Pierre Gasly's pole position at the Italian Grand Prix was one of the biggest shocks Formula 1 has seen recently, noting that over the past decade only two drivers outside the big four teams have claimed pole.

items.titleZh: F3车手首次测试F1新赛道马德里赛道
items.summaryZh: F3车手在马德里赛道赛道完成了首次季中测试，这是这条F1新赛道首次迎来F3测试。
items.summaryEn: F3 drivers have completed in-season testing at the Madring for the first time, marking the F1 new track's first-ever F3 test.

items.titleZh: F1赛车驶入地下？红牛在马德里地铁上演史无前例特技
items.summaryZh: Oracle 红牛 比赛将沥青换成地下轨道，标志性的小红牛8赛车驶上马德里地铁轨道，完成一项史无前例的特技表演。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Next stop Madrid! Red Bull take to the Metro in epic first-of-its-kind stunt
items.summaryEn: Oracle Red Bull Racing swapped the asphalt for the underground, as the iconic RB8 took to the tracks of the Madrid Metro in a first-of-its-kind stunt.

items.titleZh: 贝尔曼：法拉利ADUO 2引擎升级对哈斯并非“改变格局”
items.summaryZh: 奥利弗·贝尔曼表示，法拉利ADUO 2引擎升级相比哈斯更新的F1底盘只是“小得多的一步”，并未带来显著性能提升。法拉利通过额外研发与升级机会系统推出2026赛季第二次也是最后一次动力单元升级，其中一套在意大利大奖赛交给哈斯使用。
items.titleEn: Ferrari’s ADUO 2 upgrade is no “game changer” for Haas either
items.summaryEn: Oliver Bearman says Ferrari's ADUO 2 engine upgrade represents "a much smaller step" than Haas' updated Formula 1 chassis and did not provide a significant performance gain. Ferrari introduced the second and final power unit upgrade of the 2026 season through its additional development and upgrade opportunity system, with one unit given to Haas at the Italian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚：梅赛德斯本应在蒙扎让拉塞尔和安东内利双车进站
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚认为，梅赛德斯在虚拟安全车期间未让乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利双车进站，从而影响了拉塞尔的意大利大奖赛。梅赛德斯最终在蒙扎以1-2完赛，安东内利从第19位发车逆转夺冠。
items.titleEn: Juan Pablo Montoya: Mercedes should have double-stacked George Russell and Kimi Antonelli at Monza
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes Mercedes compromised George Russell's Italian Grand Prix by not double-stacking its drivers under the virtual safety car. Mercedes still finished 1-2 at Monza, with Kimi Antonelli recovering from 19th on the grid to win.

items.titleZh: F1冠军争夺战尚未结束
items.summaryZh: 安东内利在意大利大奖赛蒙扎从第19位发车并夺冠，这场令人震惊的胜利被认为虽巩固了他作为积分榜领跑者的地位，但本赛季的冠军争夺战仍未结束。
items.titleEn: F1 title race: Why championship is not over despite spectacular Kimi Antonelli win at Italian Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli delivered a spectacular win at the Italian Grand Prix at Monza after starting from 19th, and while the victory underlined his status as championship leader, the title fight is still not over.

items.titleZh: 法拉利面临关键抉择：车队内部问题与未来走向
items.summaryZh: 法拉利2026赛季陷入困境：车手组合不和谐、车队运营问题清单不断拉长，梅赛德斯和安东内利还在法拉利主场给了他们最难堪的打击。文章探讨车手、车队以及领队瓦塞尔接下来的出路，以及前红牛车队CEO霍纳可能扮演的角色。
items.titleEn: The pivotal choices Ferrari is now facing
items.summaryEn: Ferrari faces a spiraling crisis in its 2026 season, marked by driver disharmony, growing operational problems, and an embarrassing home-race blow from Mercedes and Kimi Antonelli. The article examines what comes next for the drivers, team principal Fred Vasseur, and how former Red Bull CEO Christian Horner might fit in.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔将连续第三场F1比赛缺阵
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕骨折尚未康复，将缺席在新马德林赛道举行的首场F1比赛，这是他连续缺席的第三场大奖赛。利亚姆·劳森将继续代替他出战。
items.titleEn: Hadjar to miss third straight F1 race
items.summaryEn: Red Bull's Isack Hadjar will miss a third consecutive grand prix, sitting out the first-ever F1 race at the new Madring venue as he continues to recover from a wrist fracture, with Liam Lawson again deputising in the RB22.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔因手腕伤势连续第三场缺席，角田裕毅回归小红牛
items.summaryZh: 红牛确认伊萨克·哈贾尔的手腕伤势仍需更多恢复时间，他将缺席本周末在马德里举行的F1西班牙大奖赛，这是他连续第三场缺席。利亚姆·劳森将回到红牛车队与马克斯·维斯塔潘搭档，角田裕毅则再次代表小红牛出战。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar to sit out third F1 race in Madrid as Yuki Tsunoda returns
items.summaryEn: Red Bull has confirmed that Isack Hadjar needs more time to recover from his wrist injury and will miss this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, his third consecutive race absence. Liam Lawson returns to the RB22 alongside Max Verstappen, while Yuki Tsunoda gets another race with Racing Bulls.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔因手腕伤势继续缺阵，将缺席西班牙大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 红牛确认伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕伤势未愈，将连续缺席第三场比赛，无缘本周末在马德里举行的西班牙大奖赛。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar to miss Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid due to wrist injury as Liam Lawson continues at Red Bull
items.summaryEn: Red Bull have confirmed that Isack Hadjar will miss a third straight race due to his ongoing wrist injury and will sit out this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯：意大利大奖赛对皮亚斯特里的抱怨是“一时冲动”
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯表示，他在F1意大利大奖赛与队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的争夺是“公平”的，尽管当时他有两个车轮压上了草地，并称此前的抱怨是“一时冲动”下做出的。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris: Oscar Piastri move complaint made "in the heat of the moment" in Italian GP
items.summaryEn: McLaren driver Lando Norris said his Italian Grand Prix battle with team-mate Oscar Piastri, in which he dipped two wheels on the grass, was "fair", describing his earlier complaint as being made "in the heat of the moment".

items.titleZh: 前F1掌门人伯尼·埃克莱斯顿据报在葡萄牙因携带猎枪被捕
items.summaryZh: 据葡萄牙媒体《Correio da Manha》报道，前F1首席执行官伯尼·埃克莱斯顿因涉嫌携带猎枪且缺少所需文件，在葡萄牙被拘留。
items.titleEn: Ex-F1 boss Bernie Ecclestone reportedly arrested for travelling with shotgun in Portugal
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 CEO Bernie Ecclestone was reportedly arrested in Portugal for allegedly travelling with a shotgun without the required documentation. The 95-year-old was reportedly detained after his private jet landed at Tires Aerodrome in Cascais, just outside Lisbon.

items.titleZh: Edd Straw 2026年F1意大利大奖赛车手排名
items.summaryZh: Edd Straw对2026年F1意大利大奖赛的车手表现进行排名，本站比赛既有令人难忘的主场胜利，也有主队车队的严重失误。
items.titleEn: Edd Straw's 2026 Italian Grand Prix F1 driver rankings
items.summaryEn: Edd Straw has ranked the driver performances at the 2026 F1 Italian Grand Prix, a race that delivered a memorable home win alongside a bad stumble from the home team.

items.titleZh: 安东内利意大利大奖赛夺冠后向车迷致意：梦想成真
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在蒙扎意大利大奖赛夺冠后向车迷表示，这场胜利是“梦想成真”，他成为自1966年以来首位在蒙扎夺冠的本土车手。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli sends emotional message to fans after "indescribable" Italian GP victory
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli described his Italian Grand Prix victory at Monza as a "dream come true" in a message to fans, becoming the first home driver to win at Monza since 1966.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚：法拉利高层须介入，明确汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔的界限
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚认为，在意大利大奖赛首圈刘易斯·汉密尔顿与夏尔·勒克莱尔发生碰撞后，法拉利高层必须介入并明确车手之间的界限。
items.titleEn: Ferrari bosses must step in after Lewis Hamilton-Charles Leclerc Monza clash, says former driver
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes Ferrari's senior management must step in and establish clear boundaries between drivers after Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc clashed on the opening lap of the Italian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 瓦塞尔：即便有ADUO 2升级，法拉利仍“缺少纯粹动力”
items.summaryZh: 法拉利领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔表示，法拉利在2026年从未打算在引擎动力方面达到梅赛德斯的水平，第二次动力单元升级也未缩小与梅赛德斯引擎的差距。
items.titleEn: Even with ADUO 2 upgrade, Ferrari is “missing pure power”
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur says Ferrari never aimed to match Mercedes' level of engine power in 2026, and the team's second power unit upgrade failed to close the gap to the Mercedes engine.

items.titleZh: 奥迪就角田裕毅意大利大奖赛重启事件提交上诉意向
items.summaryZh: 奥迪已就意大利大奖赛重启阶段涉及角田裕毅的一起事件提交“上诉意向”，原因是角田裕毅在该事件中未受到处罚。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: The Yuki Tsunoda incident that's caused Audi to lodge an 'intention to appeal'
items.summaryEn: Audi has lodged an 'intention to appeal' after Yuki Tsunoda escaped a penalty for an incident at the Italian Grand Prix restart.

items.titleZh: F1意大利大奖赛：蒙扎站的关键看点
items.summaryZh: F1意大利大奖赛产生了2026年一位并不意外的赢家，但其夺冠过程比预期更为平淡，通往这一结果的整个周末历程则复杂得多。随着欧洲赛季段收官，The 比赛梳理了蒙扎之行的关键内容。
items.titleEn: Everything we learned from F1's Italian Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix produced a familiar 2026 winner whose run to victory was more routine than expected, but the weekend-long route to that outcome was far more complicated. As the European leg of the season concluded, The Race outlined the key storylines from Monza.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛完整周末赛程公布
items.summaryZh: The 比赛 Team发布了2026年F1西班牙大奖赛的完整周末赛程，比赛将在马德里郊外的新赛道马德里赛道首次举行。
items.titleEn: What time is F1's 2026 Spanish Grand Prix? Full weekend schedule
items.summaryEn: The Race Team has published the full weekend schedule for the 2026 Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix, which will be held for the first time at the new Madring track just outside the Spanish capital.

items.titleZh: 布伦德尔评2026意大利大奖赛：安东内利童话、拉塞尔受挫与法拉利内斗
items.summaryZh: 天空体育F1评论员布伦德尔撰文点评2026年意大利大奖赛，盛赞这是他30年解说生涯中最好的比赛之一，聚焦安东内利在蒙扎的童话般夺冠、梅赛德斯的策略拆分以及勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿的首圈事故。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: Martin Brundle's verdict on Kimi Antonelli fairytale, 'bruised' George Russell and Lewis Hamilton-Charles Leclerc incident
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports F1 commentator Martin Brundle reviewed the 2026 Italian Grand Prix, calling it one of the best races of his 30-year commentary career, focusing on Kimi Antonelli's fairytale victory at Monza, Mercedes' decision to split their drivers' strategies, and the opening-lap incident between Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton.

items.titleZh: 蒙扎引入类椭圆赛道式尾流竞速，2026新规改变F1比赛风格
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1新规已在多站比赛中显著改变竞速风格，蒙扎意大利大奖赛的尾流大战是最具戏剧性的例证。今年出现了新术语“悠悠球式竞速”，指赛车借助电池额外动力轻松超车，但因能量耗尽又难以保持位置。
items.titleEn: How Monza introduced oval-like slipstream racing to F1
items.summaryEn: The 2026 F1 regulations have significantly changed the racing style at several circuits, with Monza's slipstream festival being the most dramatic example. A new term, 'yo-yo racing', describes cars easily overtaking using extra battery power but then being unable to hold the position as energy runs out.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔蒙扎冲突中令人费解之处
items.summaryZh: Motorsport.com分析称，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与夏尔·勒克莱尔在蒙扎发生队友冲突，但与历史上通常涉及世界冠军争夺的队友冲突不同，两人紧张的缘由令人难以理解。
items.titleEn: What doesn't make sense about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc's Monza clash
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc clashed as Ferrari team-mates at Monza, but unlike historic team-mate battles that involved world championships at stake, the reason for the tension here is hard to understand.

items.titleZh: 未公开视角：勒克莱尔意大利大奖赛撞车360度车载画面
items.summaryZh: 法拉利车手夏尔·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛中的撞车事故，其360度车载视角画面现已可供回看。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: 360 onboards of Charles Leclerc's crash at the Italian Grand Prix!
items.summaryEn: A 360-degree onboard view of Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc's crash at the Italian Grand Prix is now available to watch back.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫早知安东内利会在意大利大奖赛有神奇表现
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队领队沃尔夫表示，他在周六就已感觉到安东内利会在蒙扎有特殊表现。2026年9月6日，主场作战的安东内利令意大利观众陷入狂欢。
items.titleEn: Why Toto Wolff already knew Kimi Antonelli "would walk on water" at F1 Italian GP
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff says he already sensed something special from Kimi Antonelli on Saturday, and the home hero went on to send the Italian crowd into raptures at Monza on 6 September 2026.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛：周日正赛直播观看时间
items.summaryZh: F1将前往马德里的全新街道赛道马德里赛道举行西班牙大奖赛，这也是本赛季欧洲赛区的最后一站比赛。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP 2026: Dates, schedule, weather, UK start time and how to watch or stream F1 race in Madrid live on Sky Sports
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads to a brand-new street circuit in Madrid for the Spanish Grand Prix, the final European round of the season.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫：梅赛德斯车手蒙扎内斗“本可能以灾难收场”
items.summaryZh: 托托·沃尔夫表示，意大利大奖赛上基米·安东内利与乔治·拉塞尔之间的胜利争夺“本可能以灾难收场”，梅赛德斯F1车队“会显得像白痴”。
items.titleEn: Toto Wolff uneasy as Mercedes drivers fought at Monza: “That could have ended in disaster”
items.summaryEn: Toto Wolff said the victory battle between Kimi Antonelli and George Russell at the Italian Grand Prix "could have ended in disaster", which would have made Mercedes' F1 team "look like idiots".

items.titleZh: 从第19位发车夺冠：基米·安东内利在蒙扎创造历史
items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利从第19位发车，超越几乎全部对手赢得意大利大奖赛冠军，成为自1966年以来首位在蒙扎夺冠的意大利车手。
items.titleEn: Why Kimi Antonelli’s historic Monza win means so much to his father
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli started 19th and overtook almost the entire field to win the Italian Grand Prix, becoming the first Italian winner at Monza since 1966.

items.titleZh: 谁昨晚睡得最差：乔治·拉塞尔
items.summaryZh: 专栏作者认为拉塞尔虽然登上意大利大奖赛亚军领奖台，但这本应是他能赢下的比赛，因此成为本期“谁昨晚睡得最差”的主角。
items.titleEn: Who slept worst last night: George Russell
items.summaryEn: The columnist argues that George Russell, despite finishing second on the podium at the Italian GP, should have won the race and therefore is this edition's subject of 'who slept worst last night'.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与安东内利父亲蒙扎温情互动走红："风度之举"
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘与基米·安东内利的父亲马尔科·安东内利在蒙扎赛后的互动在社交媒体上走红，网友称赞这是"风度之举"。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen's "wholesome" Monza moment with Kimi Antonelli's father goes viral: "Class act"
items.summaryEn: A post-race moment between Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Kimi Antonelli's father Marco Antonelli at Monza has gone viral on social media, earning praise from fans.

items.titleZh: 奥迪就角田裕毅起步事件中干事裁决提出上诉
items.summaryZh: 奥迪已提交上诉意向通知，针对意大利大奖赛干事未就角田裕毅涉嫌违反起步程序一事适用F1运动规则的决定提出上诉。
items.titleEn: Audi to appeal stewards' decision in Tsunoda aborted start case
items.summaryEn: Audi has lodged notice of its intention to appeal against the Italian Grand Prix stewards' decision not to apply Formula 1's sporting regulations in relation to Yuki Tsunoda's alleged infringement of the start procedure.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿呼吁法拉利明确队内规则，莱克勒克蒙扎碰撞引争议
items.summaryZh: 意大利大奖赛上，莱克勒克在首圈将队友汉密尔顿撞出赛道，随后又在第二圈高速撞上帕拉波利卡护墙引发红旗。七届世界冠军汉密尔顿赛后表示，法拉利缺乏清晰的队内交战规则导致车队损失了积分。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton calls for clearer Ferrari team rules after Charles Leclerc Monza clash
items.summaryEn: At the Italian Grand Prix, Charles Leclerc barged team-mate Lewis Hamilton into the gravel on the opening lap before spinning into the Parabolica barrier on lap two, triggering a red flag. Hamilton, the seven-time champion, said afterwards that Ferrari's lack of clear rules of engagement has cost the team points.

items.titleZh: “闻所未闻！”安东内利从第19位夺冠被比作“水上行走”
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛上从第19位发车一路逆袭夺冠，赛后受到评论员和领队托托·沃尔夫的高度赞誉。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli: Mercedes driver hailed by pundits and Toto Wolff after remarkable 19th to first Italian GP comeback win
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli produced a remarkable comeback from 19th on the grid to win the Italian Grand Prix, earning praise from pundits and team boss Toto Wolff. He caught teammate George Russell to claim a landmark home victory and extend his championship lead.

items.titleZh: 奥迪就角田裕毅意大利大奖赛裁决提出上诉意向
items.summaryZh: 奥迪F1车队已通知国际汽联，就意大利大奖赛中角田裕毅未被处罚一事提出上诉意向。争议源于第6圈重新起步时角田的停车位置引发了额外的编队圈。
items.titleEn: Audi lodges intention to appeal against Yuki Tsunoda's Italian GP verdict
