items.summaryEn: Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc crashed out of the Italian Grand Prix at Monza after a high-speed accident, bringing out the red flag after two racing laps.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛撞车退赛
items.summaryZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛中发生撞车事故，遗憾退出比赛。
items.titleEn: Charles Leclerc CRASHES OUT the of Italian GP!
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc crashed out of the Italian Grand Prix and was forced to retire from the race.

items.titleZh: 科尔顿·赫塔2026赛季雪上加霜——蒙扎两度失控一次故障
items.summaryZh: 科尔顿·赫塔的F2赛季持续恶化，蒙扎周末的表现为其困境提供了最清晰的例证。这位前IndyCar领先车手已被凯迪拉克F1车队签为2026赛季测试与开发车手，并在可能晋升世界锦标赛前转战F2。
items.titleEn: Colton Herta’s 2026 season goes from bad to worse – two offs, one breakdown at Monza
items.summaryEn: Colton Herta's Formula 2 season has been going from bad to worse, which nothing illustrates more clearly than his Monza weekend. The former IndyCar frontrunner was hired by the Cadillac Formula 1 team as a test and development driver for 2026 and switched to F2 ahead of a potential graduation to the world championship.

items.titleZh: 维特尔驾驶舒马赫法拉利F2002在蒙扎演示圈感动车迷
items.summaryZh: 四届F1世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔在意大利大奖赛前驾驶迈克尔·舒马赫的法拉利F2002进行演示圈，使用可持续燃料向童年英雄致敬，引发车迷强烈情感共鸣。
items.titleEn: F1 fans left emotional after Sebastian Vettel drives Michael Schumacher's Ferrari F2002 at Monza
items.summaryEn: Four-time Formula 1 champion Sebastian Vettel drove Michael Schumacher's Ferrari F2002 in a demonstration run ahead of the Italian Grand Prix, using sustainable fuel as a tribute to his childhood hero and drawing an emotional response from fans.

items.titleZh: 维特尔驾驶舒马赫法拉利F2002在蒙扎致敬
items.summaryZh: 四届F1世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔在蒙扎意大利大奖赛驾驶好友迈克尔·舒马赫2002年的法拉利F2002进行演示圈，情绪激动，称强烈感受到舒马赫的存在。
items.titleEn: WATCH: Sebastian Vettel pays emotional Michael Schumacher tribute in Ferrari F2002 - "I felt him a lot today"
items.summaryEn: Four-time F1 world champion Sebastian Vettel was overcome with emotion after driving his friend Michael Schumacher's 2002 Ferrari F2002 in a demo run at Monza during the Italian Grand Prix. He said he strongly felt Schumacher's presence during the tribute.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索和劳森将从维修区起步参加F1意大利大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索和利亚姆·劳森将在蒙扎的F1意大利大奖赛中从维修区起步，因为两人的赛车均违反了封闭停车场规则。
items.titleEn: Fernando Alonso and Liam Lawson will start F1 Italian GP from pitlane
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso and Liam Lawson will start the F1 Italian Grand Prix at Monza from the pitlane after both cars breached parc ferme rules.

items.titleZh: 阿尔派为加斯利蒙扎杆位带回折叠式尾翼
items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎以最出人意料的方式夺得职业生涯首个杆位，六年前他曾随AlphaTauri在蒙扎赢下一场最不可预测的F1比赛。阿尔派为此重新启用了此前搁置的折叠式尾翼。
items.titleEn: Alpine brings back folding rear wing ahead of Pierre Gasly’s Monza pole
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed the first pole position of his career at Monza in the most unexpected way, six years after winning there with AlphaTauri in one of the most unpredictable F1 races ever. Alpine brought back its folding rear wing as part of the low-downforce configuration.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿不满法拉利在蒙扎排位赛中的执行
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在F1意大利大奖赛排位赛仅获第五后，隐晦表达了对法拉利执行力的不满。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton unhappy with Ferrari execution in Monza F1 qualifying
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton implicitly expressed dissatisfaction with Ferrari's execution after finishing fifth in qualifying at the Italian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 从国际象棋到蒙扎杆位：加斯利一天内两次击败拉塞尔
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎排位赛中，皮埃尔·加斯利以0.060秒优势击败赛前热门乔治·拉塞尔，夺得其九年F1生涯首个杆位，这也是他继2020年在此夺冠后又一次高光时刻。
items.titleEn: From Chess.com to Monza pole: How Pierre Gasly beat George Russell twice in one afternoon
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly stunned the Formula 1 paddock at Monza by taking a shock pole position, beating pre-session favourite George Russell by just 0.060 seconds. It was his first-ever pole in a nine-year F1 career, at the track where he claimed his only win back in 2020.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦在意大利大奖赛排位赛中为何自陷困境
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎意大利大奖赛排位赛中，皮埃尔·加斯利与阿尔派表现出色，而迈凯伦因多个关键因素导致排位赛成绩不佳。尽管此前在布达佩斯和赞德沃特两连胜，高速的蒙扎并非迈凯伦的强项。
items.titleEn: How McLaren left itself exposed at the F1 Italian Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: At Monza's Italian Grand Prix, Pierre Gasly and Alpine excelled in qualifying while McLaren was left underwhelmed by several key factors. Despite two straight wins at high-downforce circuits in Budapest and Zandvoort, the high-speed Monza track was never expected to suit McLaren.

items.titleZh: 加里·安德森解析2026年F1蒙扎低阻力空气动力学调整
items.summaryZh: 加里·安德森分析了2026年能量受限的新规则下，蒙扎赛道所需的低阻力空气动力学调校方案。
items.titleEn: Gary Anderson on F1 2026's low-drag 'Monza special' aero tweaks
items.summaryEn: Former F1 engineer Gary Anderson explains how teams can optimise low-drag aerodynamic set-ups at Monza under the energy-constrained 2026 regulations, stressing the need to keep as much downforce as possible while cutting drag.

items.titleZh: 摩纳哥上诉裁决未激发加斯利蒙扎杆位动力
items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利表示，国际汽联国际上诉法院剥夺其摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台的决定并未激发他在蒙扎取得杆位的动力。此前，国际上诉法院推翻了摩纳哥赛会干事因维修区测量不准确而取消加斯利超速处罚的决定。
items.titleEn: Monaco GP appeal ruling didn’t spur Pierre Gasly’s motivation for Monza F1 pole
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly says the FIA International Court of Appeal's decision to strip him of his Monaco Grand Prix podium did not spur his motivation for taking pole position at Monza. The ICA overruled the Monaco stewards' reversal of his pitlane speeding penalties after the pitlane measurements were found to be inaccurate.

items.titleZh: F1意大利大奖赛前瞻：排位赛爆冷，正赛悬念丛生
items.summaryZh: 加斯利为阿尔派拿下杆位，令蒙扎排位赛爆出近年最大冷门之一，而围场普遍认为周日的正赛还将带来更多意外。
items.titleEn: What to expect from F1’s Italian GP
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly's pole position for Alpine produced one of the biggest shocks of recent years in Monza qualifying, and the paddock widely believes Sunday's race will deliver further surprises.

items.titleZh: 加斯利意外夺杆位 阿尔派对意大利大奖赛正赛夺冠信心十足
items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利在意大利大奖赛排位赛中出人意料地为阿尔派夺得杆位，车队因此对周日的正赛充满信心。此前所有赛前焦点都集中在法拉利主场作战和基米·安东内利领跑总冠军上。
items.titleEn: Why Alpine is bullish about winning the Italian GP after Pierre Gasly’s shock pole
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly surprisingly took pole position for Alpine at the Italian Grand Prix, giving the team strong confidence for Sunday's race. All the pre-race focus had been on Ferrari at home and Kimi Antonelli leading the championship.

items.titleZh: F1意大利大奖赛：加斯利夺生涯首杆，周日赛程与观赛指南
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎举行的F1意大利大奖赛排位赛中，阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利以0.060秒的优势击败乔治·拉塞尔，夺得F1生涯首个杆位。皮亚斯特里排位第三，但因阻挡劳森被罚退后三位。
items.titleEn: F1 Italian GP: Sunday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed his first Formula 1 pole position for Alpine in a stunning qualifying at Monza, and this article also provides the full Sunday schedule, weather forecast and viewing information for the Italian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里谈2025年蒙扎车队指令："我不会改变我的回应方式"
items.summaryZh: 一年前，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里以积分榜领先者身份抵达蒙扎，但自那个周末起形势急转直下，最终错失冠军。皮亚斯特里表示，对于2025年蒙扎服从车队指令一事，他不会改变自己的回应方式。
items.titleEn: Oscar Piastri on Monza 2025 team orders: "I wouldn’t change how I responded"
items.summaryEn: A year ago, Oscar Piastri arrived at Monza as the title favourite, but his form declined from that weekend onwards and he ultimately lost the championship. Piastri says he would not change how he responded to the 2025 Monza team orders.

items.titleZh: 阿尔派蒙扎干地正面对决夺杆位，可媲美2012年马尔多纳多冷门
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车手加斯利在意大利大奖赛干地排位赛中正面对决拿下杆位，这一表现极为罕见。The 比赛分析认为，原因一半在于阿尔派做对了，一半在于本应击败它的车队出现了失误。
items.titleEn: What Alpine got right at Monza and everyone else got wrong
items.summaryEn: Alpine, currently sixth in the constructors' championship, took pole position at the Italian Grand Prix in a straight fight in a dry qualifying session. The Race argues the result was a 50/50 split between what Alpine got right and what the teams that should have beaten it got wrong.

items.titleZh: 安东内利：我按车队要求为拉塞尔提供牵引，期待赛季后期获得回报
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎排位赛中，基米·安东内利按车队要求帮助队友兼冠军竞争对手乔治·拉塞尔获得牵引，并期待对方在赛季后期以同样方式回报自己。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli expects George Russell to return Monza favour in F1 title fight
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli says he helped his team-mate and title rival George Russell with a tow during Monza qualifying as instructed by the team, and he expects Russell to return the favour later in the season.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里Q3失误令诺里斯在意大利排位赛损失“半秒”
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯认为，若队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在意大利大奖赛排位赛最后时刻没有失误、未能为他提供尾流，他在蒙扎的最后一个飞驰圈本可快约“半秒”，这可能影响其正赛发车位置。
items.titleEn: Did Piastri's mistake cost Norris half a second in qualifying?
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris believes he could have been about half a second faster on his final qualifying lap at Monza had team-mate Oscar Piastri not made a mistake in the closing moments of Italian GP qualifying, which may have cost him grid positions.

items.titleZh: 杰里米·克拉克森承诺若加斯利夺意大利大奖赛冠军请全队喝Hawkstone啤酒
items.summaryZh: 前《Top Gear》和《The Grand Tour》主持人杰里米·克拉克森承诺，如果皮埃尔·加斯利将意大利大奖赛的意外杆位转化为冠军，他将请整个阿尔派 F1车队喝Hawkstone啤酒。
items.titleEn: Jeremy Clarkson makes Alpine F1 promise after Pierre Gasly Italian GP pole
items.summaryEn: Former Top Gear and The Grand Tour host Jeremy Clarkson has promised the entire Alpine F1 team a Hawkstone beer if Pierre Gasly converts his surprise Italian Grand Prix pole position into a victory.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1意大利大奖赛排位赛赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 意大利大奖赛排位赛诞生了十多年来F1最令人意外的干地杆位获得者，但除了他之外，围场中鲜有车手和车队对结果感到满意。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from Italian Grand Prix F1 qualifying 2026
items.summaryEn: Italian Grand Prix qualifying produced Formula 1's most surprising dry-weather polesitter in over a decade, but apart from him there were few in the pitlane with reasons to be cheerful.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔不满维斯塔潘排位赛行为："他直接猛踩刹车"
items.summaryZh: F1意大利大奖赛排位赛Q3最后一圈，乔治·拉塞尔对马克斯·维斯塔潘在起步阶段"猛踩刹车"感到沮丧，梅赛德斯车手以微弱劣势错失杆位。
items.titleEn: George Russell frustrated with Max Verstappen qualifying antics: "He just slammed on the brakes"
items.summaryEn: George Russell was frustrated with Max Verstappen "slamming on the brakes" at the start of their final Q3 laps in Italian Grand Prix qualifying, as the Mercedes driver narrowly missed out on pole.

items.titleZh: 从摩纳哥“被抢”到惊险杆位——加斯利能否赢下意大利大奖赛？
items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利在失去摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台仅一天后，出人意料地在意大利大奖赛排位赛中夺得杆位。他将于周日与乔治·拉塞尔并排发车，向蒙扎的胜利发起冲击。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: Can Pierre Gasly win Monza race for Alpine just days after losing Monaco podium?
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed a shock pole position at the Italian Grand Prix just one day after losing his Monaco Grand Prix podium. He will start alongside George Russell as he targets victory at Monza on Sunday.

items.titleZh: 加斯利蒙扎夺职业生涯首杆，击败拉塞尔震惊F1车迷
items.summaryZh: 在2026年意大利大奖赛排位赛中，阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利以0.060秒优势击败梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔，夺得个人职业生涯首个杆位。这一成绩打破了本赛季由拉塞尔和积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利主导的格局，引发车迷热烈庆祝。
items.titleEn: F1 fans celebrate Pierre Gasly after "insane" Italian GP pole position
items.summaryEn: Alpine's Pierre Gasly claimed his first career Formula 1 pole position at the Italian Grand Prix, beating Mercedes' George Russell by just 0.060 seconds at Monza. The result broke the dominance of Russell and championship leader Kimi Antonelli in the first year of the new 2026 technical regulations, sparking huge fan celebrations.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫指责维斯塔潘致拉塞尔失去意大利大奖赛杆位
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队老板托托·沃尔夫声称，乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛排位赛最后阶段受马克斯·维斯塔潘影响而错失杆位，杆位最终由阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利爆冷夺得。
items.titleEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff blames Max Verstappen for George Russell missing out on Italian GP pole to Pierre Gasly
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff claims George Russell's final qualifying lap at the Italian Grand Prix was compromised by Max Verstappen, with the pole position ultimately going to Pierre Gasly in a shock result for Alpine.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1意大利大奖赛发车格确定，两位车手将从维修区起步
items.summaryZh: The 比赛报道，2026年F1意大利大奖赛排位赛中皮埃尔·加斯利爆冷夺得杆位，但因多起罚退及红牛、阿斯顿·马丁违反封存规则，劳森与费尔南多·阿隆索决定从维修区起步。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 Italian GP starting grid with two pitlane starts
items.summaryEn: The Race reports that the 2026 F1 Italian Grand Prix grid is set, with Pierre Gasly stunningly taking pole, while Liam Lawson and Fernando Alonso will start from the pitlane after their teams broke parc ferme rules.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘解释红牛赛车“纸糊”言论：神秘问题困扰排位赛
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在蒙扎排位赛仅列第六，落后爆冷夺杆的皮埃尔·加斯利近0.3秒，并解释了此前称小红牛22赛车“纸糊”的言论，暗示赛车存在神秘问题。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen explains Red Bull car "made out of paper" comment after mysterious issue
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen qualified only sixth at Monza, nearly three tenths behind surprise polesitter Pierre Gasly, and explained his earlier comment that the RB22 is "made out of paper", hinting at a mysterious problem with the car.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿不满法拉利战术：未优先他的夺冠希望
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿认为法拉利没有把他的比赛策略放在队友勒克莱尔之前优先考虑，这可能危及车队在2026年日渐渺茫的争夺冠军机会。
items.titleEn: Hamilton's obvious frustration at Ferrari team tactics
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton believes Ferrari is putting its dimming chances of a 2026 title comeback at risk by not prioritising his campaign over team-mate Charles Leclerc's.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里因阻挡劳森被罚退三位
items.summaryZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里因在F1意大利大奖赛排位赛中阻挡利亚姆·劳森，被罚退三位，失去第三位发车位。
items.titleEn: Piastri gets grid penalty for Lawson Q2 incident
items.summaryEn: Oscar Piastri has lost his third-place grid position for the Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix after being penalised three places for impeding Liam Lawson in qualifying.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔给加斯利的建议在意大利大奖赛排位赛中反噬自身
items.summaryZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔在F1意大利大奖赛排位赛后开玩笑承认，他赛前给好友皮埃尔·加斯利分享了一些“小贴士”，没想到加斯利爆冷夺得杆位，这让勒克莱尔自己吃了亏。
items.titleEn: How Charles Leclerc's advice to Pierre Gasly came back to bite him in Italian GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc jokingly admitted after Italian GP qualifying that he had shared some tips with his close friend Pierre Gasly before the session, not expecting the Frenchman to take a shock pole position. Gasly's surprise pole came after three practice sessions in which Alpine had not shown particularly strong pace.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯调侃托托·沃尔夫在意大利大奖赛排位赛中的愤怒时刻
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯官方幽默回应了领队托托·沃尔夫在意大利大奖赛排位赛中的愤怒瞬间。蒙扎Q3最后时刻，阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利以0.060秒优势击败梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔夺杆，沃尔夫被拍到愤然击打车库计时台。
items.titleEn: Mercedes pokes fun at Toto Wolff after angry Italian GP qualifying moment
items.summaryEn: Mercedes has poked fun at its own team principal Toto Wolff after he was filmed striking his garage timing console in frustration during Italian Grand Prix qualifying. In the final moments of Q3 at Monza, Alpine's Pierre Gasly took a surprise pole position, beating Mercedes driver George Russell by just 0.060 seconds.

items.titleZh: 兰斯·斯特罗尔成为F1首位100次Q1淘汰车手
items.summaryZh: 兰斯·斯特罗尔在意大利大奖赛排位赛中垫底，成为自2006年三阶段排位赛制度引入以来首位达到100次Q1淘汰的车手。
items.titleEn: Lance Stroll becomes first F1 driver to reach 100 Q1 eliminations
items.summaryEn: Lance Stroll set an unwanted Formula 1 record by becoming the first driver to reach 100 Q1 eliminations since the three-part qualifying system was introduced in 2006. The Canadian qualified last for Sunday's Italian Grand Prix, just under a tenth slower than team-mate Fernando Alonso.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿批评法拉利排位赛执行：意大利站周六表现艰难
items.summaryZh: 在意大利大奖赛蒙扎排位赛中，刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示法拉利车队的执行“相当糟糕”，称排位赛非常艰难，认为车队在周六挑战更高排位的希望未能实现。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team's execution of Italian GP qualifying could have been better after 'very tough' session
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton described Ferrari's execution as 'pretty poor' after a 'very tough' Italian Grand Prix qualifying session at Monza, saying the team's hopes of a better Saturday result went unrealized.

items.titleZh: 加斯利蒙扎夺F1生涯首个杆位
items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎排位赛中驾驶阿尔派赛车夺得个人F1生涯首个杆位，他形容这条赛道“有些特别”。六年前他曾在这里赢得目前唯一一场分站冠军。
items.titleEn: "Something special here" - Pierre Gasly ecstatic to take maiden F1 pole in Monza
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed the first pole position of his Formula 1 career in qualifying at Monza, driving for Alpine and calling the track "something special". Six years ago he took his only grand prix win so far at the same circuit.

items.titleZh: 加斯利与阿尔派惊险夺意大利大奖赛杆位
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛排位赛中，皮埃尔·加斯利为阿尔派车队出人意料地夺得杆位，击败了梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔。
items.titleEn: Gasly and Alpine stun Mercedes to take Italian GP pole
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly claimed a shock pole position for Alpine in Italian Grand Prix qualifying at Monza, beating George Russell's Mercedes to the top spot.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1意大利大奖赛正赛发车顺位公布

Kimi Antonelli and Alex Albon have been sent to the back of the grid due to power unit change penalties, Oscar Piastri has been penalised three places, and Fernando Alonso will start from the pit lane.

items.titleZh: F1 2026排位赛队友对决：意大利大奖赛
items.summaryZh: Motorsport.com在意大利大奖赛排位赛后发布了2026赛季各车队队友间的排位赛对决记录，该记录仅基于排位赛成绩。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 qualifying head-to-head: Italian GP

items.summaryEn: The 2026 Formula 1 cars show clear differences in energy deployment at Monza, the most energy-starved track since the in-season rule changes were agreed in April, revealing differences in how teams manage their power units.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚建议红牛在西班牙大奖赛继续让劳森代驾

items.summaryEn: Mercedes has decided to let Kimi Antonelli take a fifth power unit at his home Italian Grand Prix, meaning he will start from the back of the grid for exceeding his annual allowance. The team had rational reasons for the call, but Fernando Alonso's prediction that he could climb to third may not be easy to fulfil.

items.titleZh: F1意大利大奖赛：拉塞尔在FP2中超越勒克莱尔
items.summaryZh: 在F1意大利大奖赛第二次自由练习赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔以1分22秒559的成绩位居榜首，将法拉利车手夏尔·勒克莱尔挤下头名。
items.titleEn: F1 Italian GP: George Russell outpaces Charles Leclerc in FP2
items.summaryEn: George Russell topped second practice at Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix with a 1m22.559s lap, nudging Ferrari's Charles Leclerc off the top of the timesheets.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔领跑意大利大奖赛第二次练习赛 梅赛德斯压过法拉利
items.summaryZh: 在意大利大奖赛第二次练习赛中，梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔创下全场最快圈速，击败了领跑法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: George Russell fastest in Practice Two as Mercedes edge ahead of fast-starting Ferrari at Monza
items.summaryEn: George Russell set the fastest time in Practice Two of the Italian Grand Prix, with Mercedes edging ahead of Ferrari, whose Charles Leclerc was second quickest.

items.titleZh: 布里亚托雷就上诉法院法官与迈凯伦爆发激烈争执
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托雷就国际上诉法院恢复对皮埃尔·加斯利摩纳哥大奖赛处罚的决定，与迈凯伦爆发激烈争执，并质疑其中一名法官的公正性。
items.titleEn: Briatore starts explosive row with McLaren over court of appeal judge
items.summaryEn: Alpine executive advisor Flavio Briatore has become embroiled in a heated dispute with McLaren over the International Court of Appeal's decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix penalties, questioning the impartiality of one of the judges on the panel.

items.titleZh: 布里亚托雷质疑摩纳哥大奖赛上诉公正性，称一名法官与迈凯伦关系密切
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队负责人弗拉维奥·布里亚托雷在意大利大奖赛蒙扎的新闻发布会上质疑摩纳哥大奖赛结果上诉程序的公正性，声称一名法官与迈凯伦车队关系密切。皮埃尔·加斯利在摩纳哥站因维修区超速被罚而失去第三名，后证实该处罚源于FOM的错误测量，阿尔派提出复审后FIA赛事干事同意撤销处罚。
items.titleEn: Flavio Briatore questions Monaco GP appeal integrity in explosive Monza press conference
items.summaryEn: Alpine F1 boss Flavio Briatore questioned the fairness of the appeal procedure against the Monaco Grand Prix results, claiming one judge has a close relationship with McLaren. Pierre Gasly lost his third place after being penalised for exceeding the pitlane speed limit, which was later found to be caused by an incorrect measurement by FOM, and the FIA stewards agreed to rescind his penalty after Alpine launched a right of review.

items.titleZh: 红牛更新伊萨克·哈贾尔恢复时间表
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队领队劳伦特·梅基斯表示，伊萨克·哈贾尔的手腕伤势需要更多时间恢复，可能无法在西班牙大奖赛重返F1。哈贾尔在夏季休赛期训练中受伤，缺席了赞德福特和蒙站的比赛周末。
items.titleEn: Red Bull gives update on Isack Hadjar’s recovery timeline
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says Isack Hadjar needs more time to recover from his wrist injury and is unlikely to return to Formula 1 at the Spanish Grand Prix. Hadjar was injured in training during the summer break and missed the Zandvoort and Monza race weekends.

items.titleZh: F1宣布2027赛季将在米兰举办为期三天的盛大揭幕活动
items.summaryZh: F1官方宣布，F1 Live Milan揭幕活动将于2027年2月18日至20日在意大利米兰举行，为期三天，汇聚全部11支车队、22位车手和现场娱乐表演。
items.titleEn: F1 announces plans for huge 2027 season launch in Milan
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has announced that F1 Live Milan, a three-day season launch event, will take place in Milan, Italy, from 18-20 February 2027, featuring all 11 teams, 22 drivers and live entertainment.

items.titleZh: F1公布2027赛季启动活动落地米兰
items.summaryZh: F1宣布2027赛季启动活动"F1 The Show"将于2月18日在米兰举行，汇集2027赛季的车手与车队。
items.titleEn: F1 2027: Season launch event to be held in Milan in February ahead of next campaign with teams, drivers present
items.summaryEn: F1 has announced that its 2027 season launch event, F1 The Show, will be held in Milan on February 18, featuring the 2027 drivers and teams.

items.titleZh: F1将于2027年2月在米兰举办赛季启动活动
items.summaryZh: 据The 比赛报道，F1将于2027年2月18日在米兰举办赛季启动活动“F1 The Show”，这是继两年前在O2体育馆举办F1 75 Live之后再次举办此类活动。
items.titleEn: F1 to hold 2027 season launch in Milan
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 will hold a 2027 season launch event called 'F1 The Show' in Milan on February 18, marking a return to the format two years after F1 75 Live at the O2 arena.

items.titleZh: 摩纳哥大奖赛裁决后阿尔派车队在积分榜受损
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联国际上诉法院裁定皮埃尔·加斯利在摩纳哥大奖赛中的超速处罚成立，这一裁决对积分榜产生显著影响，阿尔派车队因此受损。
items.titleEn: F1 championship standings after Monaco GP ruling: Alpine loses out
items.summaryEn: The FIA's International Court of Appeal ruled that Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix speeding penalties did stand, a decision that significantly affects the standings and costs Alpine dearly.

items.titleZh: 兰多·诺里斯新赛车团队收到“数百份求职申请”
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯周三宣布组建单座车队LN4 Fusion和车手发展计划LN4 Legacy，希望帮助缺乏资金支持的天才车手一路走向F1。他的新团队已收到数百份求职申请。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris' new race team received "a few hundred job requests"
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris announced on Wednesday the launch of the single-seater team LN4 Fusion and the LN4 Legacy driver programme, hoping to help underfunded talent work their way to Formula 1. His new race team has already received a few hundred job requests.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚警告：迈凯伦势不可挡，诺里斯冲击2026冠军
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手胡安·帕布罗·蒙托亚认为，迈凯伦随着队内信心增长，在2026赛季冠军争夺中已变得“难以阻挡”。卫冕冠军兰多·诺里斯在匈牙利和荷兰大奖赛连续夺冠后，本周末将出战意大利大奖赛。
items.titleEn: Former F1 driver warns McLaren is becoming "hard to stop" as Lando Norris fights for 2026 title
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes McLaren has become "hard to stop" in the 2026 championship as confidence grows within the team. Reigning champion Lando Norris heads into this weekend's Italian Grand Prix on the back of consecutive victories at the Hungarian and Dutch Grands Prix.

items.titleZh: 意大利大奖赛一练：勒克莱尔领跑法拉利包揽一二
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛第一次自由练习赛中，勒克莱尔以1分23.008秒位列榜首，法拉利包揽前二，主场作战取得令人鼓舞的开局。
items.titleEn: What happened in Italian GP first practice
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc topped first practice for the Italian Grand Prix at Monza with a 1m23.008s, leading a Ferrari one-two in an encouraging start at the team's home race.

items.titleZh: F1意大利大奖赛：勒克莱尔领跑法拉利一二带回FP1
items.summaryZh: F1意大利大奖赛第一次自由练习赛中，法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔以1分23秒008的中性胎最快圈速位居榜首，队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿紧随其后，法拉利一二带回。
items.titleEn: F1 Italian GP: Charles Leclerc leads Ferrari 1-2 in FP1
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc topped first free practice at the Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix with a 1m23.008s lap on medium tyres, leading a Ferrari 1-2 ahead of his team-mate Lewis Hamilton at Monza.

items.titleZh: Netflix发布迈克尔·舒马赫1994年F1纪录片预告片
items.summaryZh: Netflix发布了纪录片《舒马赫'94 - 传奇的诞生》的预告片，该片将于10月2日全球首映，聚焦迈克尔·舒马赫的首个F1世界冠军头衔。
items.titleEn: Netflix releases trailer for new Michael Schumacher 1994 F1 documentary
items.summaryEn: Netflix has released the trailer for its documentary "Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend", which will premiere globally on 2 October and focuses on Michael Schumacher's first F1 championship title.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔领跑汉密尔顿 法拉利升级后包揽意大利大奖赛一练前二
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛第一次自由练习赛中，查尔斯·勒克莱尔领先队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿，帮助法拉利包揽前二。法拉利在本站为主场赛事引入最新升级，表现令人印象深刻。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: Charles Leclerc leads Lewis Hamilton as Ferrari seal one-two in first Monza practice after revealing upgrades
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc led teammate Lewis Hamilton to give Ferrari a one-two finish in first practice for the Italian Grand Prix at Monza. Ferrari impressed after unveiling their latest upgrades for their home race.

items.titleZh: 国际上诉法院裁定维持处罚，加斯利失去摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联国际上诉法院裁定，皮埃尔·加斯利因维修区超速所受的处罚有效，其阿尔派车队的摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台成绩最终被取消。
items.titleEn: Pierre Gasly loses Monaco GP podium, FIA’s Court of Appeal rules
items.summaryEn: FIA's International Court of Appeal has ruled that Pierre Gasly's penalties for pitlane speeding stand, and the Alpine driver has lost his Monaco Grand Prix podium finish.

items.titleZh: 法院裁决后加斯利再次被剥夺摩纳哥领奖台
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利的两项五秒处罚被重新执行，他因此再度失去2026年摩纳哥大奖赛的领奖台成绩。
items.titleEn: Gasly stripped of Monaco podium after court decision
items.summaryEn: Alpine F1 driver Pierre Gasly has had his two five-second penalties reimposed and once again lost his 2026 Monaco Grand Prix podium finish.

items.titleZh: 加斯利再失摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台，迈凯伦与红牛上诉成功
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利在6月7日的摩纳哥大奖赛中获得第三名，但FIA国际上诉法庭裁定迈凯伦和红牛上诉成功，其两次因维修区超速所受的时间处罚被重新执行，红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔重新获得第三名。
items.titleEn: Pierre Gasly: Alpine driver loses Monaco GP podium for second time after McLaren, Red Bull win appeal
items.summaryEn: Alpine's Pierre Gasly lost his third-place finish at the Monaco Grand Prix after McLaren and Red Bull won their appeal at the FIA's International Court of Appeal, with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar reinstated to third.

items.titleZh: 本田新F1引擎仍需改进的关键领域
items.summaryZh: 继纽维为阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利站带来首次重大升级后，本田在赞德福特站推出了本赛季首个动力单元升级，此次升级完全专注于内燃机。
items.titleEn: The key area Honda still needs to improve with its new F1 engine
items.summaryEn: Following Adrian Newey's first major upgrade for Aston Martin in Hungary, Honda introduced its first power unit update of the season at Zandvoort, with the upgrade focused entirely on the internal combustion engine.

items.titleZh: 多梅尼卡利谈缩短比赛、冲刺赛及F1未来
items.summaryZh: F1首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利在蒙扎表示，F1不会停下脚步，未来将着眼于技术、赛历、制造商关系、冲刺赛及吸引更年轻观众。他强调F1面临的风险是变得自满。
items.titleEn: Stefano Domenicali on shortening races, sprints and F1’s future
items.summaryEn: At Monza, F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali said F1 will not stand still, with the future focused on technical development, the calendar, manufacturer relations, sprint races and attracting younger audiences. He stressed that the risk for F1 is becoming complacent.

items.titleZh: F1的5兆焦规则将导致蒙扎最高时速低于匈牙利站
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联将2026年新动力单元的可回收能量降至5兆焦，以尽量保持赛车在蒙扎全速行驶，但受能量管理要求影响，蒙扎的最高时速反而会低于匈牙利站。
items.titleEn: How F1’s 5MJ rule will lead to lower top speeds at Monza than in Hungary
items.summaryEn: The FIA has reduced recoverable energy to 5MJ under F1's new power unit rules to keep cars flat-out at Monza as much as possible, but the Italian circuit's top speeds in 2026 will still be lower than in Hungary.

items.titleZh: 安东内利为意大利大奖赛揭晓受瓦伦蒂诺·罗西启发的头盔设计
items.summaryZh: F1冠军领跑者安东内利为意大利大奖赛主场揭幕一款致敬MotoGP传奇瓦伦蒂诺·罗西的新头盔设计，灵感来自罗西2002年穆杰罗夺冠时的标志性头盔。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli unveils Valentino Rossi-inspired helmet for Italian GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli has revealed a striking new helmet design for his home Italian Grand Prix, paying homage to MotoGP legend Valentino Rossi. The design is inspired by the iconic helmet Rossi wore to victory at Mugello in 2002.

items.titleZh: F1车手预计蒙扎意大利大奖赛体验将“怪异”且“令人困惑”
items.summaryZh: F1车手们预计本周末在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛将是一次“怪异”、“令人困惑”且“不太美妙”的驾驶体验。2026年能量受限的新赛车将在蒙扎遭遇迄今最极端的挑战。
items.titleEn: Slower than Hungary? Why F1 drivers think Italian GP will be 'weird'
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 drivers expect this weekend's Italian Grand Prix at Monza to be a "weird", "confusing" and "not fantastic" driving experience. The energy-limited 2026 cars will face their most extreme challenge yet at the circuit.

items.titleZh: F1车队同意2027赛季将比赛距离从305公里缩短至290公里
items.summaryZh: F1车队已达成一致，计划从2027赛季起将比赛距离全面从305公里缩短至290公里，以应对新规则下燃油需求上升带来的问题。
items.titleEn: F1 teams agree plan to cut race distances for 2027
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 teams have agreed a plan to cut race distances from 305km to 290km across the board from 2027, in response to problems caused by increased fuel demand under upcoming rule changes.

items.titleZh: F1意大利大奖赛首日：引擎话题主导围场
items.summaryZh: F1意大利大奖赛首日，蒙扎作为最依赖引擎的赛道，引擎相关话题成为围场焦点，The 比赛团队整理了首日的主要发现。
items.titleEn: Everything we learned on day one at F1's Italian GP
items.summaryEn: On the opening day of the F1 Italian Grand Prix, engine-related topics dominated paddock conversations at Monza, the most engine-dependent circuit on the calendar, as The Race team gathered key takeaways from Thursday's activities.

items.titleZh: 哈斯车队意大利大奖赛引擎升级分配背后的尴尬处境
items.summaryZh: 由于法拉利升级版F1引擎供应有限，哈斯车队在意大利大奖赛只能让一名车手使用新引擎，最终决定由奥利·贝尔曼获得升级。
items.titleEn: What's behind Haas's uncomfortable engine upgrade split at Italian GP
items.summaryEn: Haas faced an unusual situation at the Italian Grand Prix as limited supply of Ferrari's upgraded F1 engine meant only one driver could use it, with Ollie Bearman ultimately chosen to receive the upgrade.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯解释创办自己车队的原因
items.summaryZh: F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯阐述了创办自己的赛车队和车手发展计划背后的逻辑。
items.titleEn: Why Norris has started his own racing team
items.summaryEn: F1 world champion Lando Norris has explained the reasoning behind setting up his own racing team and driver development programme.

items.titleZh: 安东内利：法拉利是不可思议的品牌，但我在梅赛德斯很开心
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛前淡化有关未来转投法拉利的猜测，表示自己明白这类猜测可能会长期存在，但他坚称自己在梅赛德斯仍有很多可以回馈。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli: Mercedes driver plays down speculation around future switch to Ferrari ahead of Italian GP
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli has played down speculation about a potential future switch to Ferrari ahead of the Italian GP, saying he understands such speculation may persist but insists he still has a lot to give back at Mercedes.

items.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁与本田公布2026-2027年F1研发计划
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁技术总监恩里科·卡迪莱在意大利大奖赛前透露，车队在匈牙利大奖赛推出的大型升级及荷兰大奖赛的后续优化，很可能将是2026赛季的最后一批研发，同时介绍了本赛季与2027赛季的发展规划。
items.titleEn: What's next for Aston Martin's and Honda's F1 development
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin's chief technical officer Enrico Cardile has revealed that the team's major Hungarian Grand Prix upgrade package and subsequent refinements at the Dutch GP look set to be its final developments of the 2026 F1 season, outlining plans for this season and 2027.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿：希望成为首位在意大利为法拉利夺冠的黑人车手
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在本周末意大利大奖赛前表示，他一直在思考可能成为首位为法拉利在意大利赢得胜利的黑人F1车手的意义。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton shares thoughts about possibility of becoming first black Ferrari driver to win in Italy ahead of Italian GP
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said ahead of this weekend's Italian Grand Prix that he has been reflecting on the significance of potentially becoming the first black Ferrari driver to win in Italy.

items.titleZh: 安东内利将在意大利大奖赛排位赛中协助受罚的拉塞尔
items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利表示，他准备在意大利大奖赛排位赛中帮助梅赛德斯队友兼冠军竞争对手乔治·拉塞尔，因为世界冠军领跑者拉塞尔因引擎罚退将从最后一位发车。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: Kimi Antonelli to help Mercedes team-mate George Russell in Monza qualifying due to engine grid penalty
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli says he is ready to help his Mercedes team-mate and title rival George Russell in qualifying at the Italian Grand Prix, as the championship leader will start at the back of the grid due to an engine penalty.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿驾驶稀有法拉利F40抵达意大利大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在意大利大奖赛期间驾驶一辆罕见的法拉利F40抵达，并透露该车的发动机缸径与他的赛车号码相同。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: Lewis Hamilton arrives in rare Ferrari F40!
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton arrived at the Italian Grand Prix in a rare Ferrari F40 and revealed that the car's engine bore the same number as his racing number.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯称迈凯伦在蒙扎排位赛争夺中“挣扎”
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示，迈凯伦车队在蒙扎排位赛中“只是挣扎”，并认为车队无法争夺杆位。
items.titleEn: F1 Italian GP LIVE: Friday Practice updates, results, stream, highlights from Formula 1 race weekend at Monza
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris said McLaren were "just struggling" in qualifying at Monza and believes the team cannot fight for pole position.

items.titleZh: 米兰法拉利粉丝盛会：汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔获热烈欢迎
items.summaryZh: 在米兰举行的House of Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0%活动中，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔受到法拉利车迷的热烈欢迎，现场人群聚集为两位F1明星欢呼。
items.titleEn: Formula 1: Ferrari fans flock to Peroni event to cheer on Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc received a big reception from Ferrari fans who gathered in Milan at a House of Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% event to cheer on the two F1 stars.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯透露在续约迈凯伦前有其他“机会”
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯透露，在签署新合同留在迈凯伦至2030年底之前，他还有其他机会。天空体育F1的马丁·布伦德尔在意大利大奖赛周末前采访了他，讨论新合同与车手年度冠军争夺。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris reveals other 'opportunities' before signing new McLaren contract ahead of Italian Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris has revealed he had other opportunities before signing a new contract keeping him at McLaren until the end of 2030. Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle interviewed him ahead of the Italian Grand Prix about the deal and the title race.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯成立初级单座方程式车队LN4 Fusion，2027年参赛
items.summaryZh: 现任F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯宣布联合创立新的单座方程式车队LN4 Fusion，车队将于2027年正式参赛。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris: F1 world champion launches new junior single-seater team LN4 Fusion ahead of 2027 racing debut
items.summaryEn: Reigning F1 world champion Lando Norris has announced the launch and co-founding of LN4 Fusion, a new single-seater racing team that will make its racing debut in 2027.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿对法拉利主场作战充满希望，车队确认意大利大奖赛引擎升级
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿希望法拉利能在主场蒙扎的意大利大奖赛上争夺胜利，本周末他和勒克莱尔将使用升级后的新引擎。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: Lewis Hamilton hopeful Ferrari can fight for Monza win as team confirm engine upgrade for home race
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton hopes Ferrari can fight for a win at their home Italian Grand Prix at Monza, where he and Charles Leclerc will run upgraded new engines this weekend.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔因手腕伤势未愈缺席意大利大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队确认，伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕伤势尚未康复，将缺席本周末的意大利大奖赛。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar to miss Italian Grand Prix with wrist injury as Liam Lawson gets another Red Bull opportunity at Monza
items.summaryEn: Red Bull have confirmed that Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Italian Grand Prix as he has not yet recovered from his wrist injury.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿、拉塞尔或诺里斯能否在蒙扎抓住争冠机会？
items.summaryZh: 积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利因发车处罚几乎肯定无法在意大利大奖赛争夺胜利，这给追赶他的三位英国车手带来了重大机会。
items.titleEn: Italian GP: Will Lewis Hamilton, George Russell or Lando Norris seize title-race opening due to Kimi Antonelli grid penalties
items.summaryEn: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli is highly unlikely to contend for victory at the Italian Grand Prix due to grid penalties, giving his three British title rivals a major opportunity.

items.titleZh: 哈基宁警告：车队指令将遭车迷“钉上十字架”
items.summaryZh: 两届世界冠军米卡·哈基宁警告，若F1车队在2026年冠军争夺中使用车队指令，可能被车迷“钉上十字架”。
items.titleEn: F1 fans will 'crucify' teams if team orders are used in 2026 title battle, says former world champion Mika Hakkinen
items.summaryEn: Two-time world champion Mika Hakkinen has warned that Formula 1 teams could be 'crucified' by fans if they use team orders to influence the 2026 title battle.

items.titleZh: 安东内利为何在蒙扎主场受罚？
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利将在周日的意大利大奖赛上从队尾发车，很可能无法在主场争夺胜利，并可能在积分榜上损失位置。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli: Why is Mercedes driver taking grid penalties at Italian Grand Prix in Monza on home soil?
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli will start from the back of the grid in Sunday's Italian Grand Prix, making it very unlikely he can fight for a win on home soil, and he could lose ground in the championship this weekend.

items.titleZh: F1赛历最新：中国大奖赛成2027赛季揭幕战热门备选
items.summaryZh: 据The 比赛报道，如果2027赛季无法在巴林和沙特阿拉伯揭幕，中国大奖赛已成为揭幕战的主要备选方案。
items.titleEn: F1 calendar latest: New back-up plan for 2027 season opener
items.summaryEn: According to The Race, the Chinese Grand Prix has emerged as a leading option to open the 2027 F1 season if starting in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia is not possible.

items.titleZh: 劳森：荷兰站红牛首秀比2025年更适应赛车
items.summaryZh: 红牛替补车手利亚姆·劳森表示，虽然无法将小红牛22与他此前驾驶的红牛赛车直接比较，但他感觉这次荷兰大奖赛出场比2025年首次代表红牛参赛时更舒适。
items.titleEn: Liam Lawson got more comfortable at Red Bull in Dutch GP outing than during his 2025 stint
items.summaryEn: Red Bull stand-in Liam Lawson says that although it is impossible to compare the current RB22 with the car he drove previously for the team, he felt much more comfortable than during his first stint in 2025.

items.titleZh: 《疾速争胜》第九季确认回归 记录2026赛季
items.summaryZh: Netflix正式确认F1纪录片《疾速争胜》将回归第九季，记录2026赛季，但目前尚未公布具体剧集内容。
items.titleEn: "Drive to Survive" Season 9: The biggest F1 stories Netflix could cover
items.summaryEn: Netflix has officially confirmed that its Formula 1 docuseries Drive to Survive will return for a ninth season, documenting the ongoing 2026 championship. Details of the episodes have not yet been announced.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯：荷兰大奖赛晚段车队指令旨在帮助拉塞尔
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林表示，车队在荷兰大奖赛中使用车队指令，要求拉塞尔让队友安东内利通过，以帮助拉塞尔最终守住赞德沃特第三名。
items.titleEn: Mercedes: Late Dutch GP team orders were to help George Russell
items.summaryEn: Mercedes trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin says the team used team orders during the Dutch Grand Prix, asking George Russell to let teammate Kimi Antonelli through. Russell went on to hold on to third place at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: F3积分领先者：新F1西班牙大奖赛赛道“令人难以置信”
items.summaryZh: 三级方程式锦标赛积分领先者弗雷迪·斯莱特在马德里新赛道测试后，称其驾驶体验“令人难以令人”。马德里将在2026年取代巴塞罗那成为西班牙大奖赛举办地。
items.titleEn: F3 points leader: New F1 Spanish GP venue "incredible" to drive after test
items.summaryEn: Formula 3 championship leader Freddie Slater has labelled the new Madrid circuit as "incredible" to drive after testing at the Spanish venue. Madrid will replace Barcelona as host of the Spanish Grand Prix in 2026.

items.titleZh: 红牛期待F1研发生命线，FIA新ADUO决定在即
items.summaryZh: F1第二个额外研发与升级机会阶段已在匈牙利大奖赛后结束，但第一阶段结果尚未正式公布。摩纳哥大奖赛周末各制造商已在幕后获悉结果，红牛-福特动力总成意外排名靠前。
items.titleEn: Red Bull hopes for F1 development lifeline as FIA's new ADUO decision looms
items.summaryEn: The second ADUO period in Formula 1 has ended after the Hungarian Grand Prix, yet the results of the first period remain unannounced. During the Monaco race weekend, all manufacturers were informed behind the scenes, with Red Bull-Ford Powertrains surprisingly ranked at the top.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔质疑法拉利荷兰站进站策略
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛上，勒克莱尔质疑法拉利在第43圈末的进站决定，认为这让他失去了争夺领奖台的机会，最终仅获第五名。
items.titleEn: Did Ferrari strategy cost Leclerc a podium at Zandvoort?
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc questioned Ferrari's pitstop at the end of lap 43 in the Dutch Grand Prix, believing the call cost him a shot at the podium as he finished fifth. He said the early stop left him unable to fight George Russell for third in the closing stages.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿为法拉利无线电愤怒道歉："那不是最好的我"
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿为在荷兰大奖赛期间通过车队无线电向法拉利爆发沮丧情绪而道歉，表示那"不是最好的我"。他在比赛后半段因缺乏策略更新、尤其是被队友夏尔·勒克莱尔挡在身后而愈发不满。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton apologises for Ferrari radio fury: "That wasn’t the best version of me"
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton has apologised to Ferrari for his frustration boiling over on team radio during the Dutch Grand Prix, saying it "wasn't the best version of me". He grew increasingly frustrated in the second half of the race, especially when stuck behind team-mate Charles Leclerc.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯为何难以快速推出媲美迈凯伦的升级
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯表示正在开发一项重大升级以应对迈凯伦等对手带来的威胁，但承认在此之前将面临艰难的战斗。车队领队托托·沃尔夫指出预算上限限制了车队的研发灵活性。
items.titleEn: Why Mercedes can't fast-track McLaren-matching upgrades
items.summaryEn: Mercedes says it has a major update in development to fight back against rivals like McLaren, but admits it faces a tough battle until then, with team boss Toto Wolff citing cost cap limits on further development.

items.titleZh: “公平与诚信”面临考验，FIA将就摩纳哥争议做出裁决
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦领队安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，车队就摩纳哥大奖赛成绩提出上诉是出于对“运动诚信”的担忧。周二国际汽联国际上诉法院将审理迈凯伦与红牛对6月摩纳哥大奖赛成绩的上诉。
items.titleEn: “Fairness and integrity” of F1 at stake as FIA set to rule on Monaco controversy
items.summaryEn: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said the team's appeal against the Monaco Grand Prix result stems from concern for "the integrity of the sport". On Tuesday, the FIA's International Court of Appeal will hear appeals by McLaren and Red Bull against June's Monaco Grand Prix result.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘将参加“世界最大卡丁车赛”挑战100名车手
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘将于9月16日在银石赛道的专用卡丁车赛道参加被称为“世界最大卡丁车赛”的比赛，从最后一位发车，与100名车手同场竞技。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen to face 100 drivers in ‘world’s biggest kart race’
items.summaryEn: Four-time F1 champion Max Verstappen will compete in what is billed as the world's biggest kart race on 16 September, taking on 100 drivers on a purpose-built kart layout at Silverstone. Starting from the back of the grid, the Red Bull driver will be tasked with overtaking all 100 rivals before time runs out.

items.titleZh: FIA就科拉平托荷兰大奖赛处罚引发的网络辱骂探讨法律选项
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联谴责针对F1赛事干事的网络骚扰，此前干事在赞德福特对阿尔派车手弗兰科·科拉平托和小红牛车手阿维德·林德布拉德处以双黄旗下超车的通过维修区处罚，FIA表示正在探讨法律选项。
items.titleEn: FIA exploring legal options over abuse against F1 stewards following Franco Colapinto's Dutch GP penalty
items.summaryEn: The FIA has condemned online harassment directed at its F1 stewards after they penalised Alpine's Franco Colapinto and Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad for overtaking under double-waved yellow flags at Zandvoort, and says it is exploring legal options.

items.titleZh: 乔治·拉塞尔：兰多·诺里斯在赞德福特这类赛道总是很强
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔表示，兰多·诺里斯在长弯道和高轮胎磨损的赛道上“一直是个专家”，因此对迈凯伦车手在匈牙利和荷兰连续获胜并不感到惊讶。
items.titleEn: George Russell: “Specialist” Lando Norris always strong at tracks like Zandvoort
items.summaryEn: George Russell says Lando Norris has "always been a bit of a specialist" at circuits with long corners and high tyre degradation, so he wasn't surprised to see the McLaren driver take back-to-back wins in Hungary and the Netherlands.

items.titleZh: 红牛引擎升级决定在即，意大利大奖赛前将揭晓
items.summaryZh: FIA预计本周内公布对F1动力单元制造商第二轮ADUO分析结果，红牛将在意大利大奖赛前得知其引擎能否在赛季末前进行升级。
items.titleEn: What's at stake for Red Bull as engine decision approaches
items.summaryEn: The FIA is expected to announce this week the findings of its second round of ADUO analysis, and Red Bull will learn before the Italian Grand Prix whether its F1 engine can be upgraded before the end of the season.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格：维斯塔潘幸运避免荷兰大奖赛连环撞车
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘在荷兰大奖赛首圈撞车中很幸运，没有引发多车连环相撞。维斯塔潘在湿滑条件下于主场首圈发生严重撞车，比赛出示红旗，他的比赛提前结束。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen was "lucky" to avoid Dutch GP pile-up, says Nico Rosberg
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg said Max Verstappen was fortunate not to trigger a multi-car pile-up in his opening-lap crash at the Dutch Grand Prix. Verstappen crashed heavily on the first lap in damp conditions, bringing out the red flag and ending his race early.

items.titleZh: 兰多·诺里斯：我正在消除F1弱点，且弱点已不多
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示，相比2025年夺冠赛季，他今年在F1赛场内外的表现都更加出色。这位迈凯伦卫冕世界冠军刚在匈牙利和赞德福特连续两站拿下杆位和胜利。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris: I’m eliminating my F1 weaknesses, and I don’t have so many
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris says he is performing better both on and off the track in F1 this year compared to his title-winning 2025 campaign. The reigning world champion just took pole and victory in back-to-back rounds at Hungary and Zandvoort for McLaren.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里困惑于与诺里斯的圈速差距
items.summaryZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里坦言不解为何难以发挥迈凯伦赛车性能，而队友兰多·诺里斯凭借大幅升级的MCL40连续两站杆位夺冠。
items.titleEn: Oscar Piastri confused by pace deficit to Lando Norris in F1 2026
items.summaryEn: Oscar Piastri is puzzled by his inability to maximise the McLaren package, while team-mate Lando Norris has won the last two grands prix from pole in a heavily upgraded MCL40.

items.titleZh: 网飞续订《F1：极速求生》第九季
items.summaryZh: 网飞正式确认幕后纪录片《F1：极速求生》将回归第九季，内容将涵盖正在进行的2026赛季。
items.titleEn: Netflix renews "Formula 1: Drive to Survive" for season 9
items.summaryEn: Netflix has officially confirmed that its behind-the-scenes docuseries Formula 1: Drive to Survive will return for a ninth season, covering the ongoing 2026 season.

items.titleZh: “请给我打电话！”——角田裕毅在荷兰大奖赛表现出色后俏皮地请求重返F1
items.summaryZh: 角田裕毅在赞德沃特以第11名完赛后，半开玩笑地向各车队发出呼吁，希望能在2027年重返F1车手席位。他表示自己已经用这个成绩尽力提升了回归的机会。
items.titleEn: "Call me, please!" – Yuki Tsunoda makes cheeky F1 return pitch after impressive Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda finished 11th at Zandvoort and said he did everything he could to boost his chances of returning to the F1 grid, making a tongue-in-cheek appeal to teams for 2027.

items.titleZh: 埃德·斯特劳发布2026荷兰大奖赛F1车手排名
items.summaryZh: The 比赛的埃德·斯特劳根据荷兰大奖赛表现发布车手排名，冲刺赛赛制、赞德福特赛道布局与赛前降雨对全体车手构成考验。
items.titleEn: Edd Straw's 2026 Dutch Grand Prix F1 driver rankings
items.summaryEn: Edd Straw of The Race has published his driver rankings from the Dutch Grand Prix, where the sprint format, the Zandvoort layout and pre-race rain tested the entire Formula 1 field.

items.titleZh: 红牛对劳森在荷兰大奖赛的表现印象深刻：'他做到了他能做的'
items.summaryZh: 红牛F1车队负责人劳伦特·梅基斯称赞利亚姆·劳森在荷兰大奖赛中最大限度发挥了赛车潜力。这位24岁车手从第八位发车，以第七名完赛。
items.titleEn: Red Bull impressed by Liam Lawson at Dutch GP: 'He did what he could'
items.summaryEn: Red Bull F1 boss Laurent Mekies praised Liam Lawson for maximising what was possible at the Dutch Grand Prix. The 24-year-old started eighth and finished seventh.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔无视两次进站指令，阻挡汉密尔顿
items.summaryZh: 法拉利车队在同一圈内两次要求查尔斯·勒克莱尔进站，但他选择不进站，导致刘易斯·汉密尔顿被阻挡的时间比车队预期的更长。
items.titleEn: Leclerc failed to obey two orders to pit while he held Hamilton up
items.summaryEn: Ferrari asked Charles Leclerc to pit twice on the same lap, but he chose not to, causing Lewis Hamilton to be held up longer than the team expected.

items.titleZh: 詹姆斯·沃尔斯称威廉姆斯F1重建为“人生之旅”
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯表示，带领车队重返F1顶级竞争水平将成为他的“人生之旅”。
items.titleEn: James Vowles calls Williams F1 rebuild his "life's journey"
items.summaryEn: Williams team principal James Vowles has declared that returning the Grove outfit to the required competitive level in Formula 1 will become his "life's journey".

items.titleZh: 霍肯伯格谈荷兰大奖赛避过与队友博尔托莱托的惊险事故
items.summaryZh: 奥迪F1车手尼科·霍肯伯格表示，他与队友加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托在荷兰大奖赛起步时的"可怕"事故是运气与判断的结合，他成功避免了一场灾难性碰撞。
items.titleEn: How Nico Hulkenberg avoided a massive shunt with Audi team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto
items.summaryEn: Audi Formula 1 driver Nico Hulkenberg says his "scary" incident with team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto at the start of the Dutch Grand Prix was a combination of luck and judgement, as the German avoided a disastrous accident.

items.titleZh: 布伦德尔：汉密尔顿荷兰大奖赛无线电发泄情绪完全合理
items.summaryZh: 亚历克斯·布伦德尔认为，刘易斯·汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛期间通过车队无线电发泄沮丧情绪完全合理。这位七届世界冠军在赞德福特赛道以第四名完赛，错失领奖台。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton "entirely justified" in tense Dutch GP radio exchange, says Alex Brundle
items.summaryEn: Alex Brundle believes Lewis Hamilton was fully justified in venting his frustration over team radio during the Dutch Grand Prix. The seven-time champion finished fourth at Zandvoort, narrowly missing out on a podium.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索荷兰大奖赛积分完赛 被车迷誉为“真正的GOAT”
items.summaryZh: 两届F1世界冠军费尔南多·阿隆索在荷兰大奖赛从第18位冲至第9位积分完赛，被车迷誉为“史上最伟大车手”（GOAT）。
items.titleEn: Fernando Alonso hailed as "actual GOAT" after F1 Dutch GP: "Just a machine"
items.summaryEn: Two-time F1 champion Fernando Alonso has been hailed as the GOAT by fans after charging from 18th to ninth for a points finish at the Dutch Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯称资金不足难与对手升级竞争
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1车队领队托托·沃尔夫表示，车队“没有足够的资金”像迈凯伦和法拉利那样大力研发2026年赛车。迈凯伦和法拉利近期通过大量升级取得显著进步，而梅赛德斯自5月加拿大大奖赛后升级保守，竞争力相对落后。
items.titleEn: Mercedes "hasn't got the money" to keep up with rival teams' F1 upgrades
items.summaryEn: Mercedes Formula 1 team principal Toto Wolff says his squad "hasn't got the money" to develop its 2026 car as much as McLaren and Ferrari are doing. Both rivals have made significant progress through upgrades, while Mercedes' more conservative plan since May's Canadian Grand Prix has eroded its initial dominance.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫：梅赛德斯资金不足，难以跟上迈凯伦和法拉利升级步伐
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫表示，车队没有足够的资金像迈凯伦和法拉利那样大力研发2026年赛车。对手近期通过大量升级取得显著进步，而梅赛德斯的升级策略更为保守。
items.titleEn: Mercedes "hasn't got the money" to keep up with rival F1 upgrades
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff says the team does not have enough budget to develop its 2026 car as intensively as McLaren and Ferrari. Both rivals have made significant progress through major upgrades, while Mercedes has taken a more conservative approach.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯不同意安东内利和拉塞尔对F1实力排名的看法
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯不同意基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔关于迈凯伦目前拥有F1最好赛车的说法，他认为近期取胜更多归功于自己的驾驶。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris disagrees with Kimi Antonelli and George Russell on F1's pecking order
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris has disagreed with Kimi Antonelli and George Russell's claim that McLaren now has the best car in F1, arguing that his driving is making the difference. The reigning world champion won the last two grands prix from pole after a heavily upgraded MCL40 went winless in the first 10 rounds.

items.titleZh: 法拉利解释汉密尔顿荷兰大奖赛无线电爆发：并非实验品
items.summaryZh: 法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦塞尔澄清了刘易斯·汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛期间无线电爆发的原因。法拉利连续第二场比赛未能登上领奖台，汉密尔顿获得第四，队友夏尔·勒克莱尔第五。
items.titleEn: What Ferrari actually meant to do when Hamilton felt like a "guinea pig" in Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team boss Fred Vasseur has clarified what led to Lewis Hamilton's radio outbursts during a tough Dutch Grand Prix weekend for the Formula 1 outfit. The Scuderia finished off the podium for a second consecutive race as Hamilton took fourth with team-mate Charles Leclerc in fifth.

items.titleZh: 赞德福特赛道完美告别：荷兰大奖赛我们学到了什么
items.summaryZh: 赞德福特赛道（暂时）为F1献上了一场精彩的告别战，荷兰大奖赛在领跑集团充满真正的悬念，并出现了一些可能影响后续分站的车队积分榜意外变化。
items.titleEn: Everything we learned from F1's Dutch Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: Zandvoort enjoyed a great Formula 1 send-off (for now) as the Dutch Grand Prix delivered genuine intrigue at the front and some surprising championship developments that could echo through the coming races.

items.titleZh: 法拉利澄清汉密尔顿“小白鼠”言论背后的真实意图
items.summaryZh: 法拉利领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔解释了刘易斯·汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛期间无线电爆发的原因。法拉利连续第二场比赛未能登上领奖台，汉密尔顿获得第四，队友夏尔·勒克莱尔第五。
items.titleEn: What Ferrari actually meant to do when Lewis Hamilton felt like a "guinea pig"
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team boss Fred Vasseur has explained what led to Lewis Hamilton's radio outbursts during a tough Dutch Grand Prix weekend. Ferrari failed to reach the podium for a second consecutive race, with Hamilton fourth and teammate Charles Leclerc fifth.

items.titleZh: 加斯利警告小红牛：他们毁了我们的比赛，我不会忘记
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利将他在荷兰大奖赛正赛的失望成绩归咎于小红牛车队的战术，两队正在车队积分榜上激烈竞争。他在赞德福特赛道表现出色，冲刺赛排位第八并第八名完赛，但正赛仅从第11位发车。
items.titleEn: Pierre Gasly’s warning to Racing Bulls: ‘They ruined our race, and I won’t forget it’
items.summaryEn: Alpine driver Pierre Gasly blamed Racing Bulls' tactics for his disappointing result in the Dutch Grand Prix, as the two teams battle closely in the constructors' championship. He impressed at Zandvoort by qualifying and finishing eighth in the sprint, but started the main race only 11th.

items.titleZh: F1车迷需要更少的冲刺赛，而非更多
items.summaryZh: 荷兰大奖赛周六阿姆斯特丹铁路故障可能导致数千车迷错过冲刺赛，但作者认为这或许是好事，并批评冲刺赛数量过多的趋势。
items.titleEn: Why F1 fans need fewer sprints, not more
items.summaryEn: Technical problems on Amsterdam's train network during Dutch Grand Prix weekend risked leaving thousands of fans unable to attend the sprint, but the author argues this may be a blessing because F1 needs fewer sprint races rather than more.

items.titleZh: 安东内利因更换动力单元将在意大利大奖赛垫底发车
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯已正式决定，其F1世界冠军领跑者基米·安东内利将在即将到来的意大利大奖赛上从最后一位发车，因为车队决定为他更换新的动力单元，超出了他本赛季的配额。
items.titleEn: Antonelli set for Italian GP grid penalty
items.summaryEn: Mercedes has officially decided that its Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli will start from the back of the grid at the upcoming Italian Grand Prix after deciding to give him a new power unit, exceeding his allowance for the year.

items.titleZh: 斯特罗尔要求处罚贝尔曼和博尔托莱托闯红灯出站
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛中，兰斯·斯特罗尔注意到贝尔曼和博尔托莱托在维修区出口闯红灯，要求赛事控制中心对他们进行处罚，但赛事干事仅对两人进行了训诫。
items.titleEn: Stroll demanded penalties after Bearman and Bortoleto passed red pit exit light
items.summaryEn: During the Dutch Grand Prix, Lance Stroll noticed Oliver Bearman and Gabriel Bortoleto passing a red light at the pit lane exit and urged race control to penalise them, but the stewards only issued reprimands to the two drivers.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯确认安东内利蒙扎将受罚退后发车
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯决定为基米·安东内利更换全新动力单元，超出赛季配额，他将在主场意大利大奖赛从队尾发车。
items.titleEn: Mercedes confirms Kimi Antonelli grid penalty in Monza
items.summaryEn: Mercedes has decided to give Kimi Antonelli a new power unit exceeding his season allowance, meaning the championship leader will start from the back of the grid at his home Italian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 谁昨晚睡得最差：奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里
items.summaryZh: 2025年8月31日，皮亚斯特里在赞德福特赢得荷兰大奖赛，诺里斯因机油泄漏退赛，赛后表示只想“吃个汉堡然后回家”，当时他落后皮亚斯特里34分。
items.titleEn: Who slept worst last night: Oscar Piastri
items.summaryEn: On 31 August 2025, Oscar Piastri won the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort while Lando Norris retired with an oil leak and said he just wanted to "grab a burger and go home", leaving him 34 points behind in the championship.

items.titleZh: 劳森在红牛第三场比赛证明自己：赞德福特站表现符合期望
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森在红牛车队的第三场比赛表现符合车队期望，排位赛紧随马克斯·维斯塔潘之后，正赛无重大失误并最终获得积分。但这场比赛并非2025年4月的铃鹿站，而是约17个月后的赞德福特站。
items.titleEn: Who slept best last night: Liam Lawson
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson's third race at Red Bull was exactly what the team wanted: solid qualifying right behind Max Verstappen, no big mistakes, strong race pace and points. However, that third race was not Suzuka in April 2025, but Zandvoort some 17 months later.

items.titleZh: 前F1车手：拉塞尔在梅赛德斯压力下“仍未达标”
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手、F1 TV分析师乔利恩·帕尔默认为，荷兰大奖赛后乔治·拉塞尔在梅赛德斯感受到压力，与队友基米·安东内利相比“仍未达标”。梅赛德斯在赞德沃特收获双领奖台，但比赛末段让拉塞尔给安东内利让位的车队指令引发热议。
items.titleEn: George Russell "still not there" as Mercedes pressure builds after Dutch GP, says former F1 driver
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver and F1 TV analyst Jolyon Palmer believes George Russell is feeling the heat at Mercedes, saying the Briton is "still not there" compared to team-mate Kimi Antonelli after the Dutch Grand Prix. Mercedes secured a double podium at Zandvoort, but the late team order asking Russell to yield position to Antonelli became a major talking point.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯称缺乏资金升级2026赛车，难追迈凯伦开发步伐
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯表示因资金不足，无法通过紧急升级回应迈凯伦的强势复苏，难以跟上对手的开发速度。迈凯伦在匈牙利和荷兰大奖赛分两阶段引入的升级效果显著，兰多·诺里斯在荷兰大奖赛凭借节奏和更好的轮胎管理超越起步领先安东内利，取得赛季两连胜。
items.titleEn: Mercedes' extraordinary reason for not upgrading its F1 car
items.summaryEn: Mercedes says it cannot respond to McLaren's F1 resurgence with an urgent upgrade because it hasn't got the money for extra developments. McLaren's two-stage upgrade across the Hungarian and Dutch Grands Prix proved decisive, as Lando Norris's pace and superior tyre management allowed him to overhaul early leader Kimi Antonelli and claim his second consecutive victory.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛混乱中的赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 周六冲刺赛表现平淡令人担忧荷兰大奖赛会沉闷收场，但周日赛前一场突如其来的阵雨在赞德沃特赛道制造混乱，为比赛增添了戏剧性。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from F1's chaotic Dutch Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: After a dull sprint on Saturday raised fears of an anticlimactic Dutch Grand Prix, a sudden shower one hour before Sunday's race caused enough chaos at Zandvoort to add drama. Although the rain did not persist into the race, it made the track slippery and led to carnage at the end of lap 1.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔为让安东内利升至第二的“公平”决定辩护
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔表示，让队友兼冠军竞争对手安东内利超过自己是正确的决定，这符合他的比赛利益。
items.titleEn: Russell defends “fair” decision to let Antonelli into second place
items.summaryEn: George Russell said letting his team mate and championship rival overtake him was the correct decision which minimised the risk to their races.

items.titleZh: 安东内利称额外进站也让拉塞尔面临风险
items.summaryZh: 安东内利表示，荷兰大奖赛上他的额外进站可能并非正确决定，这一策略也让队友拉塞尔面临风险。
items.titleEn: Antonelli says extra pit stop “put George at risk” too
items.summaryEn: Antonelli said his extra pit stop at the Dutch Grand Prix may not have been the right decision, and that the strategy also put his team mate Russell at risk.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯为何说“我没有一辆能争冠的车”？
items.summaryZh: 尽管连续赢下两场大奖赛，诺里斯仍表示自己缺乏争冠所需的赛车，认为迈凯伦MCL40只在高速弯强势，低速弯劣势明显，赛季剩余比赛会很艰难。
items.titleEn: What makes Norris say “I don't have a car to fight for the championship”?
items.summaryEn: Despite winning two consecutive grands prix, Lando Norris insists he lacks the car needed to fight for the championship, saying the McLaren MCL40 is only strong in high-speed corners while its slow-corner weakness makes the rest of the season very tough.

items.titleZh: 兰多·诺里斯：我的赛车不足以争夺F1冠军
items.summaryZh: 尽管连续两场大奖赛夺冠，兰多·诺里斯仍表示对自己在剩余比赛中争夺F1世界冠军没有信心。2026赛季出现了无人愿意承认自己拥有最好赛车的有趣局面。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris: I don't have a car to fight for the F1 title
items.summaryEn: Despite two consecutive grand prix wins, Lando Norris insists he is not confident about fighting for the F1 world championship in the remaining races. The 2026 season presents a curious situation where nobody is willing to admit they have the best car.

items.titleZh: FIA解释荷兰大奖赛安全车编队圈决定，回应车手批评
items.summaryZh: 荷兰大奖赛发车程序期间开始下雨导致开局混乱，多名车手批评安全车编队圈后轮胎升温不足，FIA以安全为由解释了这一决定。
items.titleEn: FIA explains safety car formation lap after F1 driver criticism at Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: The opening stages of the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort descended into chaos after rain began during the grid procedure, and the FIA explained that the safety car formation lap was chosen on safety grounds after drivers criticised insufficient tyre warm-up before the standing start.

items.titleZh: “毫无意义”——F1车手质疑荷兰大奖赛安全车编队圈
items.summaryZh: 在赞德沃特举行的F1荷兰大奖赛因发车程序期间开始下雨而陷入混乱，多名车手认为在安全车后无法充分为轮胎升温。维斯塔潘在第一圈最后一个弯道出口处严重撞车，并承认这完全是自己的失误。
items.titleEn: "It made no sense" – F1 drivers question safety car formation lap after early Dutch GP chaos
items.summaryEn: The opening stages of the Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort descended into chaos after rain began to fall during the grid procedure, with several drivers saying they could not warm their tyres sufficiently behind the safety car. Max Verstappen crashed heavily on the exit of the final corner on the opening lap and admitted it was entirely his own mistake.

items.titleZh: 安东内利：梅赛德斯“显然”不再是F1最强车队
items.summaryZh: F1冠军领跑者基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛获得亚军后表示，梅赛德斯“显然”不再拥有最快的赛车。迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯凭借大幅升级的MCL40从杆位发车并连续获胜。
items.titleEn: Mercedes "clearly" not F1's best team anymore - Kimi Antonelli
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli reckons Mercedes "clearly" no longer boasts the fastest car after finishing runner-up to Lando Norris at the Dutch Grand Prix. McLaren's Lando Norris has won consecutively from pole thanks to the heavily upgraded MCL40.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿：法拉利战术失误让我失去第三名
items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛后表示，法拉利未及时使用车队指令导致他损失时间，最终仅获第四，错失第三名。他认为这不是运气不佳，并指出梅赛德斯在执行车队指令上更果断。
items.titleEn: “We weren’t unlucky”: Hamilton tells Ferrari their tactics cost him third place
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said after the Dutch Grand Prix that Ferrari's failure to use team orders in time cost him time and a chance to finish third, leaving him fourth. He insisted it was not bad luck and pointed out that Mercedes executes team orders more decisively.

items.titleZh: 法拉利车队指令引争议 汉密尔顿不满赞德福特站执行
items.summaryZh: 荷兰大奖赛期间，刘易斯·汉密尔顿因被队友勒克莱尔阻挡而愈发沮丧，并公开批评法拉利的比赛执行，将其与梅赛德斯的策略安排作对比。
items.titleEn: Mercedes contrast worsens Hamilton's team order frustration
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton grew increasingly frustrated with Ferrari's execution at the Dutch Grand Prix, criticising how the team handled race strategy compared to Mercedes' approach.

items.titleZh: 科拉平托与赞助商高管抨击FIA干事在荷兰大奖赛的处罚
items.summaryZh: F1荷兰大奖赛发车时，阿尔派车手科拉平托因黄旗下违规被FIA干事处罚，他本人及主赞助商美客多高管均对此表达强烈不满。
items.titleEn: Franco Colapinto and Mercado Libre executive hit out at FIA stewards after Dutch GP penalties
items.summaryEn: Alpine driver Franco Colapinto was penalised by FIA stewards for an infringement under yellow flags at the start of the Dutch Grand Prix, drawing strong criticism from both the Argentine driver and a senior executive of his main sponsor Mercado Libre.

items.titleZh: F1最后一届荷兰大奖赛赢家与输家盘点
items.summaryZh: 在最后一届一级方程式荷兰大奖赛中，诺里斯以明显优势夺冠，为目前数学上仍不乐观的车手总冠军争夺注入了希望。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from F1's 2026 Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: In the last-ever Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix, Lando Norris dominated the field, breathing life into a title bid that still does not make much mathematical sense yet.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯夺冠与梅赛德斯车队指令：我们的评判
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛后，The 比赛评估了诺里斯和迈凯伦连续夺冠对F1冠军争夺的意义，并讨论了梅赛德斯让拉塞尔为安东内利让车的车队指令是否正确。
items.titleEn: Our verdict on Norris's win and Mercedes team orders
items.summaryEn: After the Dutch Grand Prix, The Race assessed what back-to-back wins for Lando Norris and McLaren mean for F1's title fight and discussed whether Mercedes was right to order George Russell to let Kimi Antonelli pass.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯解释与阿尔本碰撞的“公平”处罚：“最糟糕的结果”
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛赞德福特赛道，塞恩斯因与威廉姆斯队友阿尔本发生碰撞被罚时10秒，他表示承担责任并称处罚“公平”。
items.titleEn: Carlos Sainz explains "fair" penalty for Alex Albon contact: "The worst possible outcome"
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz accepted responsibility for contact with his Williams team-mate Alex Albon at Zandvoort, which earned him a nominal 10-second penalty, and called the punishment "fair".

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯双雄为荷兰站撞车道歉，塞恩斯被罚10秒
items.summaryZh: 荷兰大奖赛期间，威廉姆斯车队的塞恩斯与阿尔本发生碰撞，导致阿尔本退赛。双方均为此道歉，赛会干事认定塞恩斯负全责并对其处以10秒罚时。
items.titleEn: Williams pair apologise for crash: ‘It’s not a Verstappen-Ricciardo Baku situation’
items.summaryEn: During the Dutch Grand Prix, Williams drivers Carlos Sainz and Alexander Albon collided, ending Albon's race. Both drivers apologised, and the stewards ruled Sainz wholly at fault, handing him a 10-second time penalty.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿解释荷兰大奖赛无线电爆发，呼吁法拉利提高效率
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛后因缺乏车队指令感到沮丧，呼吁法拉利像梅赛德斯那样提高效率。他在赞德福特赛道获得第四名，比赛中与队友夏尔·勒克莱尔的中段缠斗成为焦点。
items.titleEn: Hamilton explains Dutch GP radio outburst over Ferrari team orders
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton urged Ferrari to be more like Mercedes in terms of efficiency after growing frustrated by a lack of team orders during the Dutch Grand Prix. He finished fourth at Zandvoort, where his mid-race battle with teammate Charles Leclerc was arguably his defining period.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿解释荷兰大奖赛无线电爆发：呼吁法拉利效仿梅赛德斯效率
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿因在荷兰大奖赛中缺乏车队指令而感到沮丧，在无线电中表达不满，赛后呼吁法拉利提高效率、效仿梅赛德斯。他在赞德沃特的比赛中获得第四名，与队友夏尔·勒克莱尔的缠斗成为焦点。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton explains Dutch GP radio outburst over team orders
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton expressed frustration on the radio over a lack of team orders during the Dutch Grand Prix and afterwards urged Ferrari to be more efficient, like Mercedes. He finished fourth at Zandvoort, with his mid-race battle against teammate Charles Leclerc being the defining period of his race.

items.titleZh: 前车手称梅赛德斯将“担忧”迈凯伦在F1冠军争夺中的威胁
items.summaryZh: 前F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，梅赛德斯会对迈凯伦的发展速度和原始速度感到担忧。他在天空体育F1节目中称赞了兰多·诺里斯在荷兰大奖赛赞德沃特的速度。
items.titleEn: Mercedes will be "worried" about McLaren threat in F1 title fight, says former driver
items.summaryEn: Former F1 world champion Nico Rosberg believes Mercedes will be worried about McLaren's development rate and raw speed following the Dutch Grand Prix. He praised Lando Norris's pace at Zandvoort on Sky Sports F1.

items.titleZh: 霍肯伯格解释如何避免与队友博托莱托相撞的“惊险”瞬间
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛中，尼科·霍肯伯格描述了他如何在最后一刻做出“本能”的转向，以避免与队友博托莱托发生侧面碰撞。他称这次险情为“惊险”的近距离接触。
items.titleEn: Hulkenberg explains how he avoided team mate Bortoleto in “scary” near-miss
items.summaryEn: In the Dutch Grand Prix, Nico Hulkenberg described how he made an "instinctive" last-second swerve to avoid T-boning his team mate Gabriel Bortoleto. He called the incident a "scary, sketchy" close call.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格支持梅赛德斯在荷兰大奖赛使用车队指令
items.summaryZh: 前梅赛德斯F1车手尼科·罗斯伯格为车队在荷兰大奖赛期间要求基米·安东内利让乔治·拉塞尔通过的车队指令进行了辩护。
items.titleEn: Nico Rosberg weighs in on Mercedes Dutch GP team orders between Kimi Antonelli and George Russell
items.summaryEn: Former Mercedes F1 driver Nico Rosberg has defended the team's decision to use team orders during the Dutch Grand Prix, asking Kimi Antonelli to let George Russell through.

items.titleZh: 科拉平托称黄旗下超车受罚“非常严厉”
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛中，弗兰科·科拉平托因两次黄旗违规被罚分，利亚姆·劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德也因未遵守黄旗规则受罚。科拉平托批评这一处罚“非常严厉”，并称其“影响了我们整场比赛”。
items.titleEn: Colapinto claims penalty for overtaking under yellow flags was “very harsh”
items.summaryEn: Franco Colapinto received penalty points for two yellow flag infringements during the Dutch Grand Prix, while Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad were also penalised for failing to obey F1's yellow flag rules. Colapinto criticised the decision as a "very harsh penalty" which "compromised the whole of our race".

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔承认梅赛德斯荷兰站车队指令“正确决定”
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔承认，在荷兰大奖赛尾声，梅赛德斯让他与队友基米·安东内利互换位置是“正确的决定”，当时两人正在争夺仅次于冠军兰多·诺里斯的排名。安东内利和拉塞尔分别位居第二和第四，中间隔着法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿，因埃斯特班·奥康赛车故障触发的晚期虚拟安全车影响了局面。
items.titleEn: George Russell concedes Mercedes' Dutch GP team orders "the right decision"
items.summaryEn: George Russell admitted that Mercedes' decision to swap positions with his teammate Kimi Antonelli in the closing stages of the Dutch Grand Prix was "the right decision", as they battled for position behind race winner Lando Norris. Antonelli and Russell were running second and fourth, split by Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, when a late virtual safety car was triggered by Esteban Ocon's car failure.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔对梅赛德斯车队指令态度大转弯
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛结束时被车队要求让队友兼直接争冠对手基米·安东内利通过后，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在赛后评估中表现出出人意料的大度。
items.titleEn: Why Russell's U-turned on Mercedes team orders angst
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell was surprisingly magnanimous in his post-race assessment after being ordered to let team-mate and direct title rival Kimi Antonelli through at the end of the Dutch Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 2026 F1锦标赛：安东内利保持领先，汉密尔顿失去亚军位置
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1荷兰大奖赛后，基米·安东内利与乔治·拉塞尔在冲刺赛制下积分相同相互抵消，安东内利继续领跑车手积分榜，拉塞尔则从刘易斯·汉密尔顿手中夺回第二位。
items.titleEn: The 2026 F1 Championship: Kimi Antonelli stays top as Lewis Hamilton loses runner-up spot
items.summaryEn: After the 2026 F1 Dutch Grand Prix, Kimi Antonelli and George Russell scored the same number of points under the sprint format and cancelled each other out, keeping Antonelli at the top of the standings, while Russell reclaimed second place from Lewis Hamilton.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯超越安东内利夺得F1最后一届荷兰大奖赛冠军
items.summaryZh: 在2026年荷兰大奖赛中，迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯超越梅赛德斯的基米·安东内利夺冠，这是F1历史上最后一届荷兰大奖赛。安东内利获得第二名，领先队友拉塞尔。
items.titleEn: Norris passes Antonelli's Mercedes to win F1's final Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: McLaren's Lando Norris won the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix after overtaking Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli, in what was the final Dutch Grand Prix in F1 history. Antonelli finished second ahead of his team-mate George Russell.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘F1荷兰大奖赛撞车原因分析
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在主场荷兰大奖赛首圈发生撞车，他解释这是一次车手失误。从第七位发车后，他在一号弯前陷入四车并行，被挤上草地，随后在接下来的弯道中与红牛替补利亚姆·劳森竞争时发生事故。
items.titleEn: What caused Verstappen’s F1 Dutch GP crash
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen crashed on the first lap of his home Dutch Grand Prix, which he explained was a driver error. Starting seventh, he was squeezed onto the grass in a four-wide moment on the run to Turn 1, and then collided while battling Red Bull stand-in Liam Lawson in the following corners.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘解释荷兰大奖赛首圈撞车退赛原因
items.summaryZh: 四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘在主场荷兰大奖赛首圈遭遇撞车，遗憾退赛。赛后他解释了导致事故的原因。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen explains what caused his race-ending F1 Dutch GP crash
items.summaryEn: Four-time world champion Max Verstappen crashed on the first lap of his home Dutch Grand Prix and retired from the race. After the race, he explained what caused the accident.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1荷兰大奖赛成绩与积分榜
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1荷兰大奖赛于8月23日结束，迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯夺冠，梅赛德斯的基米·安东内利获得亚军，季军车手未提供姓名。
items.titleEn: All the results and standings from the 2026 F1 Dutch Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: The 2026 F1 Dutch Grand Prix concluded on 23 August, with McLaren's Lando Norris taking victory and Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli finishing second, while the name of the third-place finisher was not provided.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：诺里斯超越安东内利夺冠，维斯塔潘严重撞车
items.summaryZh: F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯在荷兰大奖赛中从杆位出发，凭借出色驾驶赢得冠军，而主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘因撞车引发红旗。迈凯伦车手诺里斯以11.5秒的优势领先亚军基米·安东内利冲线，其梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔获得季军。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Norris overhauls Antonelli for victory, Verstappen suffers heavy crash
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris produced a mega drive to win the Dutch Grand Prix from pole while home hero Max Verstappen caused a red flag by crashing out. The McLaren driver crossed the line 11.5s ahead of runner-up Kimi Antonelli, with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell completing the podium at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯在赞德福特连续第二场获胜 | 2026荷兰大奖赛报告
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在充满变数的荷兰大奖赛中连续第二场夺冠，而马克斯·维斯塔潘则因撞车退赛。
items.titleEn: Norris passes Antonelli for second win in a row at Zandvoort
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris claimed his second consecutive victory in a chaotic Dutch Grand Prix, while Max Verstappen retired after a heavy crash.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：诺里斯杆位夺冠，维斯塔潘首圈撞车退赛
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯从杆位出发赢得F1荷兰大奖赛冠军，领先亚军基米·安东内利11.5秒。主场作战的马克斯·维斯塔潘在首圈引发红旗并撞车退赛，安东内利的梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔获得季军。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Lando Norris beats Kimi Antonelli from pole as Max Verstappen crashes out
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris won the Dutch Grand Prix from pole, finishing 11.5 seconds ahead of runner-up Kimi Antonelli. Home hero Max Verstappen caused a red flag and crashed out on the first lap, while Antonelli's Mercedes team-mate George Russell completed the podium at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛五大要点：诺里斯与迈凯伦重燃争冠希望
items.summaryZh: 在2025年荷兰大奖赛上，兰多·诺里斯连续赢得第二场F1分站胜利，展现迈凯伦的强劲复苏势头，并开始缩小与基米·安东内利之间的积分差距。
items.titleEn: Five quick takeaways from the F1 Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris won his second consecutive F1 race at the 2025 Dutch Grand Prix, showing McLaren's strong resurgence, and began closing the gap to Kimi Antonelli in the championship.

items.titleZh: 2026 F1荷兰大奖赛：诺里斯连续第二站夺冠
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在赞德福特举行的最后一届荷兰大奖赛中夺冠，取得连续第二场F1胜利。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP 2026 race results
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris claimed his second consecutive Formula 1 victory at the final Dutch Grand Prix held at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格：拉塞尔已重回最佳状态
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔在经历2026赛季艰难开局后终于重回最佳状态。拉塞尔在墨尔本站和中国站冲刺赛中获胜，但随后遭遇时机不佳的安全车等周期问题，影响了策略和赛车表现。
items.titleEn: Nico Rosberg says George Russell is "back at his best" after difficult F1 start
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg believes George Russell is finally back to his best form after a difficult start to the 2026 season. Russell won in Melbourne and the Chinese sprint race but then faced multiple issues, including ill-timed safety cars that hampered his strategy, as well as car problems.

items.titleZh: 荷兰大奖赛首圈维斯塔潘严重撞车引发红旗
items.summaryZh: 荷兰大奖赛首圈，马克斯·维斯塔潘在湿滑的最后一弯打滑撞墙，赛会出示红旗中断比赛。比赛随后于当地时间下午3:33重启。
items.titleEn: Dutch Grand Prix red-flagged after one lap due to huge crash for Verstappen
items.summaryEn: The Dutch Grand Prix was red-flagged on the opening lap after Max Verstappen spun into the barrier at the damp final corner. The race restarted at 3:33pm local time.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛因维斯塔潘撞车被红旗中断
items.summaryZh: F1荷兰大奖赛在首圈结束后因主场车手马克斯·维斯塔潘的严重事故被红旗中断，维斯塔潘在赞德福特赛道最后一弯压到内侧白线后失控撞墙，随后报告自己无恙并向车队致歉。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP red-flagged after Verstappen crash
items.summaryEn: The Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix was red-flagged after one lap following a huge accident for home hero Max Verstappen, who lost control of his Red Bull after touching the white line on the inside of Zandvoort's final banked corner and hit the outside wall. Verstappen reported he was OK and apologised to his team for ending his race early.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛红旗：维斯塔潘重大事故引发中断
items.summaryZh: F1荷兰大奖赛在首圈后因红旗中断，主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘发生重大事故。在潮湿赛道上，维斯塔潘在赞德福特最后一个弯道（倾斜的全油门卢伊恩迪克弯）内侧压上白线，导致红牛赛车失控撞墙。
items.titleEn: Dutch F1 grand prix red flagged after huge Max Verstappen crash
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix was red-flagged after one lap following an enormous accident for home hero Max Verstappen. On the wet track, Verstappen put a wheel on the white line on the inside of the banked, flat-out Luyendyk corner at Zandvoort, sending his Red Bull spinning into the wall.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛因维斯塔潘严重撞车被红旗中断
items.summaryZh: 在赞德沃特举行的F1荷兰大奖赛于第二圈开始时被红旗中断，主场车手马克斯·维斯塔潘在最后一个弯失控撞上护墙。
items.titleEn: F1's Dutch GP red-flagged after monster Verstappen crash
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort was red-flagged at the start of lap two after home hero Max Verstappen lost control and crashed heavily. He immediately reported to his team that he was unhurt.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格警告安东内利：F1冠军争夺战中的“心魔”
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格警告称，目前领跑积分榜的梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在争夺首个世界冠军的过程中将面临越来越大的心理战。
items.titleEn: Nico Rosberg warns Kimi Antonelli of F1 title "demons"
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg has warned that Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli will face a growing psychological battle as he fights for his maiden title.

items.titleZh: 多梅尼卡利：无法想象F1没有维斯塔潘
items.summaryZh: F1首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利对马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛续约表示欢迎，称他无法想象F1没有维斯塔潘。这位四届世界冠军周四宣布将合同从2028年底延长至2030年底。
items.titleEn: Stefano Domenicali "cannot see" F1 without Max Verstappen
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 chief Stefano Domenicali has reacted buoyantly to Max Verstappen's contract extension with Red Bull, saying he cannot see F1 without him. The four-time world champion announced on Thursday a new deal taking his contract from the end of 2028 to the end of 2030.

items.titleZh: 兰多·诺里斯：希望梅赛德斯在拉斯维加斯被双取消资格，并在卡塔尔忘记进站
items.summaryZh: 卫冕冠军兰多·诺里斯目前仅列车手积分榜第五，他开玩笑表示保住冠军的希望在于梅赛德斯车手在赛季后半段遭遇意外。他还引用传奇评论员穆雷·沃克名言“F1是‘如果’倒过来拼”来形容F1充满意外结果。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris: I hope Mercedes gets a double disqualification in Las Vegas and forgets to pit in Qatar
items.summaryEn: Defending champion Lando Norris, currently only fifth in the drivers' standings, has joked that his hopes of retaining the title depend on the Mercedes drivers hitting trouble in the second half of the season. He echoed legendary commentator Murray Walker's saying that "F1 is 'if' spelled backwards", noting that Formula 1 is prone to unexpected outcomes.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦认为法拉利在赞德福特最快，但可能陷入困境
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在赞德福特冲刺赛中的出色表现令一级方程式对手提高警惕，但令人失望的排位赛成绩可能使其在正赛中无法发挥优势。
items.titleEn: Why McLaren thinks Ferrari is quickest in Zandvoort, but may well be stuck
items.summaryEn: Ferrari's impressive sprint race at Zandvoort has put its Formula 1 rivals on high alert, but a disappointing qualifying performance may leave the team unable to use its advantage in the grand prix.

items.titleZh: “这太疯狂了”——汉密尔顿对法拉利轮胎升温问题感到困惑
items.summaryZh: 在F1荷兰大奖赛排位赛中，刘易斯·汉密尔顿对法拉利SF-26赛车在出场圈无法充分预热轮胎感到困惑，他和夏尔·勒克莱尔都需要两圈热身圈才能让轮胎进入合适的工作温度窗口。两人在Q3中分别仅列第五和第六，追平了他们今年夏天的最差成绩。
items.titleEn: “It’s just nuts” – Lewis Hamilton baffled by Ferrari’s tyre-warming struggle
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton was baffled by the Ferrari SF-26's inability to sufficiently warm its tyres over an out-lap during Dutch Grand Prix qualifying, with both he and Charles Leclerc needing two warm-up laps at Zandvoort. The pair qualified only fifth and sixth in Q3, equalling their worst results this summer.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：安东内利称周末为“警钟”
items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中仅列第三，错失杆位，此前冲刺赛排位冲出赛道损坏赛车并在冲刺赛中只获第四，他称这个周末是一次“警钟”。
items.titleEn: Antonelli: F1 Dutch GP weekend has been a "wake-up call"
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli qualified only third for the Dutch Grand Prix after going off track in sprint qualifying and finishing fourth in the sprint, calling the weekend a "wake-up call" for the championship leader.

items.titleZh: 角田裕毅：小红牛对我的表现“相当满意”
items.summaryZh: 角田裕毅表示，小红牛车队对他适应2026年规格F1赛车的方式“相当满意”。他因利亚姆·劳森被红牛车队征召，而在赞德福特棘手的冲刺赛周末代表小红牛出战荷兰大奖赛。
items.titleEn: Yuki Tsunoda: Racing Bulls is “pretty impressed” with my performance so far
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda says Racing Bulls has been "pretty impressed" with how he has adapted to Formula 1's 2026-spec machinery as he stands in for Liam Lawson at the Dutch Grand Prix. Lawson was called up to Red Bull after Isack Hadjar injured his wrist during the summer break, giving Tsunoda his chance on the tricky Zandvoort sprint weekend.

items.titleZh: 加里·安德森解析法拉利赞德沃特升级的细节门道
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在赞德沃特带来的升级看似不起眼，但加里·安德森认为，这些细节上的优化作为整体分析可能会带来性能回报。
items.titleEn: Gary Anderson: Ferrari's deceptive Zandvoort upgrade explained
items.summaryEn: Gary Anderson believes Ferrari's understated Zandvoort upgrades may pay off when analysed as a whole, as the fine details optimise overall performance.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫开玩笑称梅赛德斯已有维斯塔潘参加“真正的英雄赛”
items.summaryZh: 在赞德福特举行的梅赛德斯媒体见面会上，沃尔夫与荷兰记者开玩笑说，梅赛德斯已经拥有维斯塔潘参加“真正的英雄赛”，延续了近年来该环节常出惊人言论的传统。
items.titleEn: Wolff jokes that Mercedes already has Verstappen for the "real hero races"
items.summaryEn: At Mercedes' media session in Zandvoort, Toto Wolff joked with Dutch journalists that Mercedes already has Max Verstappen for the "real hero races", continuing the tradition of eye-catching comments at this annual roundtable.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫调侃维斯塔潘：梅赛德斯拥有他参加最重要的比赛
items.summaryZh: 在赞德福特赛道的传统媒体见面会上，梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫开玩笑称，尽管维斯塔潘与红牛有合同，但梅赛德斯拥有他参加最重要的比赛，指的是双方联合的GT3项目。
items.titleEn: Toto Wolff jokes about Max Verstappen's Red Bull deal: Mercedes has him for the most important races
items.summaryEn: At the traditional media session at Zandvoort, Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff joked that although Max Verstappen has a contract with Red Bull, Mercedes has him for the most important races, referring to their joint GT3 project.

items.titleZh: 阿尔本透露撒丁岛与维斯塔潘的搞笑偶遇
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车手阿尔本在车队官方播客中透露，夏休期他在撒丁岛学习电动水翼板时意外遇到四届世界冠军维斯塔潘。
items.titleEn: Alex Albon details hilarious Sardinia run-in with Max Verstappen
items.summaryEn: Williams driver Alex Albon revealed on the team's official podcast that he unexpectedly ran into four-time world champion Max Verstappen while learning to e-foil in Sardinia during the summer break.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯在2026年F1艰难开局后向威廉姆斯工厂传达信息：“把它当作个人挑战”
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯透露，在2026年F1赛季艰难开局后，他向威廉姆斯车队工厂员工传达了激励信息。塞恩斯2025年随车队两次登上领奖台，令外界对2026年寄予厚望，但车队错过巴塞罗那私人测试，在巴林季前测试中处于劣势。
items.titleEn: Carlos Sainz reveals message to Williams factory after tough 2026 F1 start: "Take it personal"
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz has revealed the motivational message he delivered to Williams factory staff after a tough start to the 2026 F1 season. Having taken two podiums with the team in 2025, expectations were high, but Williams missed private testing in Barcelona and arrived on the back foot at pre-season testing in Bahrain.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿反弹至第五，法拉利修复周五问题
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中获得第五名后表示，与周五冲刺排位赛仅列第七相比，他对法拉利赛车“满意得多”，并对接下来的正赛感到“兴奋”。他将改善归因于赛车所做出的调整。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton rebounds to fifth after Ferrari fixes Friday struggles
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said he is "much happier" with his Ferrari after qualifying fifth for the Dutch Grand Prix, a big improvement on Friday's sprint qualifying where he was seventh, and he is "excited" for the race. He credited changes made to the car for the improved result.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘认为队友差距缩小源于赛车“更易驾驶”，斯特拉持不同意见
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘认为2026年队友之间差距缩小是因为这一代赛车在极限状态下更容易驾驶，迈凯伦车队负责人安德烈亚·斯特拉对此持不同看法。利亚姆·劳森和角田裕毅分别在临时出战中表现出色。
items.titleEn: Verstappen: “Easier” 2026 F1 cars shrinking team-mate gaps as Stella disagrees
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen believes the smaller gaps between team-mates in 2026 are down to this generation of cars being easier to drive on the limit, a view McLaren team boss Andrea Stella disagrees with. Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda both impressed in one-off outings at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘认为替补车手出色表现暴露F1问题
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛上，替补车手利亚姆·劳森和角田裕毅表现亮眼，四届世界冠军维斯塔潘暗示这表明2026年的F1变得过于简单。
items.titleEn: What Verstappen thinks strong stand-ins have exposed about F1
items.summaryEn: Strong stand-in performances by Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda at the Dutch Grand Prix prompted Max Verstappen to suggest that Formula 1 has become too easy in 2026.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔称“更放松”，安东内利领跑2026年F1冠军之争
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在2026年F1夏季休赛期后回归，表示自己“更放松”，并力图缩小与梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利的积分差距，目前安东内利领先第三名的拉塞尔56分。
