items.summaryEn: George Russell has returned from the 2026 F1 summer break feeling "more relaxed" as he tries to claw back into the title fight against Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who leads third-placed Russell by 56 points.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘患流感样疾病，赞德福特暴露红牛根本问题
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘在排位赛后承认身体不适，有流感样症状；同时红牛小红牛22在赞德福特暴露出根本性弱点，他仅列第七，落后杆位诺里斯超过0.4秒。
items.titleEn: Verstappen suffering from "flu-like" illness as Zandvoort exposes Red Bull's fundamental problems
items.summaryEn: Verstappen admitted after qualifying that he is feeling unwell with flu-like symptoms, while Red Bull's RB22 exposed fundamental weaknesses at Zandvoort, leaving him seventh on the grid, more than four tenths behind polesitter Norris.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘赞德福特感觉"像感冒一样"，红牛暴露根本性问题

items.titleEn: Max Verstappen feeling "flu-like" as Zandvoort exposes Red Bull's fundamental problems
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen admitted after qualifying at the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix that he feels "flu-like" and lacks his usual energy, while Zandvoort also exposed fundamental limitations of the Red Bull RB22.

items.titleZh: 劳森：我一直知道2025年本可以不同——现在你们也看到了
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛上顶替手腕受伤的哈贾尔，利亚姆·劳森时隔18个月重返红牛，排位赛中紧追队友维斯塔潘，表现亮眼。
items.titleEn: Liam Lawson: I always knew 2025 could have been different - now you do too
items.summaryEn: Substituting for the injured Isack Hadjar at the Dutch Grand Prix, Liam Lawson returned to Red Bull 18 months after his two-race stint and impressed by shadowing team-mate Max Verstappen in qualifying.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛发车格：诺里斯杆位 佩雷斯维修区起步
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯将在F1荷兰大奖赛从杆位发车，梅赛德斯双雄紧随其后；塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯因违反封闭停车规定更改悬挂设置，将从维修区起步。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 Dutch Grand Prix starting grid with a pitlane start
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris will start the Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix from pole position with the two Mercedes drivers behind him, while Sergio Perez will start from the pitlane after breaching parc ferme with suspension set-up changes.

items.titleEn: Winners and losers from 2026 Dutch GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: The Race team reviewed the highly competitive qualifying session for the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, highlighting both standout performers and disappointments, with Aston Martin's drivers qualifying only 18th and 19th.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘调侃拉塞尔的无线电对话走红
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛排位赛后，马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛工程师詹皮耶罗·兰比亚斯的一段无线电对话在网络上走红，他预判了乔治·拉塞尔可能会抱怨维修区放行，但这一抱怨并未发生。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen's George Russell radio joke goes viral after Dutch GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: After Dutch Grand Prix qualifying, a radio exchange between Max Verstappen and his Red Bull engineer Gianpiero Lambiase went viral, in which Verstappen predicted George Russell would complain about the pit release, but the complaint never came.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿称法拉利小改动带来“难以置信”的提升
items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿在荷兰大奖赛排位赛获得第五名后表示，法拉利赛车平衡性的显著改善让他对正赛更加乐观；队友勒克莱尔则对第六名的排位成绩不太满意。
items.titleEn: Small change made “unbelievable” improvement in Hamilton’s Ferrari
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said a significant improvement in his Ferrari's balance left him more optimistic for the Dutch Grand Prix after qualifying fifth, while team mate Charles Leclerc was less happy after taking sixth on the grid.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：周日赛程、天气预报及观赛指南
items.summaryZh: F1荷兰大奖赛周日正赛将在赞德沃特赛道举行，兰多·诺里斯在排位赛中击败乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位。积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利位列第三，马克斯·维斯塔潘第七。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Sunday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
items.summaryEn: The F1 Dutch Grand Prix takes place on Sunday at Zandvoort, with Lando Norris on pole after beating George Russell in qualifying. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli qualified third, while Max Verstappen starts seventh.

items.titleZh: 安东内利因1号弯失误错失荷兰大奖赛杆位

items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli frustrated after Turn 1 "mistake" cost him Dutch GP pole

He qualified 0.133s behind McLaren polesitter Lando Norris and 0.031s behind team-mate George Russell.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘2026年梅赛德斯接触与去年截然不同
items.summaryZh: 在赞德沃特的年度媒体会上，梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫被荷兰记者问及维斯塔潘是否会加盟梅赛德斯。此次沃尔夫表示大门看似关闭，但仍留有一丝余地。

items.titleEn: Why Max Verstappen’s 2026 Mercedes contact was very different from last year’s

items.titleEn: Max Verstappen's Red Bull deal leaves F1 rivals "breathing a sigh of relief", says David Coulthard

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德：赞德福特冲刺赛不会太精彩

items.summaryEn: Arvid Lindblad said he was not surprised the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race lacked action, but he found the session useful for practice.

items.titleEn: Winners and losers from F1's Dutch GP sprint race

items.titleZh: 帕尔默警告拉塞尔：2026年或是最佳夺冠机会

items.summaryEn: George Russell won the sprint race at Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix, beating Charles Leclerc's Ferrari and Lando Norris's McLaren.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘续约红牛被视为对梅基斯领导力的“重要肯定”
items.summaryZh: F1电视分析师亚历克斯·布伦德尔称赞马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛签订的长期合同，认为这是对劳伦特·梅基斯领导力的有力肯定。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen's Red Bull commitment hailed as "important vindication" of Laurent Mekies
items.summaryEn: F1 TV analyst Alex Brundle has hailed Max Verstappen's long-term commitment to Red Bull as a strong endorsement of Laurent Mekies' leadership.

items.titleZh: 斯泰纳建议凯迪拉克放弃2026年赛车研发
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯车队领队冈瑟·斯泰纳建议凯迪拉克立即停止其陷入困境的2026年F1赛车的进一步研发，将资源转向2027年赛车。
items.titleEn: Guenther Steiner urges Cadillac to abandon 2026 F1 car development
items.summaryEn: Former Haas team principal Guenther Steiner has urged Cadillac to immediately stop developing its struggling 2026 Formula 1 car and shift its resources to the 2027 car.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔夺赞德沃特冲刺杆位，但数据向梅赛德斯发出警示
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中为梅赛德斯拿下杆位，但性能数据显示迈凯伦取得关键进步，表明梅赛德斯可能无法再推迟引进更多升级。
items.titleEn: The warning for Mercedes in its Zandvoort data
items.summaryEn: George Russell's sprint pole at the Dutch Grand Prix offered Mercedes relief, but performance data showing McLaren's key progress suggests Mercedes may not be able to delay bringing further upgrades much longer.

items.titleZh: 角田裕毅重返F1首日：冲刺赛排位第12名“相当满意”
items.summaryZh: 角田裕毅在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛中取得第12名，这位时隔八个月重返赛场的小红牛回归车手表示对自己的表现“相当满意”。由于伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕受伤退出本周末比赛，利亚姆·劳森临时升入红牛，兼任两队储备车手的角田裕毅得以顶替哈贾尔的席位。
items.titleEn: How Yuki Tsunoda’s first day back as an F1 driver went
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda qualified 12th for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint, a performance the Racing Bulls returnee says he is "pretty satisfied with" after eight months away from racing. Isack Hadjar's wrist injury over the summer break ruled him out this weekend, Liam Lawson was temporarily promoted to Red Bull, and Tsunoda, a reserve driver for both teams, inherited the seat at Racing Bulls.

items.titleZh: 沙丘与尘埃——F1车手哀悼“老派”赞德福特赛道的告别
items.summaryZh: 赞德福特赛道将于本周末举办现代时代的第六届荷兰大奖赛，这也是它在当前赛历上的告别之战。维斯塔潘的受欢迎程度与成功让这项一度被认为已成历史的比赛自2021年起重获新生，如今车手们对这个最爱赛道之一满怀不舍。
items.titleEn: Dune and dusted - F1 drivers mourn "old school" Zandvoort loss
items.summaryEn: Zandvoort will host its sixth Dutch Grand Prix of the modern era this weekend, which will also serve as its farewell on the current calendar. Max Verstappen's unprecedented popularity and success revived the race from 2021, and drivers are now sad to say goodbye to one of their favourite circuits.

items.titleZh: Netflix确认舒马赫新纪录片2026年10月上映
items.summaryZh: Netflix宣布关于迈克尔·舒马赫首次夺冠赛季的F1纪录片《舒马赫'94 - 传奇诞生》将于2026年10月2日全球上映。该片是继2021年纪录片《舒马赫》之后的又一作品。
items.titleEn: Netflix confirms release date for new Michael Schumacher F1 documentary
items.summaryEn: Netflix has announced that its new F1 documentary about Michael Schumacher's first championship-winning season, titled "Schumacher '94 - The Making of a Legend", will be released globally on October 2, 2026. The feature film follows the 2021 documentary "Schumacher".

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿对“完全不同”的法拉利感到困惑，勒克莱尔称2026最佳圈速
items.summaryZh: 在赞德福特F1冲刺排位赛中，拉塞尔夺得杆位，前五名差距仅十分之一秒；汉密尔顿因调校问题仅列第七，称赛车“完全不同”，勒克莱尔则取得第三并称这是2026年的“最佳”单圈。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton baffled by "completely different" Ferrari as Charles Leclerc nails "best" lap of 2026
items.summaryEn: George Russell took pole in the Dutch GP sprint qualifying with the top five covered by just a tenth of a second. Lewis Hamilton, who struggled with a "completely different" Ferrari after set-up changes, qualified seventh, while Charles Leclerc took third and called it his "best" lap of 2026.

items.titleZh: 本田规格2升级引擎荷兰站首秀纸面成绩不佳 潜力或可达2.5秒
items.summaryZh: 本田升级版规格2引擎在荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛首秀，阿斯顿·马丁两位车手均未能通过SQ1，纸面表现令人失望，但分析认为其实际潜力或可带来2.5秒提升。
items.titleEn: Could have been 2.5s quicker?! Honda's deceptive F1 engine upgrade debut
items.summaryEn: Honda's upgraded spec 2 Formula 1 engine made its debut in sprint qualifying at the Dutch Grand Prix, but the on-paper results were disappointing as both Aston Martin drivers failed to advance from SQ1. Analysis suggests the engine's true potential, which could be worth up to 2.5 seconds, may have been masked.

items.titleZh: 科拉平托透露米兰夏季休赛期遭窃细节
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车手弗兰科·科拉平托首次公开谈论夏季休赛期在米兰遭遇的车内盗窃事件，窃贼偷走了他的衣物和护照，他戏称这是“我人生中最糟糕的一天”。
items.titleEn: Franco Colapinto reveals details of Milan car robbery during F1 summer break
items.summaryEn: Alpine F1 driver Franco Colapinto has spoken for the first time about a theft in Milan during the summer break, in which thieves stole his clothes and passport, jokingly calling it "the worst day of my life".

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛周六赛程、天气预报及观赛指南
items.summaryZh: 在赞德沃特举行的荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔以0.041秒优势击败兰多·诺里斯夺得冲刺赛杆位。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Saturday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
items.summaryEn: George Russell took sprint pole for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, beating Lando Norris by just 0.041s, with Charles Leclerc third and Oscar Piastri fourth. Max Verstappen will start sixth for his final home grand prix at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘：红牛在荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛后仍缺乏抓地力和平衡
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在赞德沃特冲刺排位赛中仅列第六，此前练习阶段他抱怨换挡质量差、抓地力不足和转向过度，赛后表示赛车仍缺乏抓地力和平衡。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen: Red Bull still lacking grip and balance after F1 Dutch GP sprint qualifying
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen qualified only sixth for the sprint race at Zandvoort after a disappointing practice session in which he complained of poor gearshifts, low grip and oversteer, and he said the car still lacks grip and balance after sprint qualifying.

items.titleZh: 本田新F1引擎带来新的但可预期的操控性问题
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车手费尔南多·阿隆索表示，在赞德福特冲刺排位赛中难以保持赛车在赛道上，本田更强大的引擎需要更多工作来优化。阿隆索和队友兰斯·斯特罗尔已收到本田V6动力单元的第二规格，日本制造商将荷兰作为部署其赛季内升级的地点。
items.titleEn: Why Honda's new F1 engine comes with fresh but expected driveability issues
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso said more work is needed to optimise Honda's more powerful engine after struggling to keep his car on track in sprint qualifying at Zandvoort. Alonso and team-mate Lance Stroll have received the second specification of Honda's V6 power unit, with the Japanese manufacturer having chosen the Netherlands as the site to deploy its one in-season engine upgrade this year.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索：本田新引擎带来操控难题，尚需优化
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车手费尔南多·阿隆索表示，在赞德福特冲刺排位赛中难以控制赛车，本田更强大的新引擎需要更多工作来优化。
items.titleEn: "Difficult to stop the car" - Honda's new engine comes with fresh but expected driveability issues
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin driver Fernando Alonso says more work is needed to optimise Honda's more powerful engine after struggling to keep his car on the track in sprint qualifying at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 劳森重返红牛首日排位表现意味深长
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森在荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位中仅落后队友维斯塔潘0.365秒，虽在SQ2遭淘汰，但其回归红牛首日的状态明显好于去年的短暂效力期。
items.titleEn: Lawson's first day back at Red Bull was very revealing
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson lapped just 0.365s behind team-mate Max Verstappen in sprint qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix, and although he was eliminated in SQ2, he looked far more comfortable with the Red Bull than during his troubled two-event stint last year.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯赞德福特练习赛砂石路受损，正接受调查
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯在赞德福特大奖赛练习赛中因多次驶过“激进”的砂石路导致赛车部件受损，被迫使用竞争力较差的部件，并在冲刺赛排位赛后因涉嫌“不必要慢速行驶”接受调查。
items.titleEn: Sainz’s car compromised by trips through “aggressive” Zandvoort gravel in practice
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz Jnr sustained damage to his car after going off into the "aggressive" gravel multiple times during practice for the Dutch Grand Prix, forcing him to revert to less competitive components, and he is under investigation for potentially driving unnecessarily slowly in sprint qualifying.

items.titleZh: F1 2026荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛发车顺位公布
items.summaryZh: The 比赛报道，F1 2026荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛发车顺位确定，乔治·拉塞尔与兰多·诺里斯将共同占据前排发车。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 Dutch Grand Prix sprint race starting grid
items.summaryEn: The Race reports that the starting grid for the F1 2026 Dutch Grand Prix sprint race has been set, with George Russell and Lando Norris sharing the front row at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 安东内利：荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛失误损失约“25点下压力”
items.summaryZh: 安东内利在F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛中于第13弯冲出赛道，他透露这一失误损失了约“25点下压力”，最终获得周六24圈冲刺赛的第五发车位。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli: F1 Dutch GP sprint qualifying off cost "25 points of downforce"
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli revealed that his Turn 13 off during Dutch Grand Prix sprint qualifying cost him roughly "25 points of downforce", leaving him fifth on the grid for Saturday's 24-lap sprint race.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛赢家与输家盘点
items.summaryZh: F1时隔近一个月的首个正式计时环节在赞德福特结束，冲刺排位赛争夺激烈，《The 比赛》评选出本场的主要赢家与输家。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from sprint qualifying at F1's Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's first competitive session in almost a month at Zandvoort produced a closely fought battle for sprint pole, and The Race has picked out the biggest winners and losers from sprint qualifying.

items.titleZh: 马尔克斯就手腕伤势向哈贾尔提出建议
items.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因上周在健身房训练时手腕受伤，将缺席本周末的荷兰大奖赛；红牛与七届MotoGP世界冠军马克·马尔克斯都建议他不要冒险，安心恢复。
items.titleEn: The advice Marquez gave Hadjar over his wrist injury
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Dutch Grand Prix after sustaining a wrist injury during a gym session last week, with both Red Bull and seven-time MotoGP world champion Marc Marquez advising him not to take any risks and to focus on recovery.

items.titleZh: 2026 F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛发车顺位公布
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛发车顺位确定，乔治·拉塞尔（梅赛德斯）拿下杆位，兰多·诺里斯和夏尔·勒克莱尔分列二三位。
items.titleEn: This is the starting grid for the 2026 F1 Dutch Grand Prix sprint
items.summaryEn: The starting grid for the 2026 F1 Dutch Grand Prix sprint has been set, with George Russell of Mercedes taking pole position, followed by Lando Norris and Charles Leclerc in second and third.

items.titleZh: 马尔克斯就手腕伤势向哈贾尔提出建议，哈贾尔缺席荷兰大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因上周健身房训练中手腕受伤，将缺席本周末的荷兰大奖赛。红牛和MotoGP冠军马克·马尔克斯都建议他不要冒险，角田裕毅被召入替补。
items.titleEn: The advice MotoGP champion Marc Marquez gave Isack Hadjar over his wrist injury
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Dutch Grand Prix after injuring his wrist during a gym session last week. Both Red Bull and MotoGP champion Marc Marquez urged him not to take any risks, with Yuki Tsunoda called up as his replacement.

items.titleZh: 引擎与空气动力学问题使阿隆索在冲刺赛排位赛中垫底
items.summaryZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索在冲刺赛排位赛中遭遇引擎和空气动力学问题，最终在冲刺赛发车格上排名最后。他在赛后表示：“当你刹车时油门还开着，很难让赛车停下来。”
items.titleEn: Engine and aerodynamic problems leave Alonso last on grid for sprint race
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso will start last in the sprint race at Zandvoort after facing engine and aerodynamic issues in qualifying. He said, "When you brake and the throttle is open, it is difficult to stop the car."

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔力压安东内利夺得荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛杆位
items.summaryZh: 在赞德福特举行的F1冲刺赛排位赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔以1分11秒567的成绩夺得本赛季个人第三个冲刺赛杆位，前四名车手之间的差距不到0.1秒。
items.titleEn: Russell upstages Antonelli with Dutch GP sprint pole
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell took his third sprint pole of the season in F1 sprint qualifying at Zandvoort, where the top four drivers were separated by less than a tenth of a second.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：拉塞尔冲刺赛排位赛夺杆，安东内利仅列第五
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔以微弱优势击败卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯，夺得杆位。拉塞尔在SQ3中跑出最快圈速，仅领先诺里斯0.041秒，这是他2026赛季的第三个冲刺赛杆位。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Russell takes pole in tight sprint qualifying with Antonelli fifth
items.summaryEn: George Russell took pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race, beating reigning world champion Lando Norris by just 0.041s. It was Russell's third sprint pole of the 2026 season, while championship leader Kimi Antonelli qualified only fifth.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛：拉塞尔力压诺里斯夺得杆位
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔以0.041秒的微弱优势击败卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯，夺得杆位，这是他继上海站之后本赛季第二个冲刺赛杆位。F1冠军领跑者基米·安东内利仅列第五。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: George Russell clinches tight sprint pole ahead of Lando Norris
items.summaryEn: George Russell took pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint, beating reigning world champion Lando Norris by only 0.041s. It was his second sprint pole of the season after Shanghai, while F1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli finished fifth.

items.titleZh: F1 2026荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛：拉塞尔夺得杆位
items.summaryZh: 在F1荷兰大奖赛赞德福特赛道竞争激烈的冲刺排位赛中，乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，为冲刺赛赢得有利发车位置。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 Dutch GP sprint qualifying results
items.summaryEn: George Russell took pole position for the sprint race at Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix, topping a closely contested sprint qualifying session at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯曾担心同时失去塞恩斯和阿尔本，直至二人续约
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队负责人詹姆斯·沃尔斯承认，在车队2026赛季表现灾难性的情况下，他曾担心同时失去卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿尔本，所幸两位车手随后均选择续约。
items.titleEn: Williams was "concerned about losing both" Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon before contract extensions
items.summaryEn: Williams team principal James Vowles admitted he feared losing both Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon after the team's disastrous 2026 campaign, before both drivers committed their futures to the team.

items.titleZh: 奥利弗·贝尔曼承认哈斯已沦为F1“第十强”车队
items.summaryZh: 奥利弗·贝尔曼情绪低落地承认，随着阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利大奖赛完成超越，哈斯车队目前是F1中的“第十强”车队。
items.titleEn: Regressing Haas "10th best" in F1 after Aston Martin upgrades - Oliver Bearman
items.summaryEn: A downbeat Oliver Bearman has accepted that Haas is now the "10th best team" in Formula 1 after being overtaken by Aston Martin at the Hungarian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索：确认F1未来没有时间表
items.summaryZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索确认，关于其F1未来的决定没有时间表，因为他仍在等待与劳伦斯·斯特罗尔和阿德里安·纽维的会谈。这位45岁车手与阿斯顿·马丁的合同将于2026赛季末到期，其退役传闻四起。
items.titleEn: Fernando Alonso: No timeframe on confirming F1 future
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso has confirmed there is no timeline on the decision regarding his Formula 1 future as he is still awaiting talks with Lawrence Stroll and Adrian Newey. The 45-year-old's Aston Martin contract expires at the end of the 2026 season, with talk of his possible retirement swirling.

items.titleZh: 2026荷兰大奖赛唯一练习赛：安东内利力压诺里斯登顶
items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛唯一一次练习赛中以1分12秒949的最快圈击败兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦，登顶圈速榜，开启2026赛季下半程。
items.titleEn: What happened in only Dutch GP F1 2026 practice session
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli topped the sole practice session at the Dutch Grand Prix with a 1m12.949s lap, beating Lando Norris's McLaren as the second half of the 2026 Formula 1 season began.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛练习赛：安东内利力压诺里斯，红牛表现不佳
items.summaryZh: 在F1夏休期后的荷兰大奖赛练习赛中，梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利以1分12秒949排名第一，是唯一跑进1分13秒以内的车手。迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯以1分13秒070位列第二，红牛车队表现不佳。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Antonelli pips Norris in practice amid poor showing for Red Bull
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli topped the sole practice session for the Dutch Grand Prix with a 1m12.949s lap, the only driver to dip below 1m13s, while McLaren's Lando Norris was second on 1m13.070s. Red Bull had a poor session, with Max Verstappen 11th and Liam Lawson 14th.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：安东内利领跑赞德福特唯一练习赛，红牛挣扎
items.summaryZh: 夏休期后F1荷兰大奖赛唯一练习赛中，梅赛德斯车手安东内利以1分12秒949位居榜首，是唯一跑进1分13秒以内的车手，迈凯伦的诺里斯以1分13秒070紧随其后，红牛表现挣扎。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Kimi Antonelli tops sole Zandvoort practice as Red Bull struggles
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli topped the sole Dutch Grand Prix practice at Zandvoort with a 1m12.949s lap, the only driver under 1m13s, while McLaren's reigning world champion Lando Norris was second with a 1m13.070s as Red Bull struggled.

items.titleZh: 安东内利领跑赞德福特练习赛，红牛未进前十
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛唯一一次练习赛中，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利在潮湿但逐渐变干的赛道上做出最快圈速领跑，诺里斯紧随其后，而红牛车队未能进入前十。
items.titleEn: Antonelli leads Norris in Zandvoort practice, no Red Bulls in top 10
items.summaryEn: Andrea Kimi Antonelli led the sole practice session for the Dutch Grand Prix on a damp but drying track, with Lando Norris close behind, while neither Red Bull appeared in the top 10.

items.titleZh: F1 2026荷兰大奖赛练习赛结果出炉
items.summaryZh: F1在夏季休赛期后重返赛道，于赞德沃特赛道进行荷兰大奖赛的练习赛。本周末仅有一次练习赛，车手们需在周五下午冲刺排位赛前进入最佳状态。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 Dutch Grand Prix practice results
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has returned from the summer break with practice for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort. With only a single practice session this weekend, drivers had to find the right window before sprint qualifying on Friday afternoon.

items.titleZh: 帕尔默质疑奥康在哈斯的未来："真的麻烦了"
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手乔利恩·帕尔默认为，埃斯特班·奥康与哈斯车队关系紧张，其在车队的未来"真的麻烦了"。随着维斯塔潘承诺留红牛至2030年底、塞恩斯和阿尔本与威廉姆斯续约，2027年车手阵容逐渐成形，奥康的席位受到质疑。
items.titleEn: Jolyon Palmer casts doubt on Esteban Ocon's Haas F1 future: "Really in trouble"
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Jolyon Palmer believes Esteban Ocon is "really in trouble" at Haas amid a strained relationship with the team. As the 2027 grid takes shape following Verstappen's commitment to Red Bull and Sainz and Albon's contract extensions with Williams, Ocon's seat is being questioned.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦褶皱式尾翼亮相荷兰大奖赛F1升级套件
items.summaryZh: 在F1荷兰大奖赛前夕，迈凯伦推出最新尾翼升级，其引人注目的褶皱式端板设计成为围场内的焦点。
items.titleEn: Crinkled McLaren rear wing among Dutch GP F1 upgrades
items.summaryEn: Ahead of the Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix, McLaren's latest rear wing upgrade has drawn attention thanks to its striking rippled endplate design, which has become a focal point in the paddock.

items.titleZh: 角田裕毅重返F1面临"疯狂"挑战
items.summaryZh: F1 TV分析员乔利恩·帕尔默和亚历克斯·布伦德尔警告称，角田裕毅在赞德福特站代表小红牛车队重返F1将面临"疯狂"的任务，因为他此前从未驾驶过2026规格的赛车。
items.titleEn: Yuki Tsunoda warned of "insane" challenge ahead of Racing Bulls F1 return
items.summaryEn: F1 TV analysts Jolyon Palmer and Alex Brundle have warned that Yuki Tsunoda faces an "insane" task returning to F1 with Racing Bulls at Zandvoort, as he has never previously driven the 2026-spec car.

items.titleZh: 利安·劳森感激回归红牛，但预计复出将“艰难”
items.summaryZh: 利安·劳森在假期后返回英国时，接到车队领队阿兰·珀曼的电话，得知伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕受伤，他将顶替出战荷兰大奖赛。劳森对此表示感激，但也预计在红牛的复出将充满挑战。
items.titleEn: Why 'grateful' Liam Lawson is expecting a 'tough' F1 return at Red Bull
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson received a call from team principal Alan Permane upon returning to the UK, learning that Isack Hadjar had injured his wrist and that he would substitute at the Dutch GP. Lawson says he is grateful for the chance but expects his Red Bull return to be tough.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘续约红牛后F1车手市场的下一步走向
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年底，这几乎排除了2026年F1前四强车队明年阵容的重大变动，但车手市场仍有一些悬而未决的问题待解决。
items.titleEn: What's next for F1's driver market after Verstappen's new deal
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen's recommitment to Red Bull until the end of 2030 has all but ruled out major changes among F1 2026's top four teams next year, but several interesting driver market questions remain unresolved.

items.titleZh: 告别赞德福特：F1荷兰大奖赛迎来最后一届
items.summaryZh: 本周末，F1将在赞德福特沙丘间的海滨赛道最后一次举办荷兰大奖赛，这是Motorsport.com作者们回顾的赛道最美好瞬间。
items.titleEn: Goodbye Zandvoort: Our writers' highlights from F1's Dutch Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 will race for the final time around the sand dunes of Zandvoort this weekend as the seaside circuit hosts its last Dutch Grand Prix, and Motorsport.com writers look back on their favourite memories there.

items.titleZh: 告别赞德福特：F1荷兰大奖赛的难忘瞬间
items.summaryZh: 赞德福特赛道本周末最后一次举办F1荷兰大奖赛。该赛道2021年重返赛历后宣布于2024年底退出，Autosport记者们回顾了他们在赞德福特的美好回忆。
items.titleEn: Farewell Zandvoort: Our writers' personal highlights from the F1 Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Zandvoort will host its final F1 Dutch Grand Prix this weekend after announcing its exit from the calendar at the end of 2024, following its return in 2021. Autosport's writers look back on their fondest memories from the seaside circuit.

items.titleZh: 角田裕毅重返F1：享受赞德福特并拓宽2027年选择
items.summaryZh: 因伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕受伤，角田裕毅本周末将重返F1，代表小红牛车队出战赞德福特站，并希望借此机会证明自己、改善未来前景。
items.titleEn: Yuki Tsunoda's Zandvoort goals: Have fun and widen 2027 options
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda will return to F1 this weekend at Zandvoort, taking the Racing Bulls seat after Isack Hadjar's wrist injury. He understands the circumstances will be challenging but wants to use the chance to prove himself.

items.titleZh: 前F1车队领队：维斯塔潘尚未达到巅峰
items.summaryZh: 前F1车队领队奥特马尔·萨夫瑙尔认为，马克斯·维斯塔潘尽管已获得四个F1世界冠军，仍在不断进步，尚未达到巅峰表现。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen is yet to reach his peak, says former F1 team boss
items.summaryEn: Former F1 team principal Otmar Szafnauer believes that Max Verstappen, despite having already won four F1 championships, is still improving and has yet to reach his peak performance.

items.titleZh: 卡伦·钱多克对维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年表示“惊讶”
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手、天空体育分析师卡伦·钱多克表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年底，显示他相信车队自研动力单元项目的长期潜力。维斯塔潘目前排名车手积分榜第六，红牛本赛季常只有第四快的赛车。
items.titleEn: Karun Chandhok "surprised" by length of Max Verstappen's Red Bull contract
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver and Sky Sports analyst Karun Chandhok says Max Verstappen's Red Bull contract extension until the end of 2030 shows his confidence in the team's long-term in-house power unit programme. Verstappen currently sits sixth in the drivers' championship, with Red Bull often fielding the fourth-fastest car this season.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：周五赛程、天气预报及观赛指南
items.summaryZh: F1夏季休整后本周末重返赞德沃特，荷兰大奖赛将开启2026赛季的最后阶段，本站为冲刺赛周末。诺里斯在匈牙利站取得赛季首胜，安东内利仍领跑车手积分榜。
items.titleEn: F1 Dutch GP: Friday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 returns from its summer break at Zandvoort this weekend, with the Dutch GP starting the final stretch of the 2026 season as a sprint weekend. Lando Norris took his first win of the campaign in Hungary, while Kimi Antonelli still leads the championship.

items.titleZh: 乔治·拉塞尔分享夏休期向卡门·蒙特罗·蒙特求婚细节
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1车手乔治·拉塞尔在夏休期间向长期伴侣卡门·蒙特罗·蒙特求婚成功，并分享了订婚细节。
items.titleEn: George Russell shares details of summer break proposal to partner Carmen Montero Mundt
items.summaryEn: Mercedes Formula 1 driver George Russell announced his engagement to long-term partner Carmen Montero Mundt during the summer break and shared details of the proposal.

items.titleZh: “必须有所改变”——布德科夫斯基执掌凯迪拉克F1面临的课题
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队赛季中期出人意料地更换车队负责人，新任领队马钦·布德科夫斯基需要纠正新车队的缺陷并加快进步速度。
items.titleEn: “Something needed to change” – Inside Cadillac’s dramatic F1 reset
items.summaryEn: The Cadillac F1 team made a surprise mid-season change of team principal, with new boss Marcin Budkowski tasked with correcting the fledgling squad's flaws and accelerating its progress.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛首日：周四发布会要点汇总
items.summaryZh: F1夏休期结束后在赞德沃特迎来荷兰大奖赛，周四发布会上维斯塔潘、塞恩斯、阿隆索等车手及新任车队负责人首次发声，透露多项重要信息。
items.titleEn: Everything we learned from day one at F1's Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: F1 returned from the summer break at Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix, where Thursday's press conference featured first comments from drivers like Max Verstappen, Carlos Sainz and Fernando Alonso as well as new team bosses.

items.titleZh: 美国前驻英大使罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊入股阿斯顿·马丁F1车队
items.summaryZh: 美国前驻英国大使罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊已收购阿斯顿·马丁F1车队的少数股权，这是一项纯商业投资。
items.titleEn: Ex-US ambassador takes stake in Aston Martin F1 team
items.summaryEn: Former US ambassador to the United Kingdom Robert Wood Johnson has acquired a minority stake in the Aston Martin Formula 1 Team in what is described as a purely commercial investment.

items.titleZh: 美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊收购阿斯顿·马丁F1少数股权
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁已将其F1车队的少数股权出售给美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊，后者将加入董事会担任副主席。约翰逊是强生制药帝国的继承人，也是NFL球队纽约喷气机队的老板，去年还收购了英超球队水晶宫的主要股份。
items.titleEn: US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson acquires minor Aston Martin F1 stake
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin has sold a minority stake in its Formula 1 team to US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson, who joins the board of directors as vice chairman. Johnson, an heir of the Johnson & Johnson pharmaceutical empire, also owns the New York Jets NFL team and acquired a major stake in Premier League football team Crystal Palace last year.

items.titleZh: 美国亿万富翁伍迪·约翰逊收购阿斯顿·马丁F1车队少数股权
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1车队将少数股权出售给美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊，后者将加入董事会担任副主席。
items.titleEn: US billionaire Woody Johnson acquires minor Aston Martin F1 stake
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin has sold a minority stake in its Formula 1 team to US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson, who joins the board of directors as vice chairman.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘曾考虑离开F1，最终决定与红牛续约
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘表示，在考虑是否继续留在F1后，他决定与红牛续约，并将“接受”F1中不受欢迎的动力单元规则。
items.titleEn: Verstappen considered leaving F1 before deciding to renew Red Bull deal
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen says he considered whether he wanted to keep racing in Formula 1 before deciding to sign a new deal to drive for Red Bull. He will remain at Red Bull until at least 2030 and is prepared to tolerate the power unit regulations until then.

items.titleZh: TWG否认出售凯迪拉克F1车队
items.summaryZh: TWG否认凯迪拉克F1车队将被出售。此前其CEO马克·沃尔特因涉嫌欺诈和掩盖行为正接受美国司法部和证券交易委员会调查，并已出售其在洛杉矶湖人队的股份。
items.titleEn: TWG denies sale of Cadillac F1 team
items.summaryEn: TWG has denied that the Cadillac F1 team is up for sale. This follows an investigation into CEO Mark Walter by US authorities over alleged fraud and a cover-up scheme, and his recent sale of his stake in the Los Angeles Lakers.

items.titleZh: TWG否认出售凯迪拉克F1车队，此前马克·沃尔特遭美国当局调查
items.summaryZh: TWG公司首席执行官马克·沃尔特正受到美国当局调查，引发凯迪拉克F1车队可能被出售的传闻，TWG已对此予以否认。
items.titleEn: TWG denies sale of Cadillac F1 team following investigation into Mark Walter
items.summaryEn: TWG has denied rumours that the Cadillac F1 team is for sale after CEO Mark Walter came under investigation by US authorities. The billionaire recently sold his stake in the Los Angeles Lakers and is reportedly considering selling shares in other sports ventures.

items.titleZh: 角田裕毅透露海滩电话促成意外F1回归
items.summaryZh: 角田裕毅在希腊度假时于周二意外接到电话，因伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕受伤而重返F1，参加荷兰大奖赛。
items.titleEn: Yuki Tsunoda reveals beach phone call that led to surprise F1 return
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda received an unexpected call on Tuesday while on holiday in Greece, returning to F1 at the Dutch GP after Isack Hadjar injured his wrist during the summer break.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘突然承诺与红牛续约至2030年，原因何在？
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在与车队多年猜测和谈判后，重新承诺留在红牛，合同延长至2030年。
items.titleEn: Why Verstappen has suddenly committed to Red Bull until 2030
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has recommitted to Red Bull with a deal lasting until 2030 after years of speculation and talks with other teams. The contract will make the Verstappen-Red Bull partnership the longest driver-team pairing in F1 history.

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德捐赠比利时大奖赛头盔，为麦金太尔iMRI项目筹款6万英镑
items.summaryZh: 小红牛（小红牛）一级方程式车手阿维德·林德布拉德通过静默拍卖其比利时大奖赛头盔，为威尔·麦金太尔的iMRI筹款活动筹集了6万英镑。这笔资金将用于支持由18岁英国车手麦金太尔发起的600万英镑项目，旨在为剑桥阿登布鲁克医院购置一台术中磁共振成像扫描仪。
items.titleEn: Arvid Lindblad donates Belgian GP helmet raising £60,000 for Will MacIntyre's iMRI campaign
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls Formula 1 driver Arvid Lindblad has raised £60,000 for Will MacIntyre's iMRI campaign through a silent auction of his Belgian Grand Prix helmet. The funds will support Project iMRI, a £6million fundraising campaign led by the 18-year-old British driver to purchase a state-of-the-art intra-operative MRI scanner at Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘续约红牛后，2027年F1车手阵容初现端倪
items.summaryZh: F1夏季休赛期结束后一周内出现三项2027年车手续约公告，包括维斯塔潘与红牛的新合同。这些续约而非转会表明当前车手市场处于“理性赛季”，预计还会有更多续约消息。
items.titleEn: How the 2027 F1 grid is shaping up after Verstappen's Red Bull new deal
items.summaryEn: Three 2027 driver contract announcements emerged in the same week after F1's summer break, including Max Verstappen's new deal with Red Bull. These renewals rather than transfers indicate the current driver market is in a "sensible season," with more extensions expected.

items.titleZh: 2027年F1车手阵容初现端倪：维斯塔潘续约红牛后格局渐明
items.summaryZh: 夏休期结束后一周内相继出现三项2027年车手合同公告，但均为续约而非转会，包括马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛的续约，2027年车手阵容正逐步成形。
items.titleEn: How the 2027 F1 grid is shaping up after Max Verstappen's Red Bull renewal
items.summaryEn: Three 2027 driver announcements emerged in the same week after the summer break, but all were contract renewals rather than moves, including Max Verstappen's extension with Red Bull. The 2027 grid is gradually taking shape as the driver market's 'silly season' gives way to a more sensible one.

items.titleZh: 博塔斯亮相《副驾公主》节目 停车环节出糗
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车手瓦尔特里·博塔斯近日做客阿梅莉亚·迪莫尔登伯格的YouTube系列节目《副驾公主》，在该集练习紧急停车和侧方停车时出现停车失误。
items.titleEn: Valtteri Bottas suffers parking blunder in Amelia Dimoldenberg's "Passenger Princess"
items.summaryEn: Cadillac F1 driver Valtteri Bottas recently appeared on Amelia Dimoldenberg's YouTube series Passenger Princess, where he suffered a parking blunder while practising emergency stops and parallel parking.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘续约红牛至2030年，称“更接近退役而非转会”
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛车队续约至2030年，结束了数月来关于他未来的猜测。他表示自己此前“更接近退役而非转会”，原因主要是对本季新规则的不满而非对红牛赛车竞争力下滑的失望。
items.titleEn: Why Max Verstappen was 'closer to retiring than changing teams'
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has renewed his contract with Red Bull until 2030, ending months of speculation about his future. He said he was previously "closer to retiring than changing teams", with his dislike of the new regulations being a bigger factor than dissatisfaction with Red Bull's car.

items.titleZh: 前F1主持人：本田对阿斯顿·马丁引擎升级表现出“十足信心”
items.summaryZh: 前F1电视主持人威尔·巴克斯顿表示，本田对其即将推出的动力单元升级表现出真正的信心，认为这将为阿斯顿·马丁在赞德福特的荷兰大奖赛带来显著进步。
items.titleEn: Honda showing "level of certainty" over Aston Martin F1 engine upgrade, says former F1 TV host
items.summaryEn: Former F1 TV presenter Will Buxton believes Honda is showing genuine certainty that its upcoming power unit upgrade will deliver a significant step forward for Aston Martin at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 天空体育F1评论员：是时候改变对安东内利的叙事
items.summaryZh: 前W系列车手、天空体育F1分析师娜奥米·希夫表示，人们应停止将基米·安东内利视为青少年新秀，而应认可他已成为真正的F1冠军争夺者。
items.titleEn: It is time to change the narrative around Kimi Antonelli, says Sky F1 pundit
items.summaryEn: Former W Series driver and Sky Sports F1 analyst Naomi Schiff says people must stop treating Kimi Antonelli as a teenage novelty and recognise him as a genuine Formula 1 title contender.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与红牛续约，车迷调侃“愚蠢赛季”提前结束
items.summaryZh: 四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛车队签订为期两年的续约合同，结束了此前他与梅赛德斯和迈凯伦的转会传闻，车迷们纷纷调侃“愚蠢赛季”已经结束。
items.titleEn: F1 fans declare silly season over after Max Verstappen Red Bull contract announcement
items.summaryEn: Four-time champion Max Verstappen has signed a two-year contract extension with Red Bull, ending speculation linking him to Mercedes and McLaren, and prompting F1 fans to joke that the silly season is already over.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队所有者就出售传闻发表强硬声明
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队的所有者TWG Global表示车队不在出售考虑之列，此声明是在美国联邦对亿万富翁马克·沃尔特旗下公司展开调查的背景下发布的。
items.titleEn: Cadillac F1 team owner issues firm statement over sale talk
items.summaryEn: TWG Global, the owner of the Cadillac Formula 1 team, says the team is not being considered for sale, amid a US federal investigation into billionaire Mark Walter's business empire.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年，转会传闻平息
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘确认与红牛车队签订新合同，将再效力三个F1赛季至2030年，终结了他可能转投梅赛德斯或迈凯轮的传闻。
items.titleEn: What does Max Verstappen's new contract say about Red Bull and his F1 future? Our writers have their say
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has confirmed a new contract with Red Bull that will keep him at the team for three more Formula 1 seasons until 2030, ending rumours of a switch to Mercedes or McLaren.

items.titleZh: 前F1车手批评汉密尔顿与法拉利错失良机：失误“相当草率”
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手乔利恩·帕尔默认为，法拉利和刘易斯·汉密尔顿未能利用梅赛德斯罕见的弱点，并称一系列失误“相当草率”。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari called out by former F1 driver for "pretty sloppy" errors
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Jolyon Palmer believes Ferrari and Lewis Hamilton are failing to capitalise on Mercedes' rare vulnerabilities, labelling a string of mistakes as "pretty sloppy".

items.titleZh: 欣奇克利夫质疑沃尔夫与安托内利父亲商讨罚退计划
items.summaryZh: 前IndyCar车手、F1评论员詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫质疑梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫就F1动力单元罚退事宜咨询基米·安托内利父亲的做法。
items.titleEn: James Hinchcliffe questions "very telling" detail of Toto Wolff's Kimi Antonelli penalty plan
items.summaryEn: Former IndyCar driver and F1 commentator James Hinchcliffe questioned Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff's approach of consulting Kimi Antonelli's father about F1 power unit penalty plans.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘续约红牛至2030年，续约决定令人意外
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛车队续约，若履行新合同将效力至2030年底，这一消息颇为出人意料。
items.titleEn: Our verdict on Verstappen committing to Red Bull after all
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has extended his contract with Red Bull, which would keep him at the team until the end of 2030 if he sees it out, a surprising development given constant speculation over his future.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与红牛新约：赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 在超过一年的续约悬念之后，马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛签下一份重磅新合同，尽管表面维持现状，却立即重塑了F1车手市场的格局。The 比赛分析了这一消息的赢家与输家。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from Verstappen's big new Red Bull F1 deal
items.summaryEn: After more than a year of intrigue about his future, Max Verstappen has signed a major new contract with Red Bull, which instantly reshapes the F1 driver market despite seemingly maintaining the status quo. The Race looks at the winners and losers from the news.

items.titleZh: 2027年F1车手阵容：已确认车手汇总
items.summaryZh: 2027年F1赛季的车手阵容尚未出现剧变，本文汇总了目前所有已确认的2027年席位及所属车队。
items.titleEn: The 2027 F1 grid: Every confirmed driver
items.summaryEn: The 2027 F1 grid has so far not seen the seismic changes some expected, and this article compiles all confirmed driver seats and their teams for the season.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘意外续约红牛至2030赛季
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘已与红牛车队续约，将留队至2030赛季结束。
items.titleEn: Verstappen signs surprise new Red Bull deal
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has extended his contract with Red Bull Racing and will remain with the team until the end of the 2030 season.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年底
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘已与红牛车队签订新合同，效力至2030年底，平息了关于他未来的猜测。红牛车队现已确认了他的长期承诺。
items.titleEn: Verstappen commits to Red Bull until end of F1 2030
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has signed a new contract with Red Bull until the end of 2030, ending speculation about his future. Red Bull has now confirmed his long-term commitment.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年底
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛车队签订新合同，将效力至2030年底，平息了关于他未来的猜测。红牛车队确认了这一续约消息。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen commits to Red Bull until end of F1 2030
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has signed a new contract with Red Bull that will keep him at the team until the end of 2030, ending speculation about his future. Red Bull confirmed the extension.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘与红牛续约至2030年，结束未来猜测
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘已与红牛车队签署新合同，将至少效力至2030年，从而结束了关于他未来的猜测。
items.titleEn: Verstappen ends speculation over future by committing to Red Bull until 2030
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has signed a new deal with Red Bull which will keep him at the team until at least 2030, ending speculation about his future.

items.titleZh: 阿尔本称2026新规削弱其最大优势
items.summaryZh: 续约威廉姆斯的阿尔本认为，2026年F1新规削弱了他的关键优势，这或许可以部分解释他本赛季的挣扎表现。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 has neutered Albon's biggest strengths
items.summaryEn: Alex Albon, who has recommitted to Williams, believes the 2026 F1 regulations have neutered his key strengths, which might partly explain his difficult season.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔是否已错失夺冠良机？
items.summaryZh: The 比赛 分析乔治·拉塞尔在夏休期后能否反弹，还是已经浪费了争夺总冠军的机会，文章引用评论称他的机会看起来正在消失。
items.titleEn: Has Russell already blown his big title chance?
items.summaryEn: The Race analyses whether George Russell can bounce back in the second half of the F1 season or has already wasted his chance to fight for the title, citing comments that his opportunities appear to be fading.

items.titleZh: 劳森在2026年荷兰大奖赛迎来命运轮回时刻
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森将在2026年荷兰大奖赛顶替因手部受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔代表红牛出场，这与他2023年在赞德沃特替补丹尼尔·里卡多完成首秀的情形如出一辙。
items.titleEn: The full circle moment given to Lawson at the 2026 Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson will return for Red Bull at the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix, replacing the injured Isack Hadjar, echoing his 2023 F1 debut at Zandvoort when he stood in for Daniel Ricciardo.

items.titleZh: 利亚姆·劳森意外获红牛召唤，坚持不懈终得回报
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森因伊萨克·哈贾尔手部受伤，将在赞德沃特举行的荷兰大奖赛上再次临时替补红牛旗下车手出战，这正是他2023年首次亮相F1并替补丹尼尔·里卡多的同一条赛道。
items.titleEn: Liam Lawson's unexpected Red Bull call-up rewards his perseverance
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson will once again step in as a temporary replacement for an injured Red Bull driver at the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, the same circuit where he made his Formula 1 debut substituting for Daniel Ricciardo in 2023. His perseverance is being rewarded despite a difficult first stint with the squad.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛前瞻：五大看点不容错过
items.summaryZh: F1将于本周末在赞德福特赛道迎来2026年夏休期后的回归，荷兰大奖赛标志着赛季进入中点，冠军争夺和下赛季车手席位的归属都将逐渐明朗。
items.titleEn: Five things to look out for at the F1 Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 returns from its 2026 summer shutdown this weekend with the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, which marks the halfway point of the season. The race promises championship battles and the fight for seats on next season's grid.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯留住塞恩斯和阿尔本：留队是否正确？
items.summaryZh: 在2026赛季表现不佳之际，威廉姆斯车队成功说服卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿尔本留队。塞恩斯签署了新的多年合同，而阿尔本的2027年确认据The 比赛了解并非新比赛合同，而是与原合同中的退出条款有关。
items.titleEn: Fortunate? Our verdict on Williams retaining Sainz and Albon
items.summaryEn: Amid a troubled 2026 Formula 1 season, Williams has convinced Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon to stay with the team. Sainz has agreed to a new multi-year commitment, while according to The Race, Albon's confirmation for 2027 relates to exit clauses in his existing contract rather than a new racing deal.

items.titleZh: 加斯利摩纳哥领奖台听证会将闭门进行
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联国际上诉法院关于皮埃尔·加斯利在F1摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台位置恢复的听证会将于下周闭门举行。
items.titleEn: Why Gasly podium hearing will take place in private
items.summaryEn: The FIA International Court of Appeal hearing on Pierre Gasly's reinstated Monaco Grand Prix podium will take place next week, unusually behind closed doors.

items.titleZh: 谁应入选F1总统山？Motorsport邀读者选出最伟大的四位车手
items.summaryZh: Motorsport联合Autosport和Yahoo的10位记者此前评选出F1史上最伟大的25位车手，榜首出现并列，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与其他车手并列第一。如今媒体发起互动，邀请读者从75年多的大奖赛历史中选出心中定义这项运动的四位车手。
items.titleEn: Who belongs on F1's Mount Rushmore? Pick your four greatest drivers
items.summaryEn: Motorsport, together with a panel of 10 journalists from Autosport and Yahoo, previously ranked the 25 greatest F1 drivers, with Lewis Hamilton tying for first place. Readers are now invited to choose the four drivers who define the sport from more than 75 years of grand prix racing.

items.titleZh: 评论：萨因茨在威廉姆斯被浪费
items.summaryZh: 《The 比赛》专栏作者埃德·斯特劳撰文指出，刚刚与威廉姆斯续约的卡洛斯·萨因茨正被浪费在F1中游车队的末尾，尽管他本赛季整体表现十分出色。
items.titleEn: Sainz is being wasted at Williams
items.summaryEn: In a column for The Race, Ed Straw argues that Carlos Sainz, who has just re-signed with Williams, is being wasted at the back end of F1's midfield despite an outstanding season.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯确认2027年F1阵容，塞恩斯续约
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队宣布与卡洛斯·塞恩斯签订多年续约合同，确认2027年F1车手阵容。此前一天，队友亚历克斯·阿尔本仅同意续约一年。
items.titleEn: Williams confirms F1 2027 line-up with Sainz extension
items.summaryEn: Williams has announced a multi-year contract extension for Carlos Sainz, confirming its 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up. The news comes a day after team-mate Alex Albon agreed to just a one-season extension.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯说服塞恩斯签下多年续约合同
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯已与威廉姆斯签下一份多年期合同续约，将自己在F1的近期未来交给车队，尽管2026赛季开局艰难。
items.titleEn: Williams convinces Sainz to sign multi-year extension
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz has signed a multi-year contract extension to commit his immediate Formula 1 future to Williams, despite a difficult start to 2026.

items.titleZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯确认2027年继续效力威廉姆斯
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队宣布与卡洛斯·塞恩斯签署多年续约协议，确认其将在2027赛季继续效力，此前一天队友亚历克斯·阿尔本仅续约一年。
items.titleEn: Carlos Sainz to remain at Williams for F1 2027
items.summaryEn: Williams has confirmed Carlos Sainz will remain with the team into the 2027 Formula 1 season after signing a multi-year deal, coming a day after team-mate Alex Albon agreed to just a one-season extension.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯与威廉姆斯续签多年合同
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯与威廉姆斯车队签署一份新的多年合同，延长效力承诺。
items.titleEn: Sainz extends contract to drive for Williams with new “multi-year” deal
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz has signed a new multi-year contract with Williams, extending his commitment to the team.

items.titleZh: 施泰纳：F1与MotoGP联合赛事五年内或成真
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯车队负责人冈瑟·施泰纳认为，在Liberty Media收购MotoGP后，F1与MotoGP联合举办比赛周末可能在五年内成为现实，银石等赛道或成举办地。
items.titleEn: Guenther Steiner "wouldn't discount" F1-MotoGP double-header within five years
items.summaryEn: Former Haas F1 team principal Guenther Steiner believes a joint F1 and MotoGP race weekend could become reality within five years following Liberty Media's acquisition of MotoGP, with circuits like Silverstone possible hosts.

items.titleZh: 库特哈德预测赞德福特将永久告别F1赛历
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手大卫·库特哈德认为，受赛道物理条件和商业需求的严重限制，F1将永远不会重返赞德福特。本周末的荷兰大奖赛将是该滨海赛道在F1的最后一场比赛。
items.titleEn: David Coulthard predicts Zandvoort will never return to F1 calendar
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver David Coulthard believes Formula 1 will never return to Zandvoort, citing severe physical and commercial constraints. This weekend's Dutch Grand Prix will be the coastal circuit's final F1 race.

items.titleZh: 劳森意外回归红牛出赛赞德福特，替补角色无压力迎战
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森意外代表红牛车队出赛赞德福特站，《The 比赛》撰文称这是一次“零风险”的机会，表现不佳不应被苛责，而任何成绩都将提升他的声誉。
items.titleEn: What's really at stake for Lawson on shock Red Bull F1 return
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson's unexpected appearance for Red Bull Racing at Zandvoort is described as a free hit, where failure is the baseline expectation but any achievement would enhance his reputation. Ed Straw argues that the lack of pressure gives Lawson the ideal conditions to succeed.

items.titleZh: FIA下周审理迈凯伦与红牛对摩纳哥大奖赛的上诉
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联（FIA）将于8月25日闭门审理迈凯伦和红牛对摩纳哥大奖赛恢复皮埃尔·加斯利领奖台决定的上诉。加斯利因两次维修区超速被罚时5秒跌至第七，复审后其第三名成绩被恢复，引发多支车队不满。
items.titleEn: FIA to hear McLaren and Red Bull's Monaco GP appeal next week
items.summaryEn: The FIA will hear appeals from McLaren and Red Bull on 25 August against the decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's podium at the Monaco Grand Prix. Gasly was demoted to seventh after two five-second penalties for pitlane speeding, but his third-place finish was reinstated following a right of review.

items.titleZh: FIA确定迈凯伦与红牛摩纳哥大奖赛上诉听证日期
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联（FIA）将于下周审理迈凯伦和红牛针对摩纳哥大奖赛恢复皮埃尔·加斯利领奖台位置决定的上诉。
items.titleEn: FIA sets date for McLaren and Red Bull's Monaco GP appeal
items.summaryEn: The FIA will hear McLaren and Red Bull's appeals next week regarding the decision to restore Pierre Gasly's podium position from the Monaco Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 劳森回归红牛 角田裕毅荷兰大奖赛复出
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森重返红牛车队，角田裕毅也回到F1赛场，The 比赛团队分析了红牛在哈贾尔手腕受伤后的应急人选安排。
items.titleEn: Our verdict on Lawson and Tsunoda's Dutch GP call-ups
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson is back in a Red Bull Racing Formula 1 car and Yuki Tsunoda has returned to the F1 grid at the Dutch Grand Prix. The Race team assesses Red Bull's contingency plan following Isack Hadjar's wrist injury.

items.titleZh: 劳森将顶替哈贾尔出战荷兰大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队官方确认，利亚姆·劳森将在本周末的F1荷兰大奖赛中顶替因手腕受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔。哈贾尔在夏季休赛期健身房训练中手腕受伤，无法参加赞德沃特站的比赛。
items.titleEn: Lawson to replace Hadjar at Red Bull for Dutch GP
items.summaryEn: Red Bull has officially confirmed that Liam Lawson will replace the injured Isack Hadjar at this weekend's Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix. Hadjar sustained a wrist injury during a gym session over the summer shutdown and will therefore miss the race at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因伤缺席F1荷兰大奖赛，红牛确认劳森替补
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队正式确认，利亚姆·劳森将在本周末的F1荷兰大奖赛中替补受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔。哈贾尔因在健身房训练时手腕受伤，将缺席赞德福特站的比赛。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar to miss F1 Dutch GP, Red Bull replacement confirmed
items.summaryEn: Red Bull has officially confirmed that Liam Lawson will replace the injured Isack Hadjar at this weekend's Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix. Hadjar sustained a wrist injury during a gym session and will therefore skip the race at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 劳森顶替受伤的哈贾尔，角田裕毅重返F1
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森将在赞德福特举行的荷兰大奖赛重返红牛F1车队，顶替手腕受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔，角田裕毅则被征召回归小红牛车队参赛。
items.titleEn: Lawson replaces injured Hadjar as Tsunoda gets F1 return
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson will return to the Red Bull Formula 1 team at the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, replacing the injured Isack Hadjar, while Yuki Tsunoda has been called up to race for the sister Racing Bulls team.

items.titleZh: F1车手如何度过2026年夏休期
items.summaryZh: F1的强制夏休期让围场在荷兰大奖赛前得到了宝贵的休整机会，车手们分享了各自在假期中度假、陪伴家人、庆祝和训练的点滴。
items.titleEn: How F1 drivers spent the 2026 summer beak
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's mandatory summer shutdown gave the paddock a much-needed chance to recharge ahead of the Dutch Grand Prix, and the drivers have shared how they spent their holidays, family time, celebrations and training.

items.titleZh: 官方：哈贾尔缺席荷兰大奖赛，劳森替补，角田回归
items.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕受伤将缺席本周末的荷兰大奖赛，利亚姆·劳森将从小红牛被召入替补参赛，而角田裕毅则回归小红牛填补劳森的空缺。
items.titleEn: Official: Hadjar to miss Dutch GP, Lawson will substitute and Tsunoda to return
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Dutch Grand Prix due to a wrist injury, prompting Red Bull to call up Liam Lawson from Racing Bulls as his replacement, while Yuki Tsunoda returns to Racing Bulls to fill Lawson's seat.

items.titleZh: F1发车程序保持不变，尽管FIA称其不再是安全问题
items.summaryZh: FIA的尼古拉斯·通巴齐斯表示，尽管安全问题已通过其他方式解决，F1起步程序中额外增加的五秒钟很可能在下赛季继续保持。
items.titleEn: F1 pre-start procedure to stay despite FIA saying it is no longer a safety issue
items.summaryEn: FIA's Nikolas Tombazis says the additional five seconds in F1's starting procedure are likely to remain next season, even though the safety concerns have been addressed in a different way.

items.titleZh: F1 2027年发车程序保持不变
items.summaryZh: FIA单座赛车总监Nikolas Tombazis表示，F1发车前的五秒预启动程序很可能在2027赛季继续保留，尽管相关安全担忧已通过其他方式解决。
items.titleEn: Pre-start procedure set to remain for F1 2027
items.summaryEn: FIA single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis has indicated that F1's five-second pre-start procedure is likely to remain in place for the 2027 season, even though the related safety concerns have been addressed through other means.

items.titleZh: 前F1主持人：没有格雷姆·洛登，凯迪拉克不会出现在发车格上
items.summaryZh: 前F1广播员威尔·巴克斯顿称赞格雷姆·洛登，称如果没有他，凯迪拉克车队就不会出现在今天的发车格上。凯迪拉克在夏休期间宣布，洛登在担任车队负责人的首个赛季仅11场比赛后被替换。
items.titleEn: Cadillac "wouldn't be on the grid" without Graeme Lowdon, says former F1 TV host
items.summaryEn: Former F1 broadcaster Will Buxton praised Graeme Lowdon, saying that without him the Cadillac team would not be on today's starting grid. Cadillac announced during the summer break that Lowdon was replaced after just 11 races in his first season as team principal.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔或因手腕伤势缺席F1荷兰大奖赛，红牛替补计划已就绪
items.summaryZh: 据Autosport报道，红牛二队车手伊萨克·哈贾尔在赞德沃特赛前的一次健身房训练中手腕受伤，可能被迫缺席荷兰大奖赛。车队尚未做出正式决定，但红牛已有替补计划，马克斯·维斯塔潘可能迎来不同的队友参加他的主场收官战。
items.titleEn: Hadjar could miss F1 Dutch GP with Red Bull replacement plan already in place
items.summaryEn: According to Autosport, Racing Bulls driver Isack Hadjar sustained a wrist injury during a gym session ahead of the Zandvoort race weekend and could be forced to miss the Dutch Grand Prix. The team has yet to make a formal decision, but a Red Bull replacement plan is already in place, meaning Max Verstappen could have a different team-mate for his final home race.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔手腕受伤或缺席荷兰大奖赛，红牛已有替补计划
items.summaryZh: 据Motorsport.com报道，红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔在赞德沃特赛前健身房训练中手腕受伤，可能缺席荷兰大奖赛。车队尚未做出正式决定，但据荷兰《电讯报》消息，替补计划已经就绪。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar could miss F1 Dutch GP with Red Bull replacement plan already in place
items.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar suffered a wrist injury during a gym session before the Zandvoort race weekend and could miss the Dutch Grand Prix. The team has not made a formal decision, but according to Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf, a replacement plan is already in place.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔因手腕伤势恐缺席荷兰大奖赛，劳森或意外回归红牛
items.summaryZh: 据消息，伊萨克·哈贾尔在夏休期手腕受伤，很可能缺席F1荷兰大奖赛，最终决定尚未做出。若他无法参赛，小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森有望意外重返红牛车队参赛。
items.titleEn: Hadjar in doubt for Dutch GP after wrist injury
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar picked up a wrist injury during the F1 summer break and is likely to miss the Dutch Grand Prix, though a final decision has not yet been made. If he cannot race, Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson could make a surprise return to Red Bull Racing.

items.titleZh: 荷兰大奖赛七大看点：维斯塔潘主场告别战
items.summaryZh: 本周末F1将告别赞德沃特赛道，维斯塔潘能否在主场夺冠成为焦点。此外，赛事还涉及政治话题，包括普京的宣传胜利。
items.titleEn: A home win for Verstappen? A propaganda win for Putin? Seven Dutch GP talking points
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 will say goodbye to the Zandvoort circuit this weekend, with Max Verstappen's chances of a home victory in the spotlight. The event also involves political topics, including a propaganda win for Vladimir Putin.

items.titleZh: FIA下周审理红牛与迈凯伦就加斯利处罚提出的上诉
items.summaryZh: 国际上诉法院将于8月25日审议红牛与迈凯伦针对加斯利在摩纳哥大奖赛所受处罚被撤销一事提出的上诉。
items.titleEn: FIA to hear Red Bull and McLaren’s appeal over Gasly’s penalties next week
items.summaryEn: The International Court of Appeal will hear appeals from Red Bull and McLaren on August 25th against the decision to rescind the penalties Pierre Gasly received at the Monaco Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 乌克兰敦促FIA逆转对俄罗斯参赛者的政策转变
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰政府致信国际汽联，要求其撤销近期允许俄罗斯人以本国国旗参加赛车运动的决定，并指责此举是在纵容“体育洗白”。
items.titleEn: Ukraine urges FIA to reverse its U-turn over Russian competitors in motorsport
items.summaryEn: The Ukrainian government has written to the FIA requesting it reverses its recent decision to allow Russians to compete in motorsport under their national flag, accusing the move of enabling sportswashing.

items.titleZh: 从零组建凯迪拉克F1赛道团队的挑战
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克车队在寻找车队经理时，迅速锁定了哈斯车队长期担任车队经理的彼得·克罗拉。克罗拉渴望新的挑战，并期待再次从零开始组建一支车队。
items.titleEn: "No nine to five cruise" - The challenge of assembling Cadillac's trackside F1 team from scratch
items.summaryEn: When new Formula 1 entrant Cadillac searched for a race team manager, it quickly identified Peter Crolla, who had long served as team manager at Haas. Crolla was eager for a new challenge and looked forward to building a team from scratch again.

items.titleZh: 马克·沃尔特出售洛杉矶湖人队：对凯迪拉克F1车队可能意味着什么
items.summaryZh: 亿万富翁马克·沃尔特在以100亿美元购入洛杉矶湖人队仅14个月后就宣布出售，这一交易可能对凯迪拉克F1车队产生影响。
items.titleEn: Mark Walter LA Lakers sale: what it could mean for Cadillac F1 team
items.summaryEn: Billionaire Mark Walter has announced the sale of the Los Angeles Lakers just 14 months after buying the NBA franchise for $10 billion, a move that could have implications for the Cadillac Formula 1 team.

items.titleZh: “不是朝九晚五的巡航”——从零组建凯迪拉克赛道团队的回报性挑战
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克在加入2026年F1赛程前一年开始寻找车队经理，很快锁定了哈斯车队长期任职的车队经理彼得·克罗拉。克罗拉寻求新挑战，并期待再次从零组建团队的机会。
items.titleEn: "No nine to five cruise" - The rewarding challenge of assembling Cadillac's trackside team from scratch
items.summaryEn: Cadillac began searching for a race team manager a full year before joining the 2026 Formula 1 grid and quickly identified long-serving Haas team manager Peter Crolla. Crolla was looking for a new challenge and saw the chance to build another team from the ground up as the perfect fit.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯宣布阿尔本续约至2027年
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队宣布亚历克斯·阿尔本将继续效力至2027年，这将是他在车队的第六个F1赛季，车队将其描述为合同“续约”。
items.titleEn: What we know as Williams unveils 'new' Albon F1 deal
items.summaryEn: Williams has announced that Alex Albon will stay with the team for a sixth Formula 1 season in 2027, describing it as a contract extension.

items.titleZh: 阿尔本与威廉姆斯续约至2027年
items.summaryZh: 亚历克斯·阿尔本已同意与威廉姆斯车队续签一年合同，将在2027年继续效力，这将是他在该车队的连续第六个F1赛季。队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯尚未承诺自己的未来。
items.titleEn: Albon commits to Williams F1 team for 2027
items.summaryEn: Alex Albon has agreed a one-year contract extension with Williams to stay for the 2027 season, which will be his sixth consecutive Formula 1 season with the team. Team-mate Carlos Sainz has yet to commit his own future.

items.titleZh: 阿尔本确认2027年继续效力威廉姆斯F1车队
items.summaryZh: 亚历克斯·阿尔本与威廉姆斯车队签署短期续约合同，将在2027赛季继续留队，这也是他在威廉姆斯的连续第六个赛季。
items.titleEn: Alex Albon commits to Williams F1 team for 2027
items.summaryEn: Alex Albon has agreed a short-term contract extension with Williams and will stay with the team for the 2027 season, his sixth consecutive year there.

items.titleZh: 阿尔本与威廉姆斯续约至2027年
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队宣布，亚历山大·阿尔本已签署新合同，将继续为车队效力至2027年。
items.titleEn: Albon signs new deal to remain at Williams in 2027
items.summaryEn: Williams has announced that Alexander Albon has signed a new contract to remain with the team through 2027.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿与舒马赫并列榜首：F1最伟大车手由你决定
items.summaryZh: Motorsport、Autosport和Yahoo Sports的10位记者各自提交历史前25名车手排名，综合结果显示刘易斯·汉密尔顿与迈克尔·舒马赫均以235分并列第一，两位七届世界冠军并列榜首的结果引发关于谁才是最伟大F1车手的讨论。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton vs Michael Schumacher: You decide F1's greatest driver
items.summaryEn: Ten journalists from Motorsport, Autosport and Yahoo Sports each submitted their top-25 all-time F1 driver rankings, and the combined result saw Lewis Hamilton and Michael Schumacher tied for first place with 235 points. The dead heat between the two seven-time world champions has sparked debate over who is the greatest F1 driver.

items.titleZh: 劳森2026赛季改变F1叙事：更快乐也更快
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森在2026赛季变得更加快乐且速度更快，这一点在积分榜上得到了体现。
items.titleEn: How Lawson's changed his F1 narrative during 2026
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson has become happier and faster in the 2026 season, and this is reflected in the championship standings.

items.titleZh: “我们需要限制它”——弗兰科·科拉平托谈及F1网络暴力
items.summaryZh: 弗兰科·科拉平托公开谈论F1中日益严重的网络暴力问题，认为尽管社交媒体增长是积极发展，但针对车手和工作人员的辱骂显著增加，需要设定限制。
items.titleEn: "We need to put a limit on it" – Franco Colapinto opens up about online abuse in F1
items.summaryEn: Franco Colapinto has spoken openly about the growing problem of online abuse in Formula 1, saying that while social media growth is positive, abuse directed at drivers and staff has risen sharply and limits need to be set.

items.titleZh: BP结束F1“流亡”：为何选择与奥迪合作
items.summaryZh: 英国石油公司BP在阔别F1数十年后，将于2026年携润滑油品牌嘉实多重返赛场，与奥迪车队合作。BP高层表示，与一支从零开始进入F1的车队共同成长，是这次合作最具吸引力的地方。
items.titleEn: Why a fuel giant ended its F1 exile
items.summaryEn: BP has returned to Formula 1 with Audi in 2026 after a decades-long absence, partnering alongside its lubricants brand Castrol. A BP executive says building a partnership with a team entering F1 from the very start is what made the collaboration so attractive.

items.titleZh: 斯泰纳谈与哈斯关系破裂：目前无任何联系
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯车队领队冈瑟·斯泰纳在离开车队后首次谈及与车队老板吉恩·哈斯的关系，确认两人目前"没有任何关系"。
items.titleEn: Guenther Steiner opens up on breakdown of relationship with Gene Haas
items.summaryEn: Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has confirmed that he currently has "no relationship" with team owner Gene Haas following his exit from the team.

items.titleZh: FIA：F1“马卡雷纳”尾翼将保留，红牛需做更多工作
items.summaryZh: FIA单座赛车主管尼古拉斯·通巴西斯表示，FIA对旋转式“马卡雷纳”尾翼的整体概念没有异议，不会干预；但在维斯塔潘连续两场撞车后，FIA与红牛进行了沟通，红牛方面认为还需做更多工作。
items.titleEn: FIA: F1's Macarena wings to stay, but Red Bull had to do "more work"
items.summaryEn: FIA single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis says the FIA has no objections to the overall concept of the rotating "Macarena" rear wing and will not intervene, but following Max Verstappen's two consecutive crashes, the FIA held talks with Red Bull, which felt more work was needed.

items.titleZh: FIA对F1“马卡雷纳”尾翼开绿灯，红牛需“更多工作”
items.summaryZh: 2026赛季上半程最引人注目的创新之一是旋转式尾翼，被法拉利领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔戏称为“马卡雷纳”尾翼。FIA表示对该整体概念没有异议，不会介入，但曾因马克斯·维斯塔潘连续两次撞车而与红牛进行过沟通。
items.titleEn: FIA happy for F1's Macarena wings to stay, Red Bull had to do "more work"
items.summaryEn: The FIA says it has no objections to the overall concept of 2026's rotating rear wings, dubbed the "Macarena" by Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur, and will not intervene.

items.titleZh: F1车迷称赞加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托在“乘客公主”节目中的坦诚表现
items.summaryZh: 奥迪F1车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托参加了阿米莉亚·迪莫尔登伯格的YouTube系列节目“乘客公主”，在节目中教主持人控制速度和如何切弯。
items.titleEn: F1 fans praise Gabriel Bortoleto's brutally honest "Passenger Princess" appearance
items.summaryEn: Audi Formula 1 driver Gabriel Bortoleto has appeared on Amelia Dimoldenberg's "Passenger Princess" YouTube series, where he taught the presenter speed control and how to hit the apex.

items.titleZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳宣布英国新书巡展，纪念红牛F1生涯
items.summaryZh: 前红牛车队CEO兼领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳宣布，将于今年秋季在英国举行新书巡展，配合其回忆录《Drive》的发布。
items.titleEn: Christian Horner announces UK book tour for new memoir following Red Bull F1 exit
items.summaryEn: Former Red Bull Racing CEO and team principal Christian Horner has announced a UK book tour this autumn to coincide with the release of his new memoir, Drive.

items.titleZh: F1推出新宣传片《五盏红灯》 科林·法瑞尔配音
items.summaryZh: F1在夏休期结束、荷兰大奖赛即将到来之际推出全新全球营销活动“五盏红灯”，由奥斯卡提名演员科林·法瑞尔担任旁白。
items.titleEn: F1 launches new "Five Lights" campaign narrated by Colin Farrell
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has launched a new global marketing campaign called Five Lights ahead of its return from the summer break with the Dutch Grand Prix, narrated by Academy Award-nominated actor Colin Farrell.

items.titleZh: 前F1车队领队萨夫瑙尔揭秘拍摄《极速求生》时提醒同事戴麦克风的奇特方式
items.summaryZh: 前F1车队领队奥特马尔·萨夫瑙尔透露，在拍摄Netflix纪录片《极速求生》期间，他用一种奇特的方式提醒同事自己正戴着麦克风。这部热门纪录片让车迷前所未有地接触F1围场，但也迫使车队人员设法保护隐私。
items.titleEn: Former F1 team boss reveals bizarre way he warned staff about "Drive to Survive" microphones
items.summaryEn: Former F1 team principal Otmar Szafnauer revealed the unusual way he warned colleagues that he was wearing a microphone while filming Netflix's Drive to Survive. The popular docuseries gave fans unprecedented access to the F1 paddock, forcing team personnel to get creative to protect their privacy.

items.titleZh: F1老将角田裕毅或于2027年转战IndyCar加盟Meyer Shank车队
items.summaryZh: 据Motorsport.com报道，F1老将角田裕毅正在与Meyer Shank 比赛（MSR）本田车队洽谈，争取2027年IndyCar系列赛#66赛车席位。
items.summaryEn: F1 veteran Yuki Tsunoda is reportedly in talks with Meyer Shank Racing for the team's #66 Honda IndyCar entry for the 2027 season.

items.titleZh: 史上最伟大的25位F1车手排名出炉
items.summaryZh: Motorsport、Autosport和Yahoo Sports的10位赛车记者各自提交排名，汇总出一份史上最伟大的25位F1车手榜单，最终第一名出现票数相同的情况。
items.titleEn: The 25 greatest Formula 1 drivers of all time, ranked
items.summaryEn: Ten journalists from Motorsport, Autosport and Yahoo Sports each submitted rankings to compile a list of the 25 greatest Formula 1 drivers in history, and the final vote produced a dead heat for first place.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯：迈凯伦2026引擎劣势或与投入不足有关
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯对客户车队迈凯伦未能像厂队那样充分发挥2026年F1动力单元性能的问题提出了自己的解释，认为迈凯伦的引擎劣势可能与其投入不足有关，而非单纯的技术问题。
items.titleEn: Just spend more? Mercedes' intriguing theory for McLaren's PU deficit
items.summaryEn: Mercedes has offered its own explanation for why customer team McLaren has not exploited the 2026 Formula 1 power unit as effectively as the works operation, suggesting the shortfall may stem from insufficient investment rather than purely technical issues.

items.titleZh: 施泰纳承认在哈斯F1车队多待了两年
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯F1车队领队冈瑟·施泰纳承认，他在车队多待了两年。施泰纳在2023赛季结束后因合同未续约而离任，并在播客中回顾了自己的任期。
items.titleEn: Guenther Steiner admits he stayed at Haas F1 team "two years too long"
items.summaryEn: Former Haas F1 team principal Guenther Steiner has admitted that he stayed at the American outfit "two years too long". He left after the 2023 season when his contract was not renewed and reflected on his tenure on the High Performance podcast.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1荷兰大奖赛周末赛程时间表
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1赛季夏休期后即将迎来荷兰大奖赛，The 比赛整理了赞德福特赛道的完整周末时间表供车迷参考。
items.titleEn: What time is F1's 2026 Dutch Grand Prix? Full weekend schedule
items.summaryEn: As the 2026 Formula 1 season resumes after the summer break, The Race has compiled the full weekend schedule for the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯：在2026年冠军之争中过早偏袒安东内利或拉塞尔
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯认为，在刘易斯·汉密尔顿加盟法拉利的威胁下，现在就在2026年世界冠军之争中优先考虑基米·安东内利或乔治·拉塞尔还"为时过早"。
items.titleEn: Mercedes: "Too early" to favour Kimi Antonelli in F1 2026 title fight
items.summaryEn: Mercedes says it is "far too early" to prioritise Kimi Antonelli or George Russell in the 2026 Formula 1 world title fight amid the threat of Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔将荷兰大奖赛打碎奖杯趣事融入红牛特别头盔设计
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队为维斯塔潘和哈贾尔推出纪念荷兰大奖赛的特别版头盔和赛车服，哈贾尔的头盔设计融入了他上赛季在该站打碎奖杯的趣事。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar turns viral Dutch GP trophy moment into special Red Bull helmet design
items.summaryEn: Red Bull has unveiled special-edition helmets and race suits for Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar for the Dutch Grand Prix, with Hadjar's helmet incorporating his broken trophy moment from last season.

items.titleZh: 艾伦·麦克尼什盛赞博尔托莱托：具备“巨大潜力”
items.summaryZh: 奥迪赛车总监艾伦·麦克尼什深入剖析了加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托成为F1车手所具备的心态，并盛赞其潜力。
items.titleEn: Allan McNish reveals qualities that give Gabriel Bortoleto “a lot of potential”
items.summaryEn: Audi sporting director Allan McNish has given an in-depth analysis of Gabriel Bortoleto's mindset as an F1 driver, praising his enormous potential.

items.titleZh: 罗伯·斯梅德利透露为何拒绝F1车队领队职位
items.summaryZh: 前法拉利和威廉姆斯车队工程师罗伯·斯梅德利透露，他近期收到F1车队领队职位的邀请但予以拒绝，原因是无法在缺乏对车队完全掌控的情况下承担相应责任。
items.titleEn: Rob Smedley reveals why he turned down F1 team principal roles
items.summaryEn: Former Ferrari and Williams race engineer Rob Smedley has revealed he was recently approached for Formula 1 team principal roles but turned them down because he was unwilling to be held accountable without having full control of a team.

items.titleZh: 本田F1项目与红牛时期截然不同
items.summaryZh: 本田首席工程师折原慎太郎表示，本田的理念“独特”，员工和知识在公路车项目与F1之间不断轮换。阿德里安·纽维在墨尔本FIA车队负责人新闻发布会上公开谈论了本田的电池问题。
items.titleEn: Why Honda's F1 project looks completely different from its Red Bull years
items.summaryEn: Honda chief engineer Shintaro Orihara says Honda's philosophy is "unique", with staff and knowledge constantly rotating between road car projects and F1. Adrian Newey spoke openly about Honda's battery problems at the FIA team principals' press conference in Melbourne.

items.titleZh: 纽维谈本田F1项目与红牛时代的根本不同
items.summaryZh: 在墨尔本举行的赛季揭幕战国际汽联车队负责人新闻发布会上，传奇设计师阿德里安·纽维的出现引发多方关注。他公开谈到本田的电池问题，承认车队负责人一职在一定程度上分散了他的设计职责，并略带夸张地表示本田这些年间主要在忙于太阳能板业务。
items.titleEn: What makes Honda's F1 project completely different from its Red Bull years
items.summaryEn: Legendary designer Adrian Newey attracted attention when he appeared at the FIA team principals' press conference at the season opener in Melbourne. He spoke openly about Honda's battery problems, admitted his team principal role had distracted him somewhat from design duties, and said with some exaggeration that Honda had mainly been busy with solar panels in the intervening years.

items.titleZh: 奥马尔·萨夫瑙尔暗示可能重返F1，但角色或将不同
items.summaryZh: 前印度力量、阿斯顿·马丁及阿尔派车队领队奥马尔·萨夫瑙尔表示，他对重返F1持开放态度，但暗示回归时可能不再担任车队领队一职。
items.titleEn: Otmar Szafnauer opens door to F1 comeback but hints at different role
items.summaryEn: Former Force India, Aston Martin and Alpine team principal Otmar Szafnauer has revealed he remains open to a Formula 1 comeback, though any return to the paddock might not be in a team principal role. He discussed his future on the High Performance Racing podcast.

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德谈与劳森在小红牛车队的搭档关系
