items.summaryEn: Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas says the newly formed team has made clear progress in the first half of its maiden Formula 1 season despite reliability issues and a lack of points.

items.titleZh: F1 2026赛季中期评分：红牛开局不利但夏季反弹显进步
items.summaryZh: Motorsport.com对2026赛季F1上半程各车队进行评分，红牛因底盘自赛季初即落后于主要对手而开局艰难，但赛季末段的反弹使其评分勉强从更差成绩拉回到C-。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 mid-season grades: Red Bull stumbles but summer rally shows glimmer of progress
items.summaryEn: Motorsport.com grades the F1 teams at the halfway point of the 2026 season, and Red Bull's difficult start, with its chassis lagging top rivals from day one, is salvaged to a C- by a late push towards the summer.

items.titleZh: 罗伯·斯梅德利质疑哈斯成为F1领先车队的前景
items.summaryZh: 前法拉利F1比赛工程师罗伯·斯梅德利认为，哈斯车队目前的商业模式和结构将阻碍其成为F1中的领先车队。哈斯自2016年加入F1以来严重依赖与法拉利的技术合作，这种方式虽具成本效益，但常导致赛季中期表现下滑。
items.titleEn: Rob Smedley casts doubt on Haas's chances of becoming F1 frontrunners
items.summaryEn: Former Ferrari Formula 1 race engineer Rob Smedley has argued that Haas's current business model and structure will prevent the team from becoming a frontrunner in Formula 1. Haas, which joined F1 in 2016, relies heavily on technical collaboration with Ferrari, a cost-effective approach that has often led to mid-season performance declines.

items.titleZh: 哈基宁揭秘与库特哈德在迈凯伦的竞争为何从未失控
items.summaryZh: 两届F1世界冠军米卡·哈基宁回顾与大卫·库特哈德在迈凯伦的合作，称两人对沃金车队未来成功的共同信念，使赛道上的碰撞未能影响他们的工作关系。
items.titleEn: Mika Hakkinen reveals why McLaren rivalry with David Coulthard never boiled over
items.summaryEn: Two-time Formula 1 champion Mika Hakkinen has opened up about working alongside David Coulthard at McLaren, explaining that a shared belief in the Woking outfit's future success prevented on-track collisions from affecting their working relationship.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克否认卡马拉2027年传闻，但称“情况可能变化”
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队CEO丹·托里斯否认了车队正在考虑签下F2领跑者拉斐尔·卡马拉参加2027赛季的报道，但承认“事情总是会变的”。此前有报道称，这支使用法拉利引擎的车队在关注这位法拉利青训车手，希望让他成为下赛季的正式车手之一。
items.titleEn: Cadillac claims Rafael Camara 2027 rumour is “unsubstantiated”, yet admits “things can change”
items.summaryEn: Cadillac F1 team CEO Dan Towriss has denied reports that the team is considering signing Formula 2 frontrunner Rafael Camara for the 2027 season, while admitting that "things can always change". This follows reports that the Ferrari-powered team was tracking the Ferrari junior driver as a potential race driver for next season.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克为何此时决定用布德科夫斯基替换洛登
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克在夏休期突然宣布格拉姆·洛登即刻卸任车队领队，由马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接任。CEO丹·托里斯承认换帅比预期更早，并称车队进入“新阶段”需要不同类型的领导。
items.titleEn: Why Cadillac has decided to act now and replace Lowdon with Budkowski
items.summaryEn: Cadillac abruptly announced during the summer break that Graeme Lowdon has been replaced as team principal with immediate effect by Marcin Budkowski. CEO Dan Towriss admitted the change came earlier than expected and said the team needs a different type of leadership for a "new phase".

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队突发换帅：洛登离任，布德科夫斯基接任
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛前一周多，凯迪拉克车队突然宣布格拉姆·洛登即刻卸任车队领队，由马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接任，时机和方式令围场震动。
items.titleEn: What’s behind Cadillac’s shock F1 team principal change – and why it happened now
items.summaryEn: Just over a week before the Dutch Grand Prix, Cadillac abruptly announced that Graeme Lowdon had been replaced as team principal with immediate effect by Marcin Budkowski, a move that stunned the paddock.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队否认佩雷斯转会威廉姆斯传闻
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队新任负责人马尔钦·布德科夫斯基称赞塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在2026赛季中的表现，并否认了关于佩雷斯可能离开车队的传闻。尽管因赛车性能不佳尚未得分，佩雷斯仍展现了自身能力。
items.titleEn: Cadillac F1 team "not distracted" by Sergio Perez to Williams rumours
items.summaryEn: New Cadillac F1 team boss Marcin Budkowski has praised Sergio Perez for his role in the 2026 campaign and denied rumours linking him with a move away from the debutant squad. Despite not yet scoring a point due to inferior machinery, Perez has still shown what he is capable of.

items.titleZh: 布德科夫斯基：加盟凯迪拉克前曾与F1半数以上车队接触
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克新任领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基确认，在加盟这支新军之前，他曾与F1围场中超过半数的车队进行过谈判，并解释了最终选择凯迪拉克的原因。此前凯迪拉克在夏休期间出人意料地宣布由他取代格雷姆·洛登担任领队。
items.titleEn: Marcin Budkowski spoke to 'over half' the F1 grid before choosing Cadillac
items.summaryEn: New Cadillac team principal Marcin Budkowski confirmed he held negotiations with more than half of the Formula 1 grid before explaining why he chose the debutant outfit. Cadillac had made a shock announcement during the summer shutdown that Graeme Lowdon was replaced by Budkowski as team principal.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克确认洛登离队并非双方协商一致
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队证实，格雷姆·洛登被解职并非双方协商一致的决定，且他仅在当天早上才得知此事。车队宣布由前阿尔派执行总监马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接替洛登，担任2026赛季剩余时间及以后的车队负责人。
items.titleEn: Cadillac confirms Lowdon's shock exit wasn't a "mutual decision"
items.summaryEn: Cadillac Formula 1 has confirmed that Graeme Lowdon's dismissal as team principal was not a mutual decision, adding that he was only informed on the morning of the announcement. The team announced that former Alpine executive director Marcin Budkowski will replace Lowdon as team principal for the remainder of the 2026 season and beyond.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队确认洛登离任并非“双方协商一致”
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队确认，格雷姆·洛登被解职并非“双方协商一致”，且他仅在当天早上才得知此事。车队宣布由前阿尔派执行总监马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接替，任期覆盖2026赛季剩余时间及之后。
items.titleEn: Graeme Lowdon's shock Cadillac exit wasn't a "mutual decision" - Dan Towriss
items.summaryEn: Cadillac's F1 team has confirmed that Graeme Lowdon's departure was not 'mutually agreed' and that he only learned of the decision on the morning it was announced. Former Alpine executive director Marcin Budkowski will replace him for the remainder of the 2026 season and beyond.

items.titleZh: 布德科夫斯基接替洛登出任凯迪拉克F1车队领队
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队任命马尔钦·布德科夫斯基为新任车队领队，接替格雷姆·洛登。49岁的布德科夫斯基曾在普罗斯特、法拉利和迈凯伦担任空气动力学专家，之后负责FIA的F1技术部门，并加入雷诺车队。
items.titleEn: Budkowski replaces Lowdon as Cadillac F1 boss
items.summaryEn: Cadillac Formula 1 Team has appointed Marcin Budkowski as its new team principal, replacing Graeme Lowdon. The 49-year-old previously worked as an aerodynamicist at Prost, Ferrari and McLaren, headed the FIA's F1 technical department, and later joined Renault.

items.titleZh: 格拉姆·洛登离开凯迪拉克，马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接任车队领队
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队宣布更换车队领队，由马尔钦·布德科夫斯基接替格拉姆·洛登。布德科夫斯基现年49岁，此前曾担任阿尔派执行总监。
items.titleEn: Graeme Lowdon leaves Cadillac, replaced by new team principal
items.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team has replaced team principal Graeme Lowdon with Marcin Budkowski, who previously served as executive director of Alpine. Budkowski, 49, has a background spanning roles at Prost, Ferrari and McLaren as well as the FIA's F1 technical department and Renault.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦认为2026年F1规则下顶尖车手仍能发挥关键作用
items.summaryZh: 针对车手们抱怨软件深度干预驾驶的2026年新规，卫冕车队冠军迈凯伦认为顶尖车手仍能凭借驾驶技术对比赛结果产生影响。
items.titleEn: Why McLaren feels the best drivers can still make a difference under F1 2026 rules
items.summaryEn: Amid widespread driver complaints about heavy software intervention in car control under the 2026 F1 rules, reigning constructors' champion McLaren believes the best drivers can still make a difference through their talent.

items.titleZh: F1 2026规则下车手天赋仍能发挥重要作用
items.summaryZh: 在车手们对软件过度干预赛车控制提出大量批评的背景下，去年的车队总冠军车队表示，车手天赋依然重要。迈阿密大奖赛前对规则进行了微调，但近期动力单元自学习算法导致的圈速差异又引发新的担忧。
items.titleEn: How driver talent still makes a big difference under F1 2026 rules
items.summaryEn: Amid much criticism from drivers about the heavy-handed intervention of software in their control of the car, last year's constructors' championship-winning team says talent still counts. A tweak to the regulations ahead of the Miami Grand Prix reduced some of the criticised 'yo-yo racing', but more recently speed differences caused by the power units' self-learning algorithms have caused a great deal of angst.

items.titleZh: F1 2026赛季中期评分：小红牛惊艳中游集团
items.summaryZh: Motorsport.com对2026赛季F1上半程各车队进行评分，小红牛被评为中游集团中最稳定可靠的表现者。
items.summaryEn: Motorsport.com grades all 11 teams after the first half of the 2026 Formula 1 season, with Racing Bulls emerging as the most reliable midfield performer.

items.titleZh: 杰西卡·霍金斯：女性具备F1所需体能，但初级系列赛需调整
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1车队大使杰西卡·霍金斯表示，女性具备参加F1所需的体能，但F2和F3等初级赛事可能需要调整，以确保男女车手能公平竞争。
items.titleEn: Jessica Hawkins dismisses F1 strength concerns but flags junior series barrier for female drivers
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin F1 ambassador Jessica Hawkins insists women have the physical strength required to race in F1, but suggests changes may be needed in junior categories such as Formula 2 and Formula 3 to ensure female and male drivers can compete on equal terms.

items.titleZh: F1的ADUO系统是否需要重新思考？国际汽联承认存在“弱点”
items.summaryZh: F1的额外发展与升级机会系统在赛季前半段成为围场内政治争议最多的话题之一，国际汽联的尼古拉斯·通巴齐斯承认该系统未来几年可能需要重新思考。
items.titleEn: Does F1's ADUO system need a rethink? FIA admits to "weaknesses"
items.summaryEn: F1's ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) system became one of the most politically debated topics in the paddock during the first half of the season, and the FIA's Nikolas Tombazis admitted it may need a rethink in the coming years.

items.titleZh: FIA承认F1的ADUO系统存在弱点但为其测量方法辩护
items.summaryZh: FIA单座赛车总监Nikolas Tombazis承认F1的ADUO系统存在“弱点”，未来可能需要改进，但坚称测量方法是准确的。该系统旨在为落后的制造商提供安全网，却在上半赛季演变为政治战场。
items.titleEn: FIA admits F1's ADUO system has "weaknesses" – but defends its measurements
items.summaryEn: FIA single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis has admitted that F1's ADUO system has "weaknesses" and may need a rethink in the coming years, although he insists the measurements are accurate. The system, designed as a safety net for manufacturers that fall behind, has turned into a political battleground in the first half of the season.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯解析安东内利2026赛季新高度的关键特质
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯副领队布拉德利·洛德解释了基米·安东内利本赛季晋升为F1冠军争夺者的几个原因。安东内利去年作为F1历史上第三年轻的车手经历了艰难的新秀赛季。
items.titleEn: Mercedes explains key attributes behind Kimi Antonelli’s new 2026 F1 level
items.summaryEn: Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord has given several reasons behind Kimi Antonelli's rise into a Formula 1 title contender this season. Antonelli endured a tough rookie campaign last year as F1's third-youngest driver in history.

items.titleZh: F1 2026赛季中期评分：阿尔派进步显著但后劲不足
items.summaryZh: 在提前放弃2025赛季转向2026赛季的车队中，搭载梅赛德斯引擎的阿尔派收获最大，开局强劲一度统治中游集团，但夏休前被对手追上，半程排名第六，其上半赛季表现被下调至B-。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 mid-season grades: Alpine makes great strides but struggles to maintain momentum
items.summaryEn: Among the teams that wrote off 2025 to focus early on 2026, Mercedes-powered Alpine benefited the most, starting strongly and dominating the midfield before being caught by rivals before the summer break. Its first half has been slightly downgraded to a B-, ending sixth in the standings, five points behind Racing Bulls.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦称法拉利升级数量鼓舞人心，力求跟上步伐
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦表示，法拉利在2026赛季前半段推出的大量F1赛车升级令其印象深刻，车队正努力理解并跟上其升级节奏，以持续推出自己的升级。
items.titleEn: McLaren trying to understand Ferrari's 'inspirational' upgrade volume
items.summaryEn: McLaren says Ferrari's vast number of F1 car upgrades over the first half of the 2026 season is an inspiration, as the team tries to understand how Ferrari managed it and keeps rolling out updates of its own.

items.titleZh: 本田F1动力单元升级前瞻：阿斯顿·马丁期待性能提升
items.summaryZh: 本田将在赞德福特站带来2026赛季首个动力单元升级，完全聚焦内燃机性能；首席工程师折原慎太郎坦言引擎性能是本田相较对手的最大短板，同时新规格将带来驾驶性方面的全新挑战。
items.titleEn: What to expect from Honda's long-awaited F1 power unit upgrade
items.summaryEn: Honda will bring its first power unit upgrade of the 2026 Formula 1 season to Zandvoort, focusing entirely on the internal combustion engine. Chief engineer Shintaro Orihara admits engine performance is Honda's biggest weakness compared to rivals, and the new specification will also bring a fresh drivability challenge.

items.titleZh: 本田F1动力单元升级在即，赞德福特站值得期待
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利站引入AMR26首个重大升级包后，本田将于赞德福特站带来2026赛季的首个动力单元升级。
items.titleEn: What to expect from Honda's long-awaited F1 power unit upgrade at Zandvoort
items.summaryEn: After Aston Martin introduced its first major upgrade package for the AMR26 in Hungary, Honda will bring its first power unit upgrade of the 2026 Formula 1 season to Zandvoort.

items.titleZh: 阿尔本在F1“烤架上的网格”视频中开红牛玩笑逗乐粉丝
items.summaryZh: F1官方系列节目“烤架上的网格”十周年挑战要求现役车手根据职业生涯发展图表识别车手，威廉姆斯车手阿尔本以关于红牛车手项目的自嘲玩笑逗乐粉丝。
items.titleEn: Alex Albon leaves fans in stitches with Red Bull joke in F1 "Grill The Grid" video
items.summaryEn: F1's official Grill The Grid series returned for its 10th anniversary, challenging current drivers to identify racers based on their career progression charts. Williams' Alex Albon stole the show with a self-deprecating joke about Red Bull's driver programme that left fans in stitches.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队负责人谈基础设施建设：边飞边造飞机
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队负责人格雷姆·洛登介绍了车队当前的基础设施建设进展，车队运营于多个地点，正在建设新设施，洛登形容这一过程为“边飞边造飞机”。
items.titleEn: How Cadillac is ‘building its plane while flying in it’ in F1
items.summaryEn: Cadillac Formula 1 team principal Graeme Lowdon has given an update on the outfit's current infrastructure, which is still being developed. Lowdon described the process as "building the plane while flying in it."

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队更新在建工厂进展
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队领队格雷姆·洛登介绍了车队基础设施的建设情况，这支F1最新车队目前在英国银石设有主要基地，其位于美国印第安纳州的新基地仍在建设中。
items.titleEn: Cadillac gives update on its under-construction F1 factories
items.summaryEn: Cadillac F1 team principal Graeme Lowdon has given an update on the team's infrastructure, which is still being developed, with the newest F1 team currently based at Silverstone in the UK while its new American base in Indiana is still taking shape.

items.titleZh: F1 2026赛季中期评分：哈斯车队开局强劲但逐渐掉队
items.summaryZh: 在Motorsport.com对2026赛季上半程11支车队的评分中，哈斯凭借奥利弗·贝尔曼的强势开局以21分位居车队积分榜第七，但因研发竞赛加剧导致性能下滑，仅获C-评分。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 mid-season grades: Haas gets left behind after strong start
items.summaryEn: In Motorsport.com's grading of all 11 teams after the first half of the 2026 F1 season, Haas sits seventh in the constructors' standings on 21 points thanks to Oliver Bearman's strong start, but its worrying performance decline as the development race heats up drops its grade to a C-.

items.titleZh: 杰西卡·霍金斯预测女性F1车手将在“几年内”出现
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队大使、前W Series车手杰西卡·霍金斯认为，女性将在“几年内”登上F1赛场，并支持F1学院培养有实力争夺大奖赛席位的车手。
items.titleEn: Jessica Hawkins predicts female F1 driver within "few years"
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin driver ambassador and former W Series racer Jessica Hawkins believes a woman will race in Formula 1 within a few years, backing the F1 Academy to develop talent capable of fighting for grand prix seats.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦技术总监承认对未及时跟进法拉利旋转尾翼概念感到失望
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦F1技术总监尼尔·霍尔迪承认，车队对未能像先驱法拉利那样迅速采纳倒置尾翼概念感到"失望"，目前正继续开发自己的版本，计划在夏休后投入使用。
items.titleEn: McLaren "disappointed" not to pick up rotating rear wing as quickly as Ferrari
items.summaryEn: McLaren Formula 1 technical director Neil Houldey admitted the team was "disappointed" not to adopt the upside down rear wing concept as quickly as pioneering Ferrari, and is continuing to develop its own version for use after the summer break.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦为何不会很快全面转向2027年赛车研发
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦认为在夏休后继续为2026年赛车带来升级仍有很大收益，且不会因此损害2027年项目。匈牙利站引入的改进地板和新版前翼帮助诺里斯拿下本赛季首个分站冠军。
items.titleEn: Why McLaren won't switch full focus to its 2027 car anytime soon
items.summaryEn: McLaren believes there is still plenty of benefit in bringing car upgrades after the summer break without compromising its 2027 Formula 1 project. Its latest upgrade package in Hungary, featuring a revised floor and the latest front wing iteration, helped Lando Norris claim his and the team's first grand prix win of the campaign.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦为何不会停止2026年F1赛车研发
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦认为夏休期后继续为2026年赛车带来升级仍有很大收益，不会因此牺牲2027年项目。车队在匈牙利站推出的最新升级包延续了其中期升级的高效传统。
items.titleEn: Why McLaren won't turn off its 2026 F1 car development just yet
items.summaryEn: McLaren believes there is still plenty of benefit in bringing car upgrades after the summer break without compromising its 2027 Formula 1 project. The team's latest upgrade package in Hungary continued its successful record of in-season development.

items.titleZh: 前F1车手库特哈德曾免费将伦敦酒吧转让给克拉克森
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手大卫·库特哈德透露，他经营的伦敦西南部酒吧The Brown Dog生意不佳，曾免费将其提供给前《Top Gear》主持人杰里米·克拉克森，试图挽救这家酒吧。
items.titleEn: Former F1 driver reveals he offered London pub to Jeremy Clarkson in unusual deal
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard revealed that he once offered his struggling south-west London pub to former Top Gear host Jeremy Clarkson free of charge in an attempt to salvage the venture.

items.titleZh: 乔治·拉塞尔宣布与卡门·蒙特罗·蒙德订婚
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1车手乔治·拉塞尔宣布与长期伴侣卡门·蒙特罗·蒙德订婚，他在社交媒体上发布了一枚戒指和一颗白心的帖子，并分享现场照片。
items.titleEn: George Russell announces engagement to long-term partner Carmen Montero Mundt
items.summaryEn: Mercedes Formula 1 driver George Russell has announced his engagement to his long-term partner Carmen Montero Mundt, sharing the news on social media with a post featuring a ring and a white heart emoji alongside photos from the occasion.

items.titleZh: 萨夫瑙尔建议法拉利让勒克莱尔独处，勿进行正式中期会谈
items.summaryZh: 前阿尔派车队领队奥特马尔·萨夫瑙尔建议法拉利管理层不要与查尔斯·勒克莱尔进行正式的中期会谈，认为车队应在他与刘易斯·汉密尔顿共处的艰难时期让他独处。
items.titleEn: Otmar Szafnauer tells Ferrari to 'leave Charles Leclerc alone' amid Lewis Hamilton battle
items.summaryEn: Former Alpine team principal Otmar Szafnauer has advised Ferrari management against holding a formal mid-season discussion with Charles Leclerc, insisting the team should leave him alone as he works through a challenging period alongside Lewis Hamilton.

items.titleZh: 哈基宁警告迈凯伦勿追维斯塔潘：勿“搅局”破坏队内氛围
items.summaryZh: 两届F1世界冠军米卡·哈基宁警告老东家迈凯伦不要试图签下马克斯·维斯塔潘，建议车队保护内部团队精神，避免在赛季中期的车手市场传闻中“搅局”。
items.titleEn: Mika Hakkinen urges McLaren not to "rock the boat" with Max Verstappen move
items.summaryEn: Two-time Formula 1 champion Mika Hakkinen has warned his former team McLaren against pursuing Max Verstappen, advising them to protect their internal team spirit and avoid "rocking the boat" amid midseason driver market speculation.

items.titleZh: 托托·沃尔夫谈育儿挑战：九岁儿子领跑卡丁车锦标赛
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1车队领队托托·沃尔夫谈到了在九岁儿子杰克的卡丁车乐趣与求胜心之间寻找平衡的挑战。小沃尔夫近日在意大利IAME卡丁车系列赛中夺冠，目前领跑积分榜，赛季收官战在即。
items.titleEn: Toto Wolff reveals parenting challenge as son Jack leads karting championship
items.summaryEn: Mercedes Formula 1 team principal Toto Wolff has spoken about balancing his nine-year-old son Jack's enjoyment and ambition in karting. Jack recently won a race in the IAME Karting Series in Italy and now leads the championship standings ahead of the season finale.

items.titleZh: F1 2026赛季中期评分：奥迪厂队首秀开局稳健
items.summaryZh: 奥迪作为厂队进入F1首个赛季，夏季休赛期前以12分位居车队积分榜第八，开局表现令人鼓舞。奥迪在去年冬季柏林发布会上明确了2030年前赢得世界冠军的目标。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 mid-season grades: Audi gets off to solid start on works debut
items.summaryEn: Audi has made an encouraging start in its first season as an F1 works team, sitting eighth in the standings on 12 points heading into the summer break. The German marque set an explicit goal of winning world championships by 2030 when it presented its F1 project in Berlin last winter.

items.titleZh: 贝尔曼开设自行车店与咖啡馆
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车手贝尔曼透露，他与一群朋友在摩纳哥上方开设了一家自行车店和咖啡馆。这位21岁英国车手在F1 Beyond The 发车区播客中谈到自己对骑行的热情，并将其大量融入2026年赛季训练。
items.titleEn: Oliver Bearman reveals new business venture away from F1
items.summaryEn: Haas Formula 1 driver Oliver Bearman has revealed he has opened a bike shop and cafe above Monaco alongside a group of friends. The 21-year-old Briton discussed his growing passion for cycling on the F1 Beyond The Grid podcast and has integrated the sport heavily into his training for the 2026 F1 campaign.

items.titleZh: 博尔托莱托反驳F1 2026赛车与驾驶风格冲突的观点
items.summaryZh: 奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托反驳了2026年赛车与驾驶风格相冲突的说法，认为F1车手“应该能够适应”任何赛车。
items.titleEn: Gabriel Bortoleto refutes idea of F1 2026 cars clashing with driving styles
items.summaryEn: Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto has refuted the idea that the 2026 F1 cars clash with driving styles, arguing that F1 drivers "should be able to adapt" to any machinery.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿分享与新宠物狗Halo的首批照片
items.summaryZh: 七届F1世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿在夏休期分享了家中新成员——金毛寻回犬幼犬Halo的首批照片和视频。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton shares first photos with new puppy Halo
items.summaryEn: Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton has shared the first photos and videos of his new golden retriever puppy named Halo during the F1 summer break.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔谈红牛“文化冲击”：从小红牛到红牛队
items.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔表示，从小红牛晋升至红牛一队是一次“文化冲击”，但他认为青训多年的经历让这次过渡感觉自然。哈贾尔在度过新秀赛季后，将于2026赛季与四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘搭档。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar explains Red Bull "culture shock" after Racing Bulls move
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar described his promotion from Racing Bulls to the senior Red Bull team as a "culture shock", but insisted that his years in the junior programme made the transition feel natural. After his rookie season with Racing Bulls, he will partner four-time F1 world champion Max Verstappen from the 2026 season.

items.titleZh: FIA计划下一轮规则改革让F1赛车再减重80公斤
items.summaryZh: FIA单座赛车总监尼古拉斯·通巴西斯表示，2026年底盘规则在缩短轴距、减重和减少脏空气影响方面取得进展，但FIA希望在下一轮规则改革中让赛车再减重80公斤。
items.titleEn: FIA wants F1 cars to lose another 80kg under next rules overhaul
items.summaryEn: FIA single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis says the 2026 chassis regulations represent progress in shortening the wheelbase, reducing weight and cutting dirty air, but the FIA wants cars to lose another 80kg under the next rules overhaul.

items.titleZh: 克拉克、塞纳、安东内利——大满贯年龄纪录的演变
items.summaryZh: F1大满贯（杆位、领跑每一圈并夺冠、同时创造最快圈速）的年龄纪录不断被刷新。胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥在1950年摩纳哥大奖赛上以38岁10个月27天的年龄成为首位大满贯得主，此后吉姆·克拉克、埃尔顿·塞纳等车手相继打破纪录，而最近安德烈亚·安东内利可能再次刷新这一纪录。
items.titleEn: Clark, Senna, Antonelli – How the grand chelem age record has evolved
items.summaryEn: The age record for F1 grand chelems (pole position, leading every lap, winning, and setting the fastest lap) has been repeatedly broken. Juan Manuel Fangio became the first grand chelem winner at the 1950 Monaco Grand Prix at the age of 38 years, 10 months, and 27 days, and since then drivers like Jim Clark and Ayrton Senna have successively broken the record, while recently Andrea Kimi Antonelli may have broken it again.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯模拟器车手维克多·马丁斯：对赛车影响并非直接
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯F1车队测试与发展车手维克多·马丁斯在接受Autosport采访时表示，他对赛车有影响，但这种影响并非直接的，因为车队中有许多人和部门需要改进与分析。
items.titleEn: What is it like being a Williams F1 simulator driver?
items.summaryEn: Williams F1 test and development driver Victor Martins said in an interview with Autosport that he does have an impact on the car, but it is not necessarily direct, as the team has many people and departments working on improvements and analysis.

items.titleZh: 天空体育与奥迪联合推出“飞驰圈”赛道指南系列
items.summaryZh: 天空体育与奥迪合作推出名为“飞驰圈”的赛道指南系列节目，在F1赛道现场结合真实驾驶与高级模拟数据，为观众解析赛道。
items.titleEn: Sky Sports and Audi launch 'Flying Lap' series in unique storytelling experience from F1 race tracks
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports and Audi have launched a track guide series called 'Flying Lap', which combines real-life driving at Formula 1 circuits with advanced simulation data to give viewers an in-depth look at each track.
